name: 'Magic' Ring
icon: Ring A Simple Gold Unfaded Icon.png
description: 'Magic' Ring is a common Ring which can be sold or bartered with.
quote: The runes encircling this ring appear to have been scratched into the metal with a rock.
where_to_find: Received from Mattis at his stall
notes:
Stealing the ring from Mattis before talking to him grants the following inspiration:
• Made You Look ( Entertainer backgrounds)
• Artful Dodger ( Urchin backgrounds)

name: +1 Breastplate
description: +1 Breastplate is a common Medium Armour.
quote: Wearing this "plus one" garment allows you to bring one additional person to a wedding or any other similar occasion.
where_to_find: Given as a consolation prize by Akabi after failing to win the jackpot at the Wheel of Fortune
notes:
• This item is effectively equivalent to a regular Breastplate.
• This item can not be spawned using third party tools.

name: A Sparking Promise
icon: Ring E Gold A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: A Sparking Promise is a rare Ring. It grants a cantrip which can electrify surfaces the target walks on.
quote: A year into their union, Lenore, cleric of Mystra, gifted the gnome inventor Yrre an invention of her own devising - a ring that held a spell of sparks. Eventually, the touch of Lenore's hand faded to a glinting memory, but the ring's tingling grip remained resolute.
special:
Ensnaring Shock (Bonus Action)
Consume 4 of your Lightning Charges to mark a foe. When the target moves create an electrical blast with Range: 2 m (6.5 ft) radius that deals 1d4 Lightning. ( Recharge: Short rest.)

name: Abdel's Trusted Shield
description: Abdel's Trusted Shield is a very rare Shield that allows the wearer to cast Protection from Missiles once per Short Rest, as well as use Shield Bash.
quote: Attached to this shield is a faded note. 'G, I've found the best defence against an arrow is to be the one behind the bow - but this shield also does the trick in a pinch. Yours, AA'
where_to_find: Given by Golbraith on the first floor of his home
special:
Protection from Missiles (Action)
Amplify your reflexes to better contend with incoming missiles. Ranged weapon attacks against you have Disadvantage, and their damage is halved. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
notes:
• Golbraith must be convinced of the party's courage against Mind Flayers.
• Apparently, Golbraith was a friend of [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Abdel_Adrian Abdel Adrian], the canonical identity of Gorion's Ward, the main character of the previous installments of the Baldur's Gate series. Some details about this can be read about in the book Confidant of a Duke found on a bookshelf beside Golbraith. However, neither Golbraith nor this shield appear in any previous games. Golbraith is loosely based on a fan of Baldur's Gate 3, who had been diagnosed with Alzheimer's.

name: Aberration Hunters' Amulet
description: The Aberration Hunters' Amulet is an uncommon Amulet. It grants Githyanki wearing it Advantage on Intelligence Saving Throws and aberrations have Disadvantage on attacks against them. The wielder can gain Advantage on Attack Rolls against Aberrations for 3 turns, once per Short Rest.
quote: Many a Githyanki hunter has worn this amulet before you. The strange stones set in swirling silver reverberate with echoes of their magic.
where_to_find: Carried by Ghustil Stornugoss in the Doctor's Office, west of the Infirmary
special:
Ancient Grudges (Bonus Action)
Touch your amulet to subsume a sliver of the knowledge of the gith. You gain Advantage on Attack Rolls against aberrations. ( Recharge: Short rest.)

name: Absolute Confidence Amulet
image: Amulet Necklace D Bronze A 1 Faded.png
controller_icon: Amulet Necklace D Bronze A 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Amulet Necklace D Bronze A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Absolute Confidence Amulet is an uncommon Amulet that grants the wearer a +1 bonus to Performance checks at the cost of -1 to Intimidation checks.
quote: The interlocked bronze links of this necklace tinkle softly every time you move.
where_to_find: Reward by Naaber
special:
• Performance +1
• Intimidation -1
notes:
• The party must initiate a conversation with him multiple times until all dialogue options are exhausted.
• The amulet can alternatively be pickpocked from Naaber.
• If this amulet is pickpocked from Naaber first, he rewards the party with the Seemingly Gleaming Ring instead.

name: Absolute Outfit
description: Absolute Outfit is a set of common Camp Clothing.
quote: Adorned with the tripartite symbol of the Absolute, this ensemble of black and green presents the wearer as either a mocker or a devotee of the cult. Or someone who likes the cut and colour. Or someone who is cold.
where_to_find: At random locations later in the game (rarely)

name: Absolute's Protector
description: Absolute's Protector is a rare Shield that reduces damage from spells by 1 if the user bears the mark of the Absolute, grants Shield Bash, and allows the wielder to cast Fire Shield: Chill once per Long Rest.
quote: The Absolute's power radiates from this shield, invisible waves of energy beckoning to the Branded.
where_to_find: Carried by Z'rell
special:
Fire Shield: Chill (Action)
Cast as a level 4 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Absolute's Smite
icon: Ring I Gold A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Absolute's Smite is an inaccessible uncommon Ring that grants its wearer the ability to cast Searing Smite once per Long Rest.
quote: This ring coaxes anyone branded by the Absolute. Their fingers veritably itch to slip it on.
special:
Searing Smite (Action + Bonus Action + Level 1 Spell Slot)
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Absolute's Talisman
description: Absolute's Talisman is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to cast a self-only version of Aid, and grants Advantage on Death Saving Throws if they bear the Absolute's Brand.
quote: Stained by blood, and gifted to only the most faithful of True Souls to help preserve their lives.
where_to_find: Worn by Priestess Gut
special:
Absolute's Talisman: Aid (Action)
Cast as a level 2 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
notes: • The Aid effect from this amulet is removed from affected character if the amulet is unequipped.

name: Absolute's Warboard
description: Absolute's Warboard is an uncommon Shield that improves a branded wearer's Saving Throws and allows them to cast Heroism once per Long Rest.
quote: Blood is smeared across the shield's face, exalting wielders who bear the Absolute's mark.
where_to_find: Carried by True Soul Gut
special:
Heroism (Action)
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Abyss Beckoners
description: The Abyss Beckoners are a very rare pair of gloves. They improve the damage resistance of the wearer's summons at the risk of driving them Mad.
quote: Demons will bite their masters, slaves, comrades, and, on occasion, themselves. They bite on principle, and are functionally piranha with extra steps.
where_to_find: inside a locked chest in a cell
bugs: • The description of Demonspirit Aura includes a tooltip link to Crown of Madness, instead of Demonspirit Madness.
notes:
• The following summons are innately immune to Demonspirit Madness
• Accursed Spectres from the The Hexblade's ability.
• Ghouls summoned through Danse Macabre, Animate Dead: Ghoul, or Animate Dead: Flying Ghoul
• Mummies from Create Undead
• Dryads from Conjure Woodland Being
• Wood Woads summoned by dryads through Fallen Lover
• Flaming Sphere
• Spiritual Weapon
• The following summons have a sufficiently high Wisdom saving throw bonus to be effectively immune to Demonspirit Madness. It is not possible to critically fail normal saving throws (except Concentration and Death saving throws), so a +9 Wisdom saving throw bonus is sufficient to always succeed the saving throw.
• Devas from Planar Ally: Deva or Sights of the Seelie: Summon Deva
• The following summons lack the SUMMON tag and are entirely unaffected by Demonspirit Aura:
• Guardian of Faith
• Grasping Vine

notes_links.text: Sights of the Seelie: Summon Deva
notes_links.page: Sights of the Seelie: Summon Deva

name: Acrobat Shoes
description: Acrobat Shoes is a pair of rare Boots that grants a bonus to Acrobatics and Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws.
quote: These flexible shoes were once owned by Audreyne Willoughs, who, in a somewhat ironic twist of fate, ran away from the circus to join her parents back home.
where_to_find: Sold by Barcus Wroot at his workshop
special:
• Acrobatics +1
• Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws.
bugs: • In what is likely a typo, the in-game description states these shoes grant "Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws Checks".

name: Adamantine Longsword
description: Adamantine Longsword is a rare +1 longsword that automatically critical hits objects and ignores resistance to Slashing damage.
quote: Though heavy, this longsword swings effortlessly in your hand -- ready to take down a hundred enemies.

name: Adamantine Mace
description: Adamantine Mace is a rare +1 Mace that automatically critical hits objects and ignores Resistance to Bludgeoning damage.
quote: A nimble mace, heavy with the promise of broken bones.

name: Adamantine Scale Mail
description: Adamantine Scale Mail is a very rare Medium Armour that reduces all incoming damage by 1 and sends attackers Reeling. In addition, attacks cannot land Critical Hits on the user.
quote: The adamantine scales hug your body like a second skin - a heavy, near-impregnable skin.
where_to_find: Forged from a Scale Mail Mould and Mithral Ore
special: • Attackers can't land Critical Hits on the wearer.

name: Adamantine Scimitar
description: Adamantine Scimitar is a rare +1 scimitar that automatically critical hits objects and ignores resistance to Slashing damage.
quote: Each cut of this blade shines with the wicked glint of adamantine -- a promise for a devastating blow.

name: Adamantine Shield
description: Adamantine Shield is a rare Shield that sends enemies Reeling when they miss you with a melee attack.
quote: The dull shine of the adamantine promises this shield could take a thousand beatings -- and still look as good as new.
where_to_find: Forged from a Shield Mould and Mithral Ore
special: • Attackers cannot land critical hits on the wearer.

name: Adamantine Splint Armour
description: Adamantine Splint Armour is a very rare Heavy Armour that reduces all incoming damage by 2 and sends attackers Reeling. In addition, attacks cannot land Critical Hits on the wearer.
quote: The adamantine plates lock and slide together perfectly - offering protection against even the deadliest of blades.
where_to_find: Forged from a Splint Mould and Mithral Ore
special: • Attackers cannot land Critical Hits on the wearer.

name: Adjustable Steel Helm
description: Adjustable Steel Helm is a common Helmet.
quote: Grated and fixable, so the wearer might gulp cool air during a fight.
where_to_find: On a table/shelf in the Morgue
special: • Constitution Saving Throws +1

name: After Death Do Us Part
description: After Death Do Us Part is a rare Ring which allows its wearer to regain half their hit points after being Downed, but be cursed with Shadow Possession.
quote: Love is the last cruel leaf to fall in an autumn wide with sorrow.
where_to_find: Carried by Oskar Fevras
passives: After Death Do Us Part (passive feature)
notes:
• Dropped during the quest Free the Artist if his affair is exposed to Lady Jannath or he is killed by Kerri.
• The bugged nature of this item makes it very useful (see below). As such, it may be advisable to fight Kerri, and then tell Jannath the truth, to obtain it.

name: Alfira's Lute
description: Alfira's Lute is a unique instrument. It can be played with the Perform action.
quote: Though the wood is old and worn, a loving hand has polished this lute to a shine. Its frets are slick with blood.
where_to_find: Carried by Alfira
notes: • If not acquired earlier, this item is gifted by Ripper during the goblin celebration in camp after raiding the Emerald Grove.

name: Allandra's Whelm
quote: When Allandra was a girl, she saw a hot spall of matter fire through the sky. She wished upon this falling star, but instead of getting an answer from the sky, she got one from the sea in the voice of Umberlee, goddess of the endless fathom.

name: Ambusher
description: Ambusher is a rare +1 Shortsword that grants the wielder bonuses to Initiative and Advantage on Perception checks; it also deals extra Necrotic damage on creatures which have not taken a turn yet.
quote: This blade is one of a few rare swords wielded by the Eucalyptus League, a group of fabulously wealthy courtesans who owned a great deal of Luskan's bazaars.

variants.name: Amethyst Ring
variants.icon: Ring D Gold A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
variants.description: An Amethyst Ring is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.
variants.quote: An unusual piece, this gold-studded amethyst caused a stir at the Wide plaza in Baldur's Gate
variants.where_to_find: In chests and carried by characters throughout the game

variants.name: Amethyst Ring
variants.icon: Ring D Silver A Unfaded Icon.png
variants.description: An Amethyst Ring is a common Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.
variants.quote: The silver band's cool undertones highlight this ring's vivid purple gemstone.
variants.where_to_find: In chests and carried by characters throughout the game

variants.name: Amethyst Ring
variants.icon: Ring D Silver A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
variants.description: An Amethyst Ring is a common Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.
variants.quote: The silver band's cool undertones highlight this ring's vivid purple gemstone.
variants.where_to_find: In chests and carried by characters throughout the game

name: Amethyst Ring
icon: Ring D Gold A Unfaded Icon.png
description: An Amethyst Ring is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.
quote: An unusual piece, this gold-studded amethyst caused a stir at the Wide plaza in Baldur's Gate
where_to_find: In chests and carried by characters throughout the game

name: Amulet of Bhaal
description: Amulet of Bhaal is a story-related Amulet which allows the wearer to inflict Bleeding when they hit targets with maximum hit points. It also grants access to the Bhaal Temple.
quote: A silver amulet depicting the symbol of Bhaal.
where_to_find: Worn by Sarevok Anchev or rewarded by him for completing Impress the Murder Tribunal
notes:
• This amulet allows access to Undercity Ruins as well as the Bhaal Temple inside it.
• The Dark Urge can enter the Bhaal Temple without the Amulet by having Sceleritas Fel open the door for them.

name: Amulet of Branding
controller_icon: Amulet Necklace D Silver A 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Amulet Necklace D Silver A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Amulet of Branding is a rare Amulet which allows the wearer to cast Brand the Weak once per Long Rest.
quote: Though thin and delicate-looking, the amulet's pendant sits heavy against your chest.
where_to_find: Carried by A'jak'nir Jeera
special:
Brand the Weak (Bonus Action)
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
bugs: • Brand the Weak does not display that it costs a Bonus Action on its spell container.
notes: • The vulnerability created by the Amulet seems to persist for one entire damaging instance, for example a character attacking with their main hand and off-hand at the same time will enjoy vulnerability on both strikes, if applicable.

name: Amulet of Elemental Torment
image: Amulet Necklace B Bronze A 1 Faded.png
controller_icon: Amulet Necklace B Bronze A 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Amulet Necklace B Bronze A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Amulet of Elemental Torment is an uncommon Amulet that channels the effects of certain Surfaces into the wearer's spells.
quote: Each jewel gleams with the energy of the natural elements.
where_to_find: Carried by Hope while fighting Raphael in the Foyer
notes: • Previously was sold by Grat the Trader in the Goblin Camp, Brem in the Zhentarim Basement, or Roah Moonglow in Shattered Sanctum. As of Patch 3, this was moved to Hope in the House of Hope.

name: Amulet of Greater Health
icon: Amulet of Greater Health Unfaded Icon.png
description: Amulet of Greater Health is a very rare Amulet which can enhance the wearer's Constitution.
quote: Worn by Lumi, a cleric beholden to twilight, who sheltered her fellow adventurers as a bantam shelters her chicks.
where_to_find: on the left-most pedestal in the Archive
special:
• Sets the wearer's Constitution score to 23. The enchantment has no effect if their Constitution score is higher without it.
• Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws.
notes:
• The in-game tooltip has a typo and reads, "Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws Checks".
• The amulet can be stolen without the fight if the trap is disabled first with a DC 20 Sleight of Hand Check and the Orphic Hammer, the Soul-Sworn Contract and Hope are left untouched.
• This item can be stolen in lieu of perception and disarm checks, by placing an item of equal weight on the pedestal prior to picking up the amulet in a manner similar to [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0gU35Tgtlmg this] scene in Raiders of the Lost Ark.
• If the wearer's Constitution is lower than 22, the amulet increases their maximum hit points in accordance with the increase in Constitution, but their current hit points remain the same and do not automatically rise to the new maximum.

name: Amulet of Misty Step
image: Amulet Necklace B Silver A 1 Faded.png
controller_icon: Amulet Necklace B Silver A 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Amulet Necklace B Silver A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Amulet of Misty Step is an uncommon amulet that grants its wearer the Misty Step spell on a short rest cooldown.
quote: This necklace allows the wearer to cast Misty Step. Made of blue gems unique to a privately-owned mine in Menzoberranzan, this necklace was likely a token of esteem - or perhaps a desperate attempt to win its recipient's mercy.
where_to_find: In a Gilded chest next to the bed behind Polma in Gut's private chambers
special:
Misty Step (Bonus Action)
Cast as a level 2 spell ( Recharge: Short rest.)
notes: • The amulet can only acquired once, at whichever of the two locations that is accessed first. It will not appear at the other location.

name: Amulet of Restoration
image: Amulet Necklace F Silver A 1 Faded.png
controller_icon: Amulet Necklace F Silver A 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Amulet Necklace F Silver A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Amulet of Restoration is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast Healing Word and Mass Healing Word once per Long Rest.
quote: The gemstone centrepiece of the amulet was long ago mottled and dyed by the tears of a martyr.
where_to_find: Sold by Derryth Bonecloak in the Underdark
special:
Healing Word (Bonus Action)
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
Mass Healing Word (Bonus Action)
Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Amulet of Selûne's Chosen
image: Amulet Necklace E Pearl A 1 Faded.png
controller_icon: Amulet Necklace E Pearl A 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Amulet Necklace E Pearl A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Amulet of Selûne's Chosen is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to cast Selûne's Dream once per Long Rest.
quote: The gems and pearls of this necklace have a brilliant shine to them, as if reflecting unseen moonlight.
where_to_find: In Dror Ragzlin's treasure pile
special:
Selûne's Dream (Action)
An ally you touch regains 1d8 Hit Points, but possibly falls asleep. ( Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Amulet of Silvanus
image: Amulet Necklace D Bronze A 1 Faded.png
controller_icon: Amulet Necklace D Bronze A 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Amulet Necklace D Bronze A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Amulet of Silvanus is an uncommon Amulet. It allows the wearer to cast Lesser Restoration once per Short Rest.
quote: This amulet, engraved with a small waterfall, imparts a feeling of calm serenity when worn.
where_to_find: Near Ormn the bear, hidden under a flat rock which must be moved
special:
Lesser Restoration (Action)
Cast as a level 2 spell ( Recharge: Short rest.)

name: Amulet of Windrider
controller_icon: Amulet Necklace D Gold A 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Amulet Necklace D Gold A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Amulet of Windrider is a very rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast Ride the Winds and Gust of Wind. It is one of the rewards of the quest Save Vanra.
quote: Heavily embossed with filigree, this necklace reflects light in all directions.
where_to_find: Reward by Lora Bergauz for saving her daughter during the quest Save Vanra
special:
Ride the Winds (Action)
Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
Gust of Wind (Action)
Cast as a level 2 spell ( Recharge: Short rest.)
notes:
• The amulet also can be pickpocketed from Lora, or looted from her corpse if the party sided with Auntie Ethel.
• Lora does not reward the party with the Amulet of Windrider if the quest Save Vanra is not picked up prior to freeing Vanra from the Hag's Lair; she must first be spoken with at the Basilisk Gate Barracks to receive this item.

name: Amulet of the Absolute
description: Amulet of the Absolute is a common Amulet with no enchantments.
quote: These grisly trinkets started popping up with the rise of the Cult of the Absolute. While the skull and triangle are made from cheap pewter, rumours suggest the red handprint is made exclusively with blood from ritual sacrifice.
where_to_find: On the dismembered remains of a Zealot of the Absolute in a room beneath Yurgir's bedroom

name: Amulet of the Devout
icon: Amulet of the devout Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Amulet of the Devout is a very rare Amulet. It grants the wearer a +2 bonus to Spell Save DC and, if the wearer has access to it, an additional Channel Divinity Charge.
quote: Otto, a member of the powerful arcane organisation the Circle of Eight, had a penchant for amulets. So much so that they announced his arrival before he ever needed to.
where_to_find: in the main Offering Chest in the basement
notes: • Unless obtained by Jaheira while wearing Khalid's Gift, normal looting any of the items from the offering chests curses the interacting party member with Castigated By Divinity.

name: Amulet of the Drunkard
image: Amulet Necklace A Silver A 1 Faded.png
controller_icon: Amulet Necklace A Silver A 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Amulet Necklace A Silver A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Amulet of the Drunkard is a rare amulet. It increases the duration of Drunk to 5 turns and causes the wearer to regain 2d4 hit points once, during the first turn of Drunk that occurs with this item equipped.
quote: Donning this necklace causes the room to sway and tip - or maybe it was already swaying? Whatever, time for another pint.
where_to_find: Sold by Hoots Hooligan
notes: • The party must agree to taste Hoots Hooligan's new brew before she makes this item available for sale.

name: Amulet of the Harpers
image: Amulet Necklace F Silver A 1 Faded.png
controller_icon: Amulet Necklace F Silver A 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Amulet Necklace F Silver A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Amulet of the Harpers is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast Shield once per Long Rest and grants Advantage with Wisdom Saving Throws.
quote: Nobility can be found in suffering the slings and arrows of outrageous fortune. So can dying. Best to be on guard.
where_to_find: Sold by Quartermaster Talli near the Last Light Inn waypoint
special:
• Advantage with Wisdom Saving Throws.
Shield (Reaction)
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
bugs: • The in-game description for this item ("advantage on wisdom saving throws checks") is likely a typo; it provides advantage on saving throws, not checks.

name: Amulet of the Unworthy
icon: Keepsake Locket A Glowing Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Amulet of the Unworthy is an uncommon Amulet that protects the wearer from Slashing damage, but leaves them vulnerable to Bludgeoning damage.
quote: Once part of the Girdle of Blades, this buckle was torn off and fashioned into an amulet that can be worn by creatures of all sizes.
where_to_find: Carried by a Minotaur wandering around
special:
• Resistance to Slashing damage
• Vulnerability to Bludgeoning damage

name: Anarchic Blue Outfit
description: Anarchic Blue Outfit is an article of common Camp Clothing.
quote: There is something of the blue-blooded rebel in this outfit, of the bandit princess or prince stealing blunder and hearts.
where_to_find: Sold by Figaro Pennygood

name: Anarchic Green Outfit
icon: Camp Rich D Green Unfaded Icon.png
description: Anarchic Green Outfit is an article of common Camp Clothing.
quote: There is something of the green-grinning rebel in this outfit, of the bandit princess or prince stealing plunder and hearts.
where_to_find: In the clothing chest in the epilogue

name: Anarchic Purple Outfit
icon: Camp Rich D Purple Unfaded Icon.png
description: Anarchic Green Outfit is an article of common Camp Clothing.
quote: There is something of the purple-peacock rebel in this outfit, of the bandit princess or prince stealing plunder and hearts.
where_to_find: Sold by Figaro Pennygood

name: Anarchic White Outfit
description: Anarchic White Outfit is an article of common Camp Clothing.
quote: There is something of the pale-white-toothed rebel in this outfit, of the bandit princess or prince stealing plunder and hearts.

name: Angelic Plume Helmet
controller_icon: Item ARM Helmet Leather E Unfaded.png
icon: Item ARM Helmet Leather E Icon.png
description: An Angelic Plume Helmet is a common Helmet.
quote: Fanned out in two angelic-broad wings.
where_to_find: On a shelf in the Infiltration Training room
special: • Dexterity Saving Throws +1

name: Angelic Scion Outfit
description: Angelic Scion Outfit is a set of common Camp Clothing.
quote: Golden vambraces and arm rings surmount this divine set
where_to_find: Sold by Figaro 'Facemaker' Pennygood, at the Facemaker's Boutique, in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate, close to the Baldur's Gate waypoint

name: Appreciably-Cared-For Boots
description: Appreciably-Cared-For Boots are a common pair of Boots.
quote: These boots are well-maintained and clean, though their soles are thin from wear.
where_to_find: On a table / shelf in the Morgue

name: Arcane Absorption Dagger
quote:
The leather grip of this knife is decorated with jugs. As you turn it, you can see that the jug begins empty and fills.
It's only when you reach the final image that you can see a man's severed head over the jug, filling it with beads of blood.
notes: • This item appears in an unused treasure table intended for Araj Oblodra in Moonrise Towers: MOO_InfernalTrader_SpecialStock .

name: Arduous Flame Blade
quote: The extent of cultural idolatry amongst members of the Flaming Fist is anyone's guess, but fascination with fire is plain and unambiguously obsessive.

name: Argument Solver
description: Argument Solver is an uncommon +1 Greatclub that grants the wielder the Poison Mist weapon action, which deals extra Poison damage and creates a poison cloud.
quote: Few things solve a disagreement faster than displaying a greatclub. And this one reeks, too.

name: Armour of Agility
description: The Armour of Agility is a very rare Medium Armour that doesn't limit your AC's Dexterity bonus, and boosts all of the user's Saving Throws by 2.
quote: Layered sheets of smelted, shaped, and smithed steel have been etched with a sweetly luminous gold. Its outward appearance is heavy. And yet it's so light when you lift it, like lifting a bag of shrunken dead leaves.
where_to_find: Sold by Gloomy Fentonson, near the Lower City Central Wall waypoint
special: • Saving Throws +2.

name: Armour of Devotion
description: Armour of Devotion is a set of rare Full Plate Heavy Armour that allows the wearer to cast Eternal Devotion, restoring a charge of their Paladin Channel Oath ability.
quote: The soft hum of a fervent prayer reverberates throughout the armoured plates.
where_to_find: Sold by Roah Moonglow on the main floor
special:
Eternal Devotion (Action)
Recite your Oath to regain 1 Channel Oath Charge. ( Recharge: Long rest.)
bugs: • Despite being a variant of Plate Armour +1, the world item model for the Armour of Devotion is similar in appearance to the Nightsong's Armour worn by Dame Aylin. This is due to an unused paladin armour type being set as the VisualTemplate instead of the plate armour type.

name: Armour of Landfall
description: Armour of Landfall is a very rare light armour which improves the spellcasting ability of its wearer and grants Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws. The wearer also heals while standing in vines and can cast Plant Growth.
quote: Smelling of long-abandoned gardens grown wild with thorny roses, moss and hibiscus, this armour was worn by a powerful druid who spent so long from people that she forgot to miss them.
where_to_find: Sold by Lorroakan's Projection or Rolan on the ground floor
special:
• Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws.
Plant Growth (Action)

name: Astarions's Underwear
description: Astarions's Underwear is common Underwear.
quote: Embroidered into the cloth: 'If you're reading this, you managed to bed or behead me. Either way, you got lucky.'
where_to_find: Astarion's starting underwear
notes: • Underwear cannot be looted regularly. A party member must pick up the corpse to loot the underwear.

name: Auntie Ethel's Hair
description: Auntie Ethel's Hair is a common item that can be used to permanently increase a character's Ability Score by 1. The player character must choose which ability score the hair increases when receiving it.
quote: Two lice still scurry around on the little flap of skin attached to this clump of matted, crusty hair.
effect: Consuming this piece of fey flesh grants a permanent +1 bonus to an Ability Score of your choice.
notes:
• During the fight against Auntie Ethel in the Overgrown Tunnel, if she is reduced below 20% of her maximum HP and has a turn to act, she begs for her life and implores the party to let her keep Mayrina and her unborn child, offering the player character power in return. If the interacting party member passes a DC 20 Deception or Intimidation Check against Auntie Ethel, it is possible to both free Mayrina and get this item, at the cost of letting Auntie Ethel go. Fighters and Barbarians instead get a DC 15 Intimidation Check, with Advantage, in place of the standard Intimidation check to obtain her hair and also save Mayrina. Failing one check makes the other unavailable, leaving only the options to take the deal, free Mayrina, or kill Auntie Ethel. The hag:
• Cannot offer this bargain if she is Silenced
• Cannot bargain for Mayrina if she is Knocked Out
• Does not bargain for Mayrina if she is fought at the Riverside Teahouse, even if her Hit Points are lowered below 20% before she teleports Mayrina to the Overgrown Tunnel
• The increase to an ability score is uncapped, but takes effect before other items and bonuses which raise abilities to a capped amount. The hair has no effect on abilities set to a fixed number through equipment or consumables, such as the Gloves of Dexterity or an Elixir of Hill Giant Strength.
• Paladins who take any deal break their Oath.
• The passive "Auntie Ethel's Boon" appears in the character's Notable Features section after consuming it.
• It is possible to obtain Auntie Ethel's Hair, free Mayrina, and also kill Auntie Ethel:
• Leave one party member hidden and out of combat, while the rest of the party whittle Auntie Ethel's Hit Points down to a range where the next hit will kill her.
• When the dialogue is triggered, succeed an Intimidation or Deception check to make her both give the hair and free Mayrina, but do not end the dialogue.
• Switch to the out-of-combat party member. They can see the quest reward window, where the version (ability score) of the hair can be chosen.
• Confirm the quest reward window, then finish off Auntie Ethel while she is still in dialogue with another party member.
• This method does not work in a multiplayer game.
• It is recommended to get her Hit Points down as low as possible because there is only one chance to attack her; otherwise, the out-of-combat character is dragged into the dialogue, and the hag can escape.
• This method does not leave a corpse to be looted.
• Prior to patch 7, a unique interaction could happen if playing in Honour mode when the player character was making their dialogue skill check. If any spell was used for the check, like Guidance, Auntie Ethel would trigger her legendary action, Weird Magic Surge, which would create an illusory duplicate. This action would throw the talking party member out of the dialogue and into combat once more. Even if the skill check was successful, no reward would be given, and the dialogue would not trigger again. Other non-spell effects, however, such as Bardic Inspiration, would still work on this check.

name: Azer Warhammer
description: Hits with this weapon deal an additional 1d6 Fire damage.
quote: Flecks of volcanic glass gleam darkly from the head of this warhammer - obsidian eyes regarding the world with the narrow, spite-inflamed convictions of its azer wielder.
bugs: • Although intended to be inaccessible to players, this weapon can be obtained by summoning an Azer with Conjure Minor Elemental: Azer, getting the Azer arrested, and then taking the confiscated weapon from the equipment chest in jail.

name: BOOOAL's Arms
quote: The cut-off pincer of some Underdark crustacean seems to magically adhere to a bone shaft, creating a make-shift javelin.

name: Backless Extravaganza
description: Backless Extravaganza is an article of common Camp Clothing.
quote: Backless so that people can pat you on the back and proclaim, 'I say, lovely outfit.'
where_to_find: Sold by Figaro Pennygood at the Facemaker's Boutique in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate, close to the Baldur's Gate waypoint

name: Balduran's Giantslayer
description: Balduran's Giantslayer is a legendary +3 Greatsword that receives doubled damage bonus from Strength, grants its wielder the Giant Form class action and the Topple the Big Folk weapon action, as well as Advantage on attack rolls against Large, Huge, and Gargantuan creatures.
quote: Wielded by Balduran, the founder of Baldur's Gate and friend to his guardian dragon, a great glittering wyrm called Ansur. Fellowship can be undone, though, as easily as you or I might unlace the strings of our shoes, and it was in a time of skullduggery and hardship that Balduran killed Ansur, carrying out the deed with this sword.
special:
Giant Form (Action)
Grow to a fearsome size. Your weapons deal an additional 1d6 damage and you gain 27 temporary hit points and Advantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
notes:
• It is possible to grow two size categories larger than normal by combining this weapon's Giant Form with Elixir of the Colossus. However, Giant Form does not stack with the spell Enlarge, or other effects sharing the Stack ID SIZE; see Creature Size for more details.
• Interacting with Ansur's corpse ordinarily triggers a cut-scene that initiates combat with him. By looting his corpse while already in combat with another hostile creature, this weapon can be retrieved without awakening Ansur.
• When viewed in game, the red nodules on this sword pulsate bright red as if it were were alive.

name: Band of the Mystic Scoundrel
icon: Ring E Gold A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Band of the Mystic Scoundrel is a rare Ring that grants the wearer the ability to cast illusion or enchantment spells as a bonus action after hitting a creature with a weapon attack.
quote: What better way to disguise one's transgressions than a quickly positioned phantasm after the deed is done?
where_to_find: In a backpack

name: Bandit's Armour
description: Bandit's Armour is a common Light Armour, and can only be obtained under specific circumstances.
quote: This lightweight armour appears to have been quickly produced, skipped stitches and fraying edges betraying the inattention of its maker.
where_to_find: Worn by Shadowheart in the Emerald Grove
notes:
• Shadowheart has this armour equipped if all of the following conditions are met:
• She was recruited on the Nautiloid.
• She has no armour equipped and no armour in her inventory at the end of the Prologue.
• She was not recruited again on the Ravaged Beach.
• Prior to Patch 7, she also had this armour equipped on the Ravaged Beach if the first two conditions were met.
• This armour has the same appearance as regular Leather Armour when equipped.

variants.description: Barbarian Clothes are a common piece of Clothing unique to Karlach
variants.quote: A rough combination of furs, leathers, and supple fabrics, made for a life outside civilisation.
variants.where_to_find: Worn by Karlach

name: Basket Shoe

• The party is awarded 35 experience when this item picked up.

name: Battle-Worn Blade

name: Battleaxe

name: Battleaxe +1
quote: The intricate engravings on this axe's blade and handle make plain the skill of its smith.

name: Beastmaster's Chain
image: Amulet Necklace D Bronze A 1 Faded.png
controller_icon: Amulet Necklace D Bronze A 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Amulet Necklace D Bronze A 1 Unfaded Icon.png

where_to_find: In a chest next to the table with meat

Animal Friendship (Action)
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Belm
description: Belm is a very rare +2 Scimitar. It grants the Whirlwind Attack and Perfectly Balanced Strike weapon actions.
quote: Faded but still legible, the mark of a [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Kara-Tur Kara-Turan] forgemaster adorns the pommel of this exquisite sword. Light as a robin's wing, quick as a gnomish wit, this weapon has unseamed many foes - and will continue to, in the correct hands.
notes:
• The chest containing this weapon is in a room behind a locked ( DC 18 Sleight of Hand Check) bookcase.
• This weapon was originally found in Baldur's Gate 2, and is considered one of the best weapons in that game, as it allows the wielder to make one more attack with the weapon held in the main-hand per round.

notes_links.page: List of references to previous Baldur's Gate games

bugs: • This armour is missing sleeves when worn by male dwarves.
notes:
• The player character can only purchase the Bhaalist Armour from the Echo of Abazigal if they accept becoming an Unholy Assassin of Bhaal by completing Impress the Murder Tribunal. However, it can also be acquired through an exploit – see notes on the Echo of Abazigal page for details.

name: Bhaalist Gloves

Attack Rolls +1

• Strength Saving Throws +1
• Attack rolls +1

where_to_find: Worn by the death knight That Which Lurks

where_to_find: In the armoury below Oskar's painting studio in Lady Jannath's Estate

name: Blazer of Benevolence

quote: Even though the embroidered velvet won't help against a sharp blade, wearing it fills you with self-assuredness.
where_to_find: Reward for rescuing Volo from the Goblin Camp during the quest Rescue Volo

name: Blightbringer
description: Blightbringer is a very rare +1 Shortbow that grants bonuses to attack and damage rolls against Gnomes and Dwarves, and Slows on a critical hit.
quote: Conducting a series of increasingly sick rituals - involving the ashes of a gnome and silkworms fed fat on the corpse of a dwarven cleric - the goblin shaman Kirruk Redrats created this deadly bow.

quote: This weapon was wielded by the lionlike eldritch knight Cypress of the Starfeller clan, who took on challenges of the heart and mind with palpable brilliance, and fought with a skill and heated intensity that was almost solar.
special: • This blade's magical powers only function if it is bound to an Eldritch Knight or is a Warlock's Pact Weapon.
bugs: • If this weapon is bound by an Eldritch Knight or Pact of the Blade Warlock, the weapon will retain its Favoured Weapon passive until the next long rest, as well as the bonus damage from Synchronicity, even if the character binds another weapon. The weapon will even retain this passive if the weapon is used by another character, different from the one who bound it.
notes: • This weapon gains the condition Arcanely Honed if it's the target of Weapon Bond or Bind Pact Weapon.

name: Blooded Greataxe

quote: Stained brown and reeking of iron, this greataxe once belonged to a killer so deranged, his name was magically scrubbed from all histories.

name: Bloodguzzler Garb

quote: No sooner does blood speck the armour than it's absorbed, as if sustaining something within.
where_to_find: in the Bulette
bugs: • Switching from camp clothing to default view briefly (about 4 frames) shows the character from the waist up with no clothing.

name: Bloodthirst

special:
True Strike (Bonus Action)
Cast as a cantrip ( Recharge: Short rest.)

• Armour Class +1 (Off-Hand Only)
notes: • After looting Netherstone-Pommelled Bloodthirst from Orin's remains, the game automatically separates it into two new items in the interacting party member's inventory: Orin's Netherstone and Bloodthirst.

description: Bloody Amulet is an Amulet and a Story Item.

where_to_find:
The Bloody Amulet can be obtained from Barcus Wroot, who can be met in several different locations:
• Tied to the windmill in Blighted Village X: 0 Y: 425
• In Grymforge, if been freed from the windmill

• In Last Light, if he survives into Act 2
notes:

quote: The saw's teeth are blunt and rusted, it's beautiful metalwork barely visible beneath a layer of black, coagulated blood.
bugs: • When wielded by any nurse this weapon deals an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage. A coding error causes a misplaced '1d6' to appear in the weapon's list of properties.
notes: • This weapon is stored with scimitars in the game's files and the enchanted version has scimitar weapon actions, it also still uses the one-handed weapon animations when wielded as a two-handed weapon, implying it may have been intended to be a scimitar.

name: Bonesaw
description: Bonesaw is an uncommon +1 Longsword which grants non player characters the weapon action Incise Ligaments.
quote: The saw's teeth are blunt and rusted, it's beautiful metalwork barely visible beneath a layer of black, coagulated blood.
bugs: None of the weapon actions provided by this weapon are available to the player character, if equipped.
notes:
• Collecting one of each of the nurses' tools grants the inspiration Right Tool for the Job to party members with the Criminal background.
• When wielded by any nurse, this weapon deals an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage.

name: Bonespike Boots
description: Bonespike Boots are a Very rare pair of Boots that enhances jump distance and gives the character access to the Brutal Leap ability.
quote: Armour designed for the aerodynamic leaping and striking and general screaming of your standard barbarian.
where_to_find: In wooden chest, in a secluded passageway, at the far end of the western trail leading away from the South Span Checkpoint in Rivington, at X: -1340 Y: -857
special:
Brutal Leap (Bonus Action + Movement Speed)
Leap at a target and possibly knock it Prone. ( Recharge: Per turn.)
notes: • Brutal Leap uses the Spellcasting ability of the wearer to determine the saving throw DC of the target.

name: Bonespike Garb
description: Bonespike Garb is a very rare piece of Clothing that grants temporary hit points when using Rage, and reduces incoming damage by 2. Attackers receive Piercing damage when the wearer is struck.
quote: Sharp juts and knobbly nodules of bone stud this armour, as if something ancient sank its teeth deep into the leather and they got stuck there.
where_to_find: Sold by Exxvikyap in Rivington during Act Three

name: Bonespike Gloves
icon: Gloves Barbarian Magic B Unfaded Icon.png
description: Bonespike Gloves is a pair of very rare gloves. They allow the wearer's attacks to ignore Resistance to Slashing, Piercing, and Bludgeoning damage.
quote: These gloves were soaked in the marrow of a [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Dragon_Turtle Dragon Turtle], its bones broken and their fluid drained in sloppy chunks into vats.
where_to_find: Worn by Strangler Luke during the quest Get Orin's Netherstone
notes: • Strangler Luke despawns once the trial is complete; the party must obtain these gloves before it ends.

name: Bonespike Helmet
description: Bonespike Helmet is a very rare Helmet. If the wearer rages, the helmet forces all hostile creatures within a 3m radius to roll a wisdom saving throw. Those failing this roll take 2-8 Psychic damage; a successful roll halves this.
quote: The tibia of a [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/storm_giant storm giant] was ground and chiselled and reworked till it became this helm. The wearer can actually smell summer tempest clouds like maroon-dark dread while wearing the helm.
where_to_find: Sold by Voiceless Penitent Bareki
special:
• Intimidation +2
Menacing Attack (Melee) (Action)
Possibly Frighten your target. They'll have Disadvantage on ability checks and Attack Rolls and be unable to move. ( Recharge: Per turn.)
notes:
• For the version of Menacing Attack (Melee) granted by this item:
• The DC is determined by the same method as other manoeuvres.
• The bonus damage is not equal to a Superiority Die, as would be the case for a regular Menacing Attack; it is instead equal to the wearer's proficiency bonus.
• Unlike any of the manoeuvres granted by the Battle Master subclass, the Menacing Attack granted by this helmet recharges per turn.
• As with other manoeuvres, it uses a weapon attack roll which qualifies for Extra Attack. This makes it an attractive option for use at the beginning of every combat round for melee combatants with Extra Attack and level 11+ fighters in particular.
• This weapon action is usable even if the wielder is not proficient with their equipped melee weapon.

name: Boots of Aid and Comfort
image: Boots of Aid and Comfort Icon.png
controller_icon: Boots of Aid and Comfort Unfaded.png
icon: Boots of Aid and Comfort Unfaded Icon.png
description: Boots of Aid and Comfort are an uncommon pair of Boots that grant additional Temporary Hit Points to creatures healed by the wearer.
quote: Sturdy and well-worn, these boots make a snug fit on any wearer.
where_to_find: Sold by Grat the Trader

name: Boots of Apparent Death
description: Boots of Apparent Death are a rare set of Boots that grants the wearer the ability to cast Feign Death once per Short Rest.
quote: Practical jokes with these boots often involve all your stuff being stolen by opportunistic cousins.
where_to_find: In a sarcophagus behind the locked grated iron doors
special:
Feign Death (Action + Level 3 Spell Slot)
Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Short rest.)

name: Boots of Arcane Bolstering
icon: Boots of Arcane Bolstering Unfaded Icon.png
description: Boots of Arcane Bolstering is a pair of rare Boots that grants Arcane Charge each time the wearer Dashes, adding +1 bonus to damage with spells while Threatened.
quote: Fizzling barbs of enchantment magic crackle from the laces of these boots.
where_to_find: Sold by Araj Oblodra on the main floor
notes: • Using Dash repeatedly does not increase Arcane Charge above 2 turns.

name: Boots of Brilliance
description: Boots of Brilliance are a rare pair of Boots that allow the wearer to replenish one Bardic Inspiration charge once per long rest.
quote: Tiny bells are sewn into the boots' cuffs. They jingle subtly with every step.
where_to_find: In a heavy chest in the room just north of Yurgir
special:
Restore Bardic Inspiration (Action)
Play your instrument to restore one of your Bardic Inspiration slots. ( Recharge: Long rest.)
notes: • In Early Access, these were dropped by a Mimic in Grymforge. In the final release, that Mimic now drops Wondrous Gloves.

name: Boots of Butt-Kicking
description: Boots of Butt-Kicking is a common pair of Camp Shoes.
quote: These shoes were made for stomping villainy wherever it rears its evil head.
where_to_find: Available only to Minsc in the epilogue

name: Boots of Elemental Momentum
icon: Boots of Elemental Momentum Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Boots of Elemental Momentum are an uncommon pair of Boots that grant Momentum whenever the wearer deals elemental damage with a spell or cantrip.
quote: Toughened metal boots, highly insulated with heavy leather and padding for use in any and all elements.
where_to_find: Sold by Lady Esther, north-east of the Trielta Crags waypoint
special: • Athletics +1

name: Boots of Genial Striding
icon: Boots of Genial Striding Unfaded Icon.png
description: Boots of Genial Striding is a pair of rare Boots that allow the wearer to move over difficult terrain without impediment.
quote: The soles of these boots warp and shift like warm clay manipulated by an unseen sculptor's hands.
where_to_find: Sold by Blurg

name: Boots of Persistence
description: Boots of Persistence is a pair of Boots that grant their wearer permanent Freedom of Movement and Longstrider effects.
quote: 'If I had a copper for all the adventurin folk I seen gutted or cut up, or clawed like they was made of wet paper, just cause they couldn't move quick enough when speed might have saved em... well, I'd be suckin good brandy from crystal rather than this fuckin swill.' - Overheard in a tavern in Baldur's Gate.
where_to_find: Sold by Dammon in the Lower City
special: • Dexterity Saving Throws +1
bugs: • Only body type 2 humanoids ('slim male') use a 3D model matching the icon when worn. Other body types use the 3D model of The Speedy Lightfeet instead.

name: Boots of Psionic Movement
image: Boots Metal Githyanki B Magic Faded.png
controller_icon: Boots Metal Githyanki B Magic Unfaded.png
icon: Boots Metal Githyanki B Magic Unfaded Icon.png
description: Boots of Psionic Movement are a very rare pair of Boots that allow Githyanki wearers to fly, and enhances their attacks with Psychic damage.
quote: When not atop their dragons, gith are not particularly air-worthy. This is probably for the best. The imposition of downward gravity tends to put most people in a mood.
where_to_find: Worn by Ch'r'ai Har'rak
special:
• Dexterity Saving Throws +1
Githborn: Flying Boots (Bonus Action)
Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Boots of Speed
description: The Boots of Speed is a pair of rare Boots that allows the wearer to click their heels for a burst of speed that makes it difficult for enemies to land Attacks of Opportunity on them.
quote: Featherlaced and flexible of sole, these boots have been used to round up - and outrun - many a foe.
where_to_find: Worn by Thulla
special:
Click Heels (Bonus Action)
Click the heels of your boots to gain speed and freedom of movement.
bugs: • Due to a scripting error, the Disadvantage component of Click Heels actually applies to the Reaction attacks performed by the caster, rather than reaction attacks targeting the caster.
notes:
• Thulla gives the boots the party as thanks for curing her of the duergar poison in Cure the Poisoned Gnome. If they are given to Sergeant Thrinn to complete the quest Find the Missing Boots, they can be looted from her to get them back.
• Stealing the boots off of Thulla grants the inspiration Swiftly Stolen for party members with the Criminal background.

name: Boots of Stormy Clamour
icon: Boots of Stormy Clamour Unfaded Icon.png
description: Boots of Stormy Clamour are an uncommon pair of Boots that inflict the Reverberation condition on a creature when afflicting it with another condition.
quote: Peals of thunder rumble at the back of your skull with every step taken in these boots.
where_to_find: Sold by Omeluum after completing the quest Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite

name: Boots of Striding
description: The Boots of Striding are an uncommon pair of Boots that grants the wearer a burst of speed whenever they begin concentrating on a spell.
quote: The metal of these greaves is comfortably warm against your shins, as though heated by your mere presence.
where_to_find: Worn by Minthara
special: • Athletics +1
bugs: • The Unmovable condition can be indefinitely applied by equipping the boots, casting a concentration spell, unequipping the boots, and then breaking concentration. The check to remove Unmovable is attached to the boots, and thus if they are not equipped when concentration ends, the effect will persist.

name: Boots of Uninhibited Kushigo
icon: Boots of Uninhibited Kushigo Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Boots of Uninhibited Kushigo are a rare pair of Boots that add the wearer's Wisdom modifier to their Unarmed Strike damage.
quote:
During a hilltop battle that soaked the slopes in gore, Kushigo's best friend Irishi was scalped before he could help her.
The enemy held up the bloody wig, and Kushigo fell upon one, and then another, until he had killed so many that they hung from his antlered shoulders like skewered effigies.
where_to_find: Carried by Prelate Lir'i'c, as entering Act Three

name: Boots of Very Fast Blinking
description: Boots of Very Fast Blinking are an uncommon pair of Boots that grant the wearer the ability to cast Misty Step once per turn, but with the drawback that their clothes are left behind.
quote: You can cast Misty Step, with the caveat that you will teleport leaving your clothes behind.
where_to_find: Given as a consolation prize by Akabi after failing to win the jackpot at the Wheel of Fortune
special:
Disrobing Blinkstep (Bonus Action)
You teleport to an unoccupied space you can see. However, your clothes do not teleport with you. ( Recharge: Per turn.)

name: Bow of Awareness
description: Bow of Awareness is an uncommon +1 Shortbow that boosts the wielder's Initiative.
quote: This halfling bow requires a full draw for smaller folk, but serves as a quick off-hand for those of greater height.

name: Bow of the Banshee
description: Bow of the Banshee is a rare +1 shortbow which can frighten targets on hit and grants bonuses to weapon damage and attack rolls against Frightened creatures.
quote: The impression of an elven face screams silently from the finely curved bow - the image becomes even more disturbing when the bowstring snaps forward on release, emitting a blood-curdling wail.
bugs: • Pushing Greymon off the party's raft via the Athletics dialogue option during the initial cutscene results in his loot being permanently lost, as his body does not wash ashore. To guarantee this item and the rest of his gear is recoverable, it is recommended to initiate combat and shove him into the water manually during the ship-to-ship battle.
notes:
• If he is not shoved off the party's raft, Greymon sells this item at his trader spot in the Duergar encampment. If he drowns after turning hostile on the raft, his body washes up on the beach near the southern pier at the Decrepit Village, from which this weapon can be looted.
• The [https://baldursgate.fandom.com/wiki/Bow_of_the_Banshee Bow of the Banshee] is also found in [https://baldursgate.fandom.com/wiki/Baldur%27s_Gate:_Siege_of_Dragonspear Baldur's Gate: Siege of Dragonspear]. The description of the items are similar; they can both inflict a fear effect and deal extra damage to targets under that effect.

name: Bracers of Defence
description: Bracers of Defence are a rare pair of Gloves which increase the wearer's Armour Class by 2 when unarmoured and not holding a shield.
quote: Delicate twists of magical iron - painstakingly gilded - have been fashioned into these fortifying vambraces.
where_to_find: In a gilded chest in the secret cellar area of the Apothecary, beneath the Blighted Village

name: Bracing Band
icon: Ring E Silver A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Bracing Band is an uncommon Ring which makes the wearer more difficult to hit after they shove an enemy.
quote: A common ring, simple and unadorned. Though there is a certain heft to it...
where_to_find: Rewarded by Sergeant Thrinn after returning her boots in the quest Find the Missing Boots
notes: • This is one of two possible rewards for Find the Missing Boots, the other being Armour of Uninhibited Kushigo.

name: Braindrain Cape
description: Braindrain Cape is a rare Cloak that exhausts attackers with mental fatigue.
quote:
What was life like before the mind flayers snatched you up? Road dust clots your boots, campfires roar up and diminish, faces swim by.
More and more that life distances itself like some other world. A dream world maybe, glimpsed now and again through a gauze.
notes: • This item appears in an unused treasure table intended for Araj Oblodra in Moonrise Towers: InfernalTrader_SpecialStock .

name: Braindrain Gloves
description: Braindrain Gloves are an uncommon pair of Gloves that inflicts Mental Fatigue on a foe whenever the wearer deals Psychic damage to them.
quote: Somewhere deep in the spongy grey matter and little jiggly bits that comprise the brain, the memory of the slimy tadpole slithering over your eyeball lingers...
where_to_find: On a skeleton in the Necrotic Laboratory, next to the Blade of Oppressed Souls

name: Brass Locket
description: Brass Locket is an Amulet and a Story Item.
quote: Instead of a picture, a folded piece of paper is trapped inside. It reads, 'To Barth, You can do more than you realise. Love always, Mum'.
where_to_find: In a chest inside the Tiefling Hideout in the Druid Grove
notes:
• This item can also be looted from the corpse of Barth if he dies outside the grove.
• It features in Return the Locket; after the quest is finished its only nominal value is for trading.

name: Tarnished Locket
description: Brass Locket is a common Amulet without any enchantments.
quote: Slightly tarnished, and opened with a mere flick of the thumb.
where_to_find: in the ashes of the fireplace on the ground floor

name: Breaching Pikestaff
description: Breaching Pikestaff is a rare +2 Pike that deals an additional 1d4 Force on each successful hit.
quote: Concussive energy thumps like a mighty heartbeat from this pike.

name: Breastplate
description: Breastplate is a common Medium Armour.
quote: This standard-sized breastplate is lined with thick padding meant to cushion the wearer and deflect blows from assailants. The uniform squares of the padding suggest a mathematically-mind crafter.
where_to_find: Sold by A'jak'nir Jeera

name: Breastplate +1
description: Breastplate +1 is an uncommon Medium Armour that reduces Piercing damage.
quote: This breastplate is crafted in the specialty style of a mysterious armourer in Amn known only as 'The Tailor.'
where_to_find: On crate near Dammon in the The Hollow

name: Breastplate +2
description: Breastplate +2 is a rare Medium Armour that reduces Piercing damage and grants a +1 bonus to Dexterity Saving Throws and Ability Checks.
quote: This garment's previous owner left a few minor personal effects in its inner breast pocket: a scrap of sassafrass, a short bit of thread, and half a peppermint.
where_to_find: Sold by traders using the levelled magic armour table if the player is level 9 or above

name: Breezy Sandals
description: Breezy Sandals is a common pair of Camp Shoes.
quote: Strapped and lined in an either piscine or arboteal motif, these sandals are perfect for a warm morning stroll.
where_to_find: Set-dressing and random loot throughout the game

name: Brewing Ladle
quote: A skillful smith decorated the wooden handle with a fine golden filigree.
notes:
• The UUID of this weapon is a light hammer that can be used by player characters, but can not be found in game. The stats entry, as called by Thisobald Thorm's equipment entry, modifies it into a mace, modifies its range to 2.2 m (7 ft), removes the enchantment, and makes it exclusively wieldable by Thisobald. Both versions use the same model:
• Template Generated
• Wielded by Thisobald

name: Bright Flare Leather Outfit
description: Bright Flare Leather Outfit is a set of common Camp Clothing.
quote: A minimalist leather binding get-up that clings to the skin and creaks just the slightest bit when you move.
where_to_find:
Randomly sold by traders in Act Three:
• Carmen Pennygood at Carm's Garms in Wyrm's Crossing
• Figaro Pennygood at Facemaker's Boutique in the Lower City
• Randomly generated in wardrobes within Sharess' Caress and safes in The Counting House

name: Brimmed Hat
description: Brimmed Hat is a common Non-Armour Headwear.
quote: This wizardly hat has a little embroidered rabbit inside its lining - the rabbit is called snowball, and once he was lost, never to be found.
where_to_find: Found as random loot throughout the game.

name: Briskwind Boots
description: The Briskwind Boots is a rare pair of Boots that allows the wearer to regain all movement speed upon landing a critical hit or killing a hostile creature.
quote: The wind seems to lap encouragingly at the heels of these boots, no matter which direction they take.

name: Brocade Booties
description: Brocade Booties is a common pair of Camp Shoes.

where_to_find: Available only in the epilogue

name: Brocade Ensemble
description: Brocade Ensemble is a common Camp Clothing.

where_to_find: Available in the epilogue

name: Broken Club
quote: The tip of this club has snapped off, its wood rotten to the core.

name: Broken Padded Armour

quote: A standard gambeson of quilted cloth. Good for catching blows, but almost unbearably sweaty.
where_to_find: On a shelf in the basement

name: Broken Pike
quote: The pike's tip is battered and bent, fit for neither soldier nor scoundrel.

name: Broken Shield
description: The Broken Shield is a common Shield that is severly damaged, providing less AC than regular shields.
quote: This old splintered shield is no stronger than a child's toy.
where_to_find: In areas where old battles have occurred, such as in the Gauntlet of Shar and the Shadowfell

where_to_find: In chests and carried by characters throughout the game

name: Broodmother's Revenge
image: Amulet Necklace F Bronze A 1 Faded.png
controller_icon: Amulet Necklace F Bronze A 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Amulet Necklace F Bronze A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Broodmother's Revenge is an uncommon Amulet. It coats the wearer's weapon in poison for 3 turns whenever they are healed.
quote: Each of this amulet's jewels shines like a viper's eyes.
where_to_find: Carried by Kagha in the Emerald Grove
notes:
• This item synergizes well with the Derivation Cloak and Poisoner's Gloves, especially when used by characters with high attack modifiers or multiple attacks per round.
• It is possible to obtain this item while keeping Kagha alive and friendly within the grove. During the confrontation with Kagha for the quest Investigate Kagha, she must be convinced to side with the party. After celebrating with the tieflings in camp after defeating the goblin leaders, Kagha will be standing alone, along the pathway entering the grove. Attacking her and knocking her out with Toggle Non-Lethal Attacks makes her lootable yet keeps her alive. Following a long rest, Kagha will be awake again and upset, but non-hostile. Trading with her via bartering can bring her relationship with the party back into good standing.

name: Browbeaten Circlet
description: Browbeaten Circlet is an uncommon piece of Headwear that grants the wearer a bonus to spell save DC while being threatened.
quote: A cornered animal will, on occasion, feel a rush of exhilarating energy, and an urge to fight. The same is true of many arcane practitioners, who do not take kindly to being menaced.
where_to_find: in the evidence chest on the top floor of the Warden's tower

name: Burnished Necklace

where_to_find:
Aboard the Nautiloid in the Prologue X: 5 Y: -363

image: Ring A Gem A Gold 1 Faded.png

quote: A paralysing eyestalk harvested from a beholder was boiled in a broth, and poured down the throat of a dwarven ringsmith. Not one fortnight thence, he crafted this ring.
where_to_find: Carried by Spectator in Hope's prison

Paralyzing Ray (Action)
Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)

controller_icon: Generated ARM Hat Wizard C Icon.png

where_to_find: Can be found on a table behind Gloomy Fentonson in Baldur's Gate.

name: Cacophony
description: Cacophony is a rare +1 Quarterstaff that grants the wielder the Thunderous Smite spell.
quote: Carved in circles across the knob of the staff are different words for thunder. Gnomish, Sylvan, Elvish, Celestial, even the Primordial tongue - all of these and more fuse together to form the thunderword.
special:
Thunderous Smite (Action + Bonus Action)
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Short rest.)
notes: • The flavour text on this weapon is a reference to the novel Finnegans Wake.

name: Caitiff Staff
quote: The texture of magic granted by a warlock's patron is largely dependent upon the patron themselves - for example, your standard eldritch patron's probably going to work some eyeball-mottled tentacles in there somewhere.
special:
Caitiff's Restoration (Action)
Replenish 1 expended Warlock spell slots. ( Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Callous Glow Ring
icon: Ring E Gold A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Callous Glow Ring is an uncommon Ring that deals an additional 2 Radiant damage whenever the wearer deals damage to illuminated creatures.
quote: A grudging gleam emits from this ring - more an indictment of light than an endorsement.
where_to_find: in an opulent chest in the vault room near Balthazar
notes: • This ring has synergy with the Coruscation Ring, which applies Radiating Orb to targets when they take damage from a spell. This means that each damaging spell applies Radiating Orb to a target, which in turn becomes illuminated – and thus takes an additional 2 Radiant damage.

name: Cap and Bells
description: Cap and Bells is a common Non-Armour Headwear.
quote: Tinkling, ringing, jangling, and about as festive as a terminal diagnosis.
where_to_find: In a chest inside a blue tent opposite of the clown stage.

name: Cap of Curing
description: The Cap of Curing is an uncommon Hat that heals those inspired by the wearer using Bardic Inspiration.
quote: Putting on this hat is somehow enough to lift your spirits.
where_to_find: In a locked gilded chest behind a pillar near to where Alfira is composing her song in the Emerald Grove

name: Cap of Wrath
description: The Cap of Wrath is a rare Helmet that grants the wearer Wrath when they start the turn with 50% Hit Points or less.
quote: With every blow the skullcap seems to compress, narrowing the vision of the wearer.
where_to_find: Carried by Thudd

name: Cape of the Red Prince
image: Cape of the Red Prince Icon.png

icon: Cape of the Red Prince Unfaded Icon.png

where_to_find: In the Peculiar Clothing Chest in the Traveller's Chest at the Campsite
notes:
• Cape of the Red Prince is a reference to Divinity: Original Sin II. It matches the iconic garb of the Lizard origin character, The Red Prince.

where_to_find:
Inside Safe nº7 at the Counting House in the Lower City
• Sold by Figaro Pennygood at the Facemaker's Boutique in the Lower City

name: Cemetery-Blue Torch
description: The Cemetery-Blue Torch can be used as a Light Source or as an improvised club. It can be wielded as a simple melee weapon in one hand. It is a light weapon that anyone can dual wield without special training. It can ignite flammable surfaces or clouds if it makes contact.
quote: A deep oily smell wafts from this crude tree branch.
notes:
• When equipped, the Cemetery-Blue Torch is automatically lit and it deals an additional 1d4 Fire damage and gains the Burning condition until extinguished.
• As the name would imply, this torch burns with a blue flame when lit.

name: Cerebral Citadel Armour
description: Cerebral Citadel Armour is a rare Heavy Armour. If the wearer is infested by a mind flayer tadpole, it grants them immunity to being Frightened and gives a +1 bonus to all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.
quote: The little tentacle engravings are a nice touch.
where_to_find: in a wardrobe during the quest Visit the Emperor's Old Hideout

name: Cerebral Citadel Gloves
description: The Cerebral Citadel Gloves are rare gloves that provide a bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws when the wearer Charms or Frightens a creature.
quote: The taut violet leather is drier than snakeskin, and puckered at each knuckle with shallow mouth-shaped pits.
where_to_find: In a wardrobe during the quest Visit the Emperor's Old Hideout
special: • Strength Saving Throws +1

name: Ceremonial Battleaxe
description: Ceremonial Battleaxe is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Battleaxes family of weapons. While functionally the same as a Battleaxe +1, it can be used for solving the puzzle inside the Rosymorn Monastery chapel.
quote: The intricate engravings on this axe's blade and handle make plain the skill of its smith.
notes:
• Picking up the axe causes the Guardian to become hostile.
• This is part of the solution to the Dawnmaster's Crest puzzle in the Rosymorn Monastery.

name: Ceremonial Longsword
description: Ceremonial Longsword is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) Longsword. While functionally the same as a Longsword +1, it can be used for solving the puzzle inside the Rosymorn Monastery chapel.
quote: A complex filigree wraps around the base of this blade - the runes on the side suggesting it is not merely decorative.
notes: • This is part of the solution to the Dawnmaster's Crest puzzle in the Rosymorn Monastery.

name: Ceremonial Mace
description: Ceremonial Mace is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) Mace. While functionally the same as a Mace +1, it can be used for solving the puzzle inside the Rosymorn Monastery chapel.
quote: The leather handle of this mace smells badly of rotting blood.
notes: • This is part of the solution to the Dawnmaster's Crest puzzle in the Rosymorn Monastery.

name: Ceremonial Warhammer
description: Ceremonial Warhammer is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) Warhammer. While functionally the same as a Warhammer +1, it can be used for solving the puzzle inside the Rosymorn Monastery chapel.
quote: Following tradition, this hammer's faces were forged with grooves that sealed in the blood of its first kill.
notes:
• Picking the weapon up causes the eagles to become hostile, if caught while picking it up.
• This is part of the solution to the Dawnmaster's Crest puzzle in the Rosymorn Monastery.

name: Chain Mail
description: Chain Mail is a common Heavy Armour.
quote: The tight weave of chains in this armour chimes like wind through leaves.
where_to_find: Sold by Roah Moonglow in Act One

name: Chain Mail +1
description: Chain Mail +1 is an uncommon Heavy Armour that reduces Slashing damage.
quote: Fine fabric obscures the bulk of this chain mail, allowing its wearer to mix in polite society while protecting them from unexpected assailants.
where_to_find: Sold by traders using the levelled magic armour table if the player is between levels 4 and 6

name: Chain Mail +2
description: Chain Mail +2 is a rare Heavy Armour that reduces Slashing damage by 2.
quote: Made from thick, strong chains loosely-fitted, this armour hangs more heavily than some but protects its wearer with an impenetrable weave of metal.
where_to_find: Sold by traders using the levelled magic armour table if the player is level 7 or above

variants.name: Chain Shirt
variants.description: Chain Shirt is a common Medium Armour unique to Shadowheart
variants.quote: While the stitching on the shirt is rushed and uneven, the chain mail is sturdy, and the garment is decorated with an obsidian disk that seems to swallow all light.
variants.where_to_find: Worn by Shadowheart

name: Chain Shirt
description: A Chain Shirt is a common Medium Armour.
quote: Tight chains protect the wearer from many sharp weapons, while fabric padding protects the skin from cold metal.
where_to_find: Starting armour for Clerics

name: Chain Shirt +1
description: Chain Shirt +1 is an uncommon Medium Armour that reduces Slashing damage.
quote: The intricate embroidery on the linen panel of this armour indicates the nobility of its previous owner.
where_to_find: Sold by traders using the levelled magic armour table if the player character is between levels 2 and 4

name: Chain Shirt +2
description: Chain Shirt +2 is a rare Medium Armour that reduces Slashing damage and grants a +1 bonus to Dexterity Saving Throws and Ability Checks
quote: This mail's impossibly fine, close joining indicates the work of gnomish fingers.
where_to_find: Sold by traders using the levelled magic armour table if the player is between levels 5 and 8
notes: The in game appearance for this item is red despite the icon being blue.

name: Chain of Liberation
description: The Chain of Liberation is an uncommon Medium Armour that allows the wearer to sacrifice their Momentum (condition) to rush forward and avoid Attacks of Opportunity.
quote: Linked rings crackle with energy, just waiting to be released.
where_to_find: in a chest within a hidden room (Early Access only)
notes: • Replaced by Luminous Armour in the full release of the game.

name: Champion's Chain
description: Champion's Chain is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to grant an ally a bonus to Intimidation.
quote: A plump mass torn from Sovereign Glut's own flesh. A marker of the colony's esteem - or perhaps its property.
where_to_find: Reward for delivering Nere's Head to Glut during the quest Deliver Nere's Head
special:
Tyrant Tongue (Action)
Grant an ally a +2 bonus on Intimidation Checks. ( Recharge: Long rest.)
notes:
• Nere's head can be delivered to either Glut or Spaw, depending on which one of them is installed as Sovereign of the Myconid Colony.
• The reward for delivering the head to Spaw is the Envoy's Amulet.

name: Chancer's Carcanet
image: Amulet Necklace B Bronze A 1 Faded.png
controller_icon: Amulet Necklace B Bronze A 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Amulet Necklace B Bronze A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Chancer's Carcanet is a rare Amulet. It allows the wearer to use a reaction to make an Attack Roll or Saving Throw with Advantage, once per Long Rest.
quote: Imbued with a little luck after the item was pressed to the pursed lips of a saint of the goddess Tymora. Inscribed roughly and inexpertly on the underside: 'Lady Luck, don't you piss in my porridge oats!'
where_to_find: Given by Sarin
notes:
• The party must return Sarin's Skull to her body.
• Prior to Patch 6 this item was called "Magic Amulet".

name: Chandelier-Style Embroidered Ensemble
description: Chandelier-Style Embroidered Ensemble is a set of common Camp Clothing.

name: Channeler's Trunks
description: Channeler's Trunks are common Underwear.
quote: Underwear of this type was commonly worn by mages powerful enough to broadcast their likeness across the many plances of existence.

name: Chaos Flail
quote: The weapon of a flind, imbued with the power of the demon lord Yeenoghu. Some say the flail itself is the catalyst for transforming gnolls into vicious flinds.
special: This item can only be equipped by Gnolls

name: Charge-Bound Warhammer
description: Charge-Bound Warhammer is a rare +1 Warhammer with +1 bonus to damage and Attack Rolls, and deals additional 1d6 Lightning damage.
quote: Energy crackles in weird and wonderful patterns across your hand as you wield this bound weapon, as if your very veins were marbled like a cloud of blue-white lightning.
special: • This hammer's magical powers only function if it's bound to an Eldritch Knight or is a Warlock's Pact or Hexed weapon. These effects are in addition to the weapon's +1 enchantment. Due to both the enchantment and the favoured weapon bonus stacking, this weapon is effectively a +2 weapon when bound.
bugs: • If this weapon is bound by an Eldritch Knight or Pact of the Blade Warlock, this weapon will permanently retain the lightning damage bonus from Galvanic Currents even if the character binds another weapon. The weapon will even retain this passive if the weapon is used by another character, different from the one who bound it.
notes: • These effects are in addition to the weapon's +1 enchantment. Due to both the enchantment and the favoured weapon bonus stacking, this weapon is effectively a +2 weapon when bound.

name: Chatterbox's Tabard
description: Chatterbox's Tabard is common Camp Clothing.

notes:

name: Chocolatier Style Doublet
description: Chocolatier Style Doublet is a set of common Camp Clothing.
quote: This lovely ensemble is evocative of the apron of a master chocolatier - and just as scrumptious.

name: Cinder Shoes
description: Cinder Shoes is a pair of uncommon Boots that grants Heat whenever the wearer Burns an enemy.
quote: Despite the many scorch marks, these leather boots are somehow still supple and intact.
where_to_find: Sold by Blurg

name: Cindermoth Cloak
description: Cindermoth Cloak is an uncommon Cloak that inflicts Burning on any foe within 2 m (7 ft) which damages the wearer.
quote: With every rustle of this cloak, small moths like windblown embers appear around you - they flutter for a moment, then fade into inconsequence.
where_to_find: Worn by Aelis Siryasius in the area filled with greasy surfaces

name: Cindersnap Gloves
description: Cindersnap Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that grant the spell Protection from Missiles.
quote: 'What moves faster, a loosed crossbow bolt or a windblown cinder? Let's find out.' - Overheard during a Flaming Fist raid in Baldur's Gate.
where_to_find: Sold by Quartermaster Talli near the Last Light Inn waypoint
special:
Protection from Missiles (Action)
Amplify your reflexes to better contend with incoming missiles. Ranged weapon attacks against you have Disadvantage, and their damage is halved. ( Recharge: Short rest.)

name: Circle of Bones
description: Circle of Bones is a rare Circlet that grants all nearby allied undead Resistance to physical damage, and the wearer can cast Animate Dead once per Long Rest.
