where_to_find: Carried by Balthazar, at his altar
special:
Animate Dead (Action)
Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
bugs: • Summoning a zombie via this item's version of Animate Dead incorrectly summons a Newborn Zombie, which begins decaying, instead of the normal Zombie.

name: Circlet
description: The Circlet is a common Circlet.
quote: Provides its wearer a touch of elegance but no additional protection.
where_to_find: Starting headwear for Shadowheart

name: Circlet of Blasting
description: The Circlet of Blasting is a rare circlet that grants the wearer the ability to cast the Scorching Ray spell.
quote: This delicate circlet grants the wearer the ability to cast the Scorching Ray spell.
where_to_find: Sold by Blurg
special:
Scorching Ray (Action)
Cast as a level 2 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Circlet of Fire
icon: Circlet of Mental Anguish Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Circlet of Fire is an uncommon Circlet that grants the wearer a bonus action whenever they deal Fire damage with a leveled spell.
quote: Merely holding the circlet makes your skin flush, filling you with determination and righteous fury.
where_to_find:
This item is not present in the launch version of the game. Its effects have largely been replicated by the Pyroquickness Hat found in Act Three.
• In Early Access versions of the game the circlet could be found in a gilded chest in the final room of the Apothecary's Cellar beneath the Blighted Village X: -659 Y: -370. The cellar can be accessed through the building directly behind the village's Ancient Rune Circle.

name: Circlet of Hunting
description: The Circlet of Hunting is a very rare circlet which grants a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls against marked creatures.
quote: Huntresses prowling in the least hospitable woods of Toril hold one rule as cardinal: kill quickly. This is not about suffering. It's about sound, and its necessary absence.
where_to_find: Sold by Araj Oblodra on the main floor

name: Circlet of Mental Anguish
icon: Circlet of Mental Anguish Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Circlet of Mental Anguish is a rare Circlet that heals the wearer for 1d4 hit points when an enemy fails a Charisma, Intelligence, or Wisdom Saving Throw against one of the wearer's spells or cantrips.
quote: Fell magic has seeped into this circlet, rejoicing at the slightest touch of despair.
where_to_find: On a skeleton in the Necrotic Laboratory

name: Circlet of Psionic Revenge
icon: Circlet of Psionic Revenge Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Circlet of Psionic Revenge is a rare Circlet which allows Gith to enhance their saving throws and punish casters with psychic damage.
quote: You get the eerie feeling that the jewelsmith used more than alien metals to forge this circlet - something like ancient magic, or shards of a soul.
where_to_find: Carried by Githyanki Inquisitor Ch'r'ai W'wargaz in the Inquisitor's Chamber

name: Circus Ensemble

name: Cloak of Avarice
description: The Cloak of Avarice is a rare cloak.
quote: For one to wear this heavy cloak woven of errant, unused gold, one's pockets must hang even heavier still.

name: Cloak of Cunning Brume
icon: Cloak of Cunning Brume Unfaded Icon.png
description: Cloak of Cunning Brume is an uncommon Cloak which grants the user a smokescreen cloud effect when trying to Disengage.
quote: One of the relics of Deep Duerra's rebellious children. The children found nothing of use in the vault and were discouraged. But in the morning the Vault Keykeeper's son, who admired the children, sought them out - and in his arms he brought a wealth of things, forged in shadow.
where_to_find: Sold by Mattis

name: Cloak of Displacement

where_to_find: Sold by Entharl Danthelon in Wyrm's Crossing

where_to_find: In an opulent chest in Ketheric Thorm's chambers on the second floor
bugs: • Due to a coding error, Absorb Elements only functions once per Long Rest instead of once per Short Rest.
notes: • Absorb Elements additional elemental damage applies only to weapon attacks, and can apply its damage bonus multiple times to a single weapon attack.

name: Cloak of Protection

quote:
Wizards [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Otiluke Otiluke] and [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Bigby Bigby] may be renowned as dignified members of the Circle of Eight, but on one occasion, as younger men, Bigby bet Otiluke that he couldn't suck thirteen litres of vodka out of a protection cloak like this one.
Bigby won.

name: Cloth Armour
description: Cloth Armour is an uncommon piece of Clothing that grants Wrath when an enemy damages the wearer.
quote: No sooner does blood speck the armour than it's absorbed, as if sustaining something within.
where_to_find: On a table in the south-eastern room
notes: • Despite the inherent contradiction in its name, this item is treated as clothing by the game engine, and does not count as armour for the purposes of effects that trigger when wearing (or not wearing) armour.

name: Cloth of Authority
description: Cloth of Authority is a rare piece of Clothing that grants immunity to emotion-altering conditions. It also grants +1 Armour Class as well as Advantage on Intimidation and Insight checks.
quote: One can hardly be called a lord if they aren't dressed as such. A cursory glance at Gortash's finery would reveal intricate garb - a closer look would reveal a maddening attention to even the most minute details of the filigree.
where_to_find: worn by Enver Gortash
special: • Armour Class +1
bugs: • Switching from camp clothing to default view briefly (about 3 frames) shows the character from the waist up with no clothing.
notes: • Gortash can be found in the audience hall during the coronation or in his personal quarters on top of the fortress.

where_to_find: Near to a picnic basket on the small ruined dock behind Elerrathin's Home
notes: • Despite appearing to be camp clothing, this item actually uses the armour slot like other Clothing items.

name: Clown Hammer
description: Clown Hammer is a rare +2 Warhammer that forces both the wielder and the target to make a Wisdom Saving Throw on a critical hit, or else fall down laughing.
quote: This hammer has a colourful history - it doesn't honk when you squeeze it, alas.

name: Club
description: Club is a mundane, nonmagical variant of the Clubs family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon wielded in one hand. It is a light weapon that anyone can dual-wield without special training. It is more or less a temporary weapon considering other simple weapons like Mace are superior to it in damage.
quote: A long, deep crack runs through the side of the wood, filled with crusted blood.

name: Club +1
quote: A long, deep crack runs through the side of the wood, filled with crusted blood.

name: Club of Hill Giant Strength
description: Club of Hill Giant Strength is an uncommon club that that sets the wearer's Strength to 19.
quote: Though this rotting chair leg doesn't look like much, every splinter vibrates with barely-contained power.
notes:
• It is possible to equip this Club in a character's offhand and keep their main hand slot free (e.g. for brawler monk):
• Equip a dagger in the character's main hand and this club in their offhand.
• Switch to another companion with no weapons equipped.
• Click on their weapon slot and choose to equip the mainhand weapon currently in use by the first character. They will swap the weapon in the first character's primary weapon slot to their empty weapon slot, leaving the first character with the club in their offhand, yet with nothing in their main hand.
• According to D&D rules, this item should be named Club of Ogre Strength, because [https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/16969-ogre Ogres] have STR = 19 while [https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/16923-hill-giant Hill Giants] have STR = 21.
• The in-game model has the word "STRENGTH" engraved on it in the [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Dethek Dethek] runic script.
• Patch 1 changed the Strength increase from 15 to 19.

name: Cold Snap
description: Cold Snap is a rare Dagger which chills enemies that attack and miss the wielder; it also increases the wielder's Armour Class if used in the off-hand.
quote: In the steel, you can see small ice formations like bubbles in a bath, and even hear them pop with crickling crackles of frosted delight.
special: • Armour Class +1 (Off-Hand Only)
notes:
• Cold damage from this weapon is not applied if Thrown.
• Ferg Drogher does not sell any items (including this one) if Shadowheart is nearby, unless she killed the Nightsong earlier in Act Two.

name: Coldbrim Hat
description: Coldbrim Hat is an uncommon Hat where, once per turn, if a condition is inflicted on the target, the hat also applies 2 turns of Encrusted with Frost.
quote: Upturning the hat and gazing into it, you get this slightly vertiginous feeling, as if you were looking into a cold, abandoned well with no discernible end.
where_to_find: In a locked chest in a hidden room behind a bookcase in Balthazar's Chambers

name: Combination Axe
quote: The intricate engravings on this axe's blade and handle make plain the skill of its smith.

name: Comeback Handaxe
quote: This loyal axe always returns to its owner after being thrown. However, it has no eyes and therefore dreadful aim, inevitably returning to its thrower blade-end-first.
notes:
• True to its name, the axe has a hidden Homing Weapon feature but also hits the thrower on its way back, dealing only the base 1d6 + 1 Bludgeoning damage.
• The return damage can be avoided if the return trajectory is blocked by the environment, such as trees or pillars. The handaxe still returns to the thrower.
• Arguably more useful than it appears at first glance, unlike other homing weapons, this axe does not equip itself after being Thrown, instead returning to inventory. It also does not suffer from the combat initiation bug, making it a solid candidate for Tavern Brawlers to start fights with if not already in turn-based combat mode.

name: Corellon's Grace
description: Corellon's Grace is an uncommon Quarterstaff that increases the wielder's Saving Throws if the wielder is not wearing any armour. They also gain a bonus to Attack Rolls and Damage Rolls if attacking while unarmed.
quote: This light, flexible staff is of elven make, marked with mithral sigils that channel magic in the blink of an eye.
notes: • While naturally associated with monks due to its bonus to unarmed attacks, this staff can also be a good choice for Elk barbarians using Primal Stampede as their main attack action, or any spellcaster focused on maintaining Concentration spells.

name: Corpsegrinder
description: Corpsegrinder is a rare +2 Maul that deals additional Thunder damage and grants its wielder the Grand Slam weapon action.
quote: Reliable and trustworthy, you could not hope for more respectable company than this maul whilst traversing the forlorn places of the world.
notes: • This weapon's name is likely an homage to the song "Hammer Smashed Face" by Cannibal Corpse, whose vocalist goes by the stage name "Corpsegrinder".

name: Corrosive Flail
description: Corrosive Flail is a rare +1 Flail that grants a special weapon action, Corrosive Strike.
quote: Acid was long ago abandoned by assassins, who found poison much more reliable in spiking their target's drinks. The acid kept melting the chalices.
bugs:
• When dual-wielding a flail or morningstar with a non-Tenacity weapon using the Dual Wielder feat, Tenacity can be triggered by missing an attack with the non-Tenacity weapon, dealing Bludgeoning damage regardless of the weapon used.
• Some non-Tenacity weapons can trigger their on-hit effects via Tenacity as well, such as the Ritual Dagger and Loviatar's Scourge.

name: Coruscation Ring
icon: Ring A Simple Gold 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Coruscation Ring is an uncommon ring that inflicts Radiating Orb on creatures that the wearer deals spell damage to. The wearer must be illuminated for this effect to occur.
quote: Provocative light blooms from the engraved contours of this ring.
where_to_find: in a trapped heavy chest in the cellar of the Last Light Inn
notes:
• The chest is in a secret area, which is reached by going through a set of Double Oak Doors that are blocked by a destructible spiderweb and a pile of crates. The room beyond has a Cracked Wall, which, if broken, grants access to a cavernous area guarded by a pack of Meenlocks. In its far corner, behind another door, stands the chest.
• Alternatively, the chest can also be reached by going through the cell next to the Evidence Chest. Its left wall can be broken to gain entry into another room with a door that opens into the area with the chest.
• The chest can be disarmed with a DC 10 Sleight of Hand Check and unlocked with a DC 14 Sleight of Hand Check.
• This item has great synergy with the Callous Glow Ring. When an enemy receives Radiating Orb from Arcane Radiance, they become illuminated, which causes them to take an additional 2 Radiant damage from the Callous Glow Ring.

name: Corvid Token
image: Amulet Necklace F Bronze A 1 Faded.png
controller_icon: Amulet Necklace F Bronze A 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Amulet Necklace F Bronze A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Corvid Token is a very rare Amulet. It increases the wearer's jump distance and flying speed, grants the Polymorph: Dire Raven action, and grants Feather Fall, which persists while Polymorphed or Wild Shaped.

where_to_find: Sold by Mattis near the Requisitioned Barn

Polymorph: Dire Raven (Action)
Take the shape of a dire raven that can avoid attention and Blind enemies. It has 13 hit points. ( Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Cosy Blue Shirt
description: Cosy Blue Shirt is an article of common Camp Clothing.

where_to_find:
In a wardrobe near the Helmet of Arcane Acuity in the Mason's Guild at X: 122 Y: -746
• At several locations as set-dressing and random loot later in the game

name: Covert Cowl
description: Covert Cowl is an uncommon Helmet that makes the wearer's critical hits more likely when they are obscured.

One of the relics of Deep Duerra's rebellious children. Keeping themselves and one another safe from the nasty surprises of their home, the siblings made good progress.
At the final hurdle, they were confronted by none other than Duerra herself, and her rage was great, and they felt the candles of hope in their hearts snuff out.
where_to_find: Carried by a Meenlock in the cellar of Last Light Inn
special: • Dexterity Saving Throws +1

name: Cracked Helm of Shar
icon: Cracked Helm of Shar Unfaded Icon.png
description: Cracked Helm of Shar is a common Helmet that improves the wearer's Constitution Saving Throws.
quote: Battered by age and use, this once-fine helmet feels like a ghost of a bygone time.
where_to_find: Near a ritual circle in the Gauntlet of Shar X: -707 Y: -724
special: • Constitution Saving Throws +1

name: Craterflesh Gloves
description: Craterflesh Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that deal additional Force damage on a Critical Hit.
quote: Indents on the fingertips of these gloves are ringed with tiny meteorites, lined in a shimmering purple light rather than the rich red of astral flame.
where_to_find: Sold by Echo of Abazigal
special: • Strength Saving Throws +1
notes: • The player character can only purchase the Craterflesh Gloves from the Echo of Abazigal if they accept becoming an Unholy Assassin of Bhaal. However, it can also be acquired through an exploit – see notes on the Echo of Abazigal page for details.

name: Creation's Echo
description: Creation's Echo is a rare Quarterstaff that grants the wielder resistance to Acid, Fire, Lightning, Radiant, or Necrotic damage after first dealing damage of that element.
quote: This staff pulses with energy, swiftly attuning itself to the beat of your heart.

name: Crimson Mischief
description: Crimson Mischief is a legendary +2 Shortsword that, when wielded in the main hand, grants additional damage when attacking with Advantage and against targets with 50% or less of their hit points. When wielded in the off-hand, it instead allows the wielder to add their Ability Modifier to their damage.
quote: When she was a girl, she toyed with nastiness and sadism. Children often grow out of this; they get hobbies. For Orin, that taste for cruelty fermented, and in a way she did find hobbies. Ones that screamed.
bugs: • Despite being classed solely as a Shortsword, Scimitar proficiency also allows one to wield this weapon proficiently.

name: Cross-Crest Sandals
description: Cross-Crest Sandals is a common pair of Camp Shoes.
quote: Patterned as many knightly shields are in the modern era.

name: Crossbow of Arcane Force
icon: Crossbow of Arcane Force Unfaded Icon.png
description: Crossbow of Arcane Force is an uncommon +1 Heavy Crossbow that grants the wielder a special Arcane Ammunition weapon action that adds additional Force damage to ranged attacks.
quote: The soft hum of power emanates from the alien metal.

name: Crude Mace
quote: Rotten rags and mud are the only things keeping this mace together.
notes:
Prior to Patch #7 this mace could be found equipped by Shadowheart following the crash of the Nautiloid in Act One, if her original mace was taken from her in the Prologue and not in her inventory.
Since Patch #7 Shadowheart will not be given this mace and instead will have nothing equipped if her mace is removed during the prologue.

name: Cruel Sting
description: Cruel Sting is a rare +1 Longsword that deals extra Poison damage against Restrained targets if the wielder is a drow elf. It also grants the Ensnaring Strands spell.
quote: The trauma of becoming a drider is quickly set aside with a cold arachnid dispassion. This sword follows that disturbing trend - a replenishing poison gland is built within, deployed only against trapped opponents.
special:
Ensnaring Strands (Action)
Your attack conjures thick sticky webbing that possibly Enwebs your target(s). ( Recharge: Short rest.)
bugs:
• When this sword is looted from Kar'niss, it retains Spindleweb Fanatic until Long Rest, granting additional 1d6 Psychic damage to weapon attacks.
• Spindleweb Fanatic can be retained indefinitely by dropping the weapon on the ground or stashing it in a container prior to each long rest.

name: Crusher's Ring
description: Crusher's Ring is an uncommon Ring which grants additional speed to the wearer.
quote: Though caked with mud and grime, the ring smells faintly of lavender. Remarkable, considering where it's been.
where_to_find: Worn by Crusher
special: • Movement Speed increased by 3 m (10 ft).
notes:
• This item cannot be stolen by normal means. However, it is possible to slip the ring off his toe when he demands to kiss his feet, or kill Crusher to loot it from his corpse.
• This ring has the same effect as Longstrider, and the two effects can stack.

name: Crypt Lord Ring
icon: Ring I Gold A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Crypt Lord Ring is a very rare Ring. It allows the wearer to cast Create Undead once per Long Rest.
quote: Slipping one's finger through this ring fills the senses with the waft of tombs, the urine-yellow smell of old bandages, images of dead spiders curled into husks, and the sensation of hot, slobbering breath at the nape of one's neck.
where_to_find: Rewarded for completion of the quest Find Mystic Carrion's Servant, if Thrumbo survives
special:
Create Undead (Action)
Cast as a level 6 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
notes: • The conjured Mummy disappears if the ring is unequipped.

name: Cultist Brand
quote: Wrought from a single piece of twisted iron. Bits of charred flesh cling to the strange symbol shaped at the end.

name: Curled-Toe Boots
description: Curled-Toe Boots are a common pair of boots.
quote: Made of tough, well-worn leather, these boots have survived years of use, and can survive many more.
where_to_find: On a shelf in Flymm's Cobblers

name: Cut-Throat Leather Ensemble
description: Cut-Throat Leather Ensemble is a common Camp Clothing.
quote: With sharpened edges, this ensemble is not to be worn by the fainthearted... or by those who bleed easily.
where_to_find: Available only to Minthara in the epilogue if the player did not romance her and agree to seize Baldur's Gate.

name: Dad's Axe
quote: An old woodcutter's axe, infused with a shadow's bleak curse.

• [STRENGTH] Grasp the handle and pull the dagger with all your might. (DC 15)

name: Dagger +2

name: Dagger of Shar
quote: This dagger's handle is smooth and light, its jagged blade sharpened into a thin, cruel edge.

name: Damaged Dark Justiciar Armour
description: A Medium Armour that is the degraded version of Dark Justiciar Mail. It is part of the Dark Justiciar Set.
quote: Though time has tarnished this armour's metal and cracked its leather, the black sheen of Shar's symbol shines eternal from its chestpiece.
where_to_find: On a pair of skeletons past the Elder Rothé

name: Damaged Scale Mail
description: Damaged Scale Mail is a common Medium armour offering less protection than other Medium armours due to its damaged state.
quote: With many broken and missing scales, the armour offers little in the way of protection.

quote: Countless hands have smoothened the haft and sharpened the blade. This is an ancestral weapon - perhaps dating back to the ancient digs that sundered the duergar from their dwarf-kin.

name: Defender Flail
description: The Defender Flail is a rare +1 Flail that reduces physical weapon damage to the wearer and increases Armour Class.

special: • Armour Class +1
bugs:
• When dual-wielding a flail or morningstar with a non-Tenacity weapon using the Dual Wielder feat, Tenacity can be triggered by missing an attack with the non-Tenacity weapon, dealing Bludgeoning damage regardless of the weapon used.

notes: • The Defender Flail is also found in Baldur's Gate 2 as the [https://baldursgate.fandom.com/wiki/Defender_of_Easthaven Defender of Easthaven]. The description of the item in both games refers to the events of Icewind Dale.

quote: The power of this axe lies in a fluctuating arcane enchantment that flows between the beard and the edge of the axe, and the wielder themselves.

name: Delicate Shoes

quote: Patterned with twists of gold, lilac and sapphire, these delicate shoes are very reasonable for dancing, romancing, perhaps even prancing.

name: Delicately Constructed Outfit

quote: Capably crafted, giving the impression of affirming wealth,

notes: • [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Athkatla Athkatla] is a city found in the nation of [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Amn Amn]

where_to_find: Throughout the game as set-dressing and random loot

name: Destroyed  Kill Collar
description: Destroyed Kill Collar is an common Amulet that represents the destroyed collars used by Gortash to keep the Gondians within the Iron Foundry in check.
quote: Smells a bit rusty, but looks stylish nonetheless.
where_to_find: Worn by several Gondian workers inside the Steel Watch Foundry

name: Deva Mace
description: Deva Mace is a common variant of the Maces family of weapons wielded by Deva.
quote: The golden slopes of the celestial heavens are filled with angels. Theistic scholars don't know what they do, but whatever it is, they do it holy.
notes:
• As of Patch 8/Hotfix 31, this weapon can be obtained using a mouse and keyboard on PC with [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c8JDT_DdD0s&t=38 the following steps]:
• Summon a Planar Ally: Deva.
• Open its inventory.
• Click the preview icon, located below the character.
• Click and hold the weapon. (Caution: The weapon slot only appears for a few frames.)
• Open the party inventory (or, for example, have the Traveller's Chest from camp inventory already open) and place the weapon in an empty inventory slot.
• As of Patch 8/Hotfix 31, this weapon can also be obtained with the following steps:
• Kill a Deva summoned by Castigated by Divinity and pick Up its corpse.
• Unequip the weapon of the character holding the corpse.
• Select the filter at the top of the inventory and filter for Common items.
• The mace will be displayed in the inventory, right-click and select Equip.
• The following also works as of Patch 8/Hotfix 31, and is possible on all platforms:
• Summon a Planar Ally: Deva.
• Place a weapon with the "Can be consumed by Gale" tag on the ground.
• As the Deva, select the weapon and select the 'use' option. This will equip the weapon.
• Pickpocket the mace from the Deva's inventory.
• As of Patch 7/Hotfix 29, this weapon was obtainable using a controller on PC or console with the following steps:
• Kill a Deva summoned by Castigated by Divinity and Pick Up its body.
• Open any character's inventory, press A/X on their melee main-hand equipment slot, and unequip their current weapon in the weapon list that appears.
• Still in the weapon list, press A/X on the Deva Mace to equip it to the currently selected character.

notes_links.page: List of Items consumable by Gale

name: Devilfoil Mask
description: A Devilfoil Mask is a common Helmet worn by Merregons that increases the wearer's Strength by 1 and decreases the wearer's Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma by 1 per nearby mask.
quote: Beneath a layer of dust, the mask still gleams. An innocent smile and wide, searching eyes - seeking its own kind.
where_to_find: On a table near Sergeant Thrinn, at the Dig Site
notes:
• When first picked up, the character doing so can pass a DC 10 Arcana Check to identify it as a mask for a Merregon.
• As four of these masks are available relatively early in the game, they can, if worn by all party members, be used to raise the Strength of those wearing them by 3.
• Devilfoil Masks can be crafted into Orthon Explosives by Dammon in Act Two while at the Last Light Inn.
• These masks work well in conjunction with the Tavern Brawler feat.
• During the Self-Same Trial, any party members wearing the Devilfoil Mask will have their clone wearing a mask as well. These masks will stack with the party's masks as well as their own, causing every party member and their copy to receive the Infernal Legion buff. In this case, the buff can increase Strength by as much as 7, and decrease Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma by the same amount.

special:
Main Hand Only
Healing Incense Aura (Bonus Action)

• As of Patch 6, this weapon is obtainable using a controller by following the same steps that worked on keyboard and mouse before patch 5:
• Kill a Djinni summoned by Castigated By Divinity and pick up its body
• Open any character's inventory, select their melee main-hand equipment slot and press A/X
• Select the Djinni Scimitar from the menu that appears to equip it to the currently selected character
• This also works on PC but must be done using a controller, as this same glitch no longer works using keyboard & mouse
• The following also works as of Patch 8/Hotfix 31, and is possible on all platforms:
• Summon a Planar Ally: Djinni.
• Place a weapon with the "Can be consumed by Gale" tag on the ground.
• As the Djinni, select the weapon and select the 'use' option. This will equip the weapon.
• Pickpocket the Scimitar from the Djinni's inventory.
• Djinni summoned through Planar Ally can be bugged into swapping this weapon to a player character's equipment with a mouse and keyboard.

name: Duellist's Prerogative
description: Duellist's Prerogative is a legendary +3 Rapier that grants the wielder a greater chance of critical hits, and an extra reaction provided their off-hand is empty. The wielder can also use a reaction to grant additional Necrotic damage on a hit.
quote: A blade gifted to Lora by her own mother, Lenore the Fleet. When challenged to duels, Lenore's opponents assumed she had received this nickname from some naval exploit. They found out how wrong they were when her blade blurred faster than the eye could follow.
special:
Challenge to Duel (Bonus Action)
Challenge an enemy to attack only you, inflicting Bleeding on the target.
notes:
• Wielding an off-hand weapon or a shield disables Elegant Duellist and Dueller's Enthusiasm.
• Lora does not reward the party with the Duelist's Prerogative if the quest Save Vanra is not picked up prior to freeing Vanra from the Hag's Lair; she must first be spoken with at the Basilisk Gate Barracks to receive this item.
• Although Challenge to Duel is described as a spell and not as a weapon action, it still receives a bonus from the Heightened Manoeuvre passive feature.

name: Duke Ravengard's Longsword
description: Duke Ravengard's Longsword is a rare +1 Longsword which increases the wielder's Charisma by +2 and can also grant allies temporary hit points based on their respective Charisma modifiers.
quote: Cradling his newborn son awkwardly, the Duke's face pulled into a rictus of misery. His love Francesca smiled at him, briefly, and died. He stared at her until the boy cried, and he told the boy it would be all right, though he himself did not believe it.
special:
• Charisma +2
Commander's Strike (Action + Bonus Action)
Direct an ally to strike a foe. The ally uses a reaction on their next turn to make a weapon attack. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
notes:
• The sword can be acquired by casting Command: Drop on Duke Ravengard.
• If acquired after Ravengard's rescue from the Iron Throne, the spell must be cast by a character who is not considered an ally: Either by a companion that was not part of the original rescue party, or by using Disguise Self. Wyll permanently leaves the party and turns hostile if the Duke notices his sword being stolen. This can be prevented by immediately leaving the camp after picking up the sword.
• If acquired immediately after Gortash's installation as Grand Duke, Disguise Self is not needed, but it is advisable for both the caster and party member picking up the sword to remain Invisible.
• The Charisma bonus from the sword is uncapped, meaning that the bonus does not stack with other capped Charisma bonuses when Charisma is above any of those caps.

name: Dwarven Splintmail
description: Dwarven Splintmail is a rare heavy armour that reduces Piercing damage by 1 and grants a +1 bonus to Strength Saving Throws and Ability Checks. In addition, it also boosts the user's Constitution by 2.
quote: Skilled hands crafted this armour, reinforcing the metal plates while sacrificing none of the flexibility.
where_to_find: Sold by Lann Tarv on the main floor

bugs: • Despite existing in the game files, the custom icon and world item model for the Dwarven Splintmail are not set, and the armour instead inherits these values from Splint Armour +1.
notes:
• Disciple Z'rell must be convinced to give additional aid in finding Ketheric's relic.
• This item refreshes in Lann Tarv's inventory after every long rest, allowing the purchase of multiple copies.
• This armour bears some rather distinctive rear-facing heraldry on its front. When worn (particularly by larger body types such the Male Human/Elf "Body 2" or "Body 4"), a set of six dwarven figures are depicted. While five of the figures are shown in traditional, often stoic poses, the figure on the middle of wearer's right side is bent over, facing away from the observer with his trousers lowered, effectively 'mooning' anyone looking at it.

name: Dwarven Thrower

notes:
• Ferg Drogher does not sell any items (including this one) if Shadowheart is nearby, unless she killed The Nightsong earlier in Act Two. Otherwise Ferg Drogher disappears from the game after the first interaction with him and there is no other opportunity to get the Dwarven Thrower.
• As this weapon returns when thrown, it works well with Tavern Brawler and Enraged Throw.

name: Elven Chain
description: Elven Chain is a rare Medium Armour that grants its wearer bonuses to Initiative Rolls and Dexterity Saving Throws.
quote: The weight of the interwoven steel rings is offset by clever elven craftsmanship - rustling against your undershirt, the mail feels like you're wearing a cloud.
where_to_find: Sold by Exxvikyap in Rivington during Act Three
bugs:
• Because this item does not have a proficiency group, items such as the Bracers of Defence, Bonespike Boots, and Corellon's Grace that are not supposed to give their bonuses to characters wearing armour still provide their benefits with Elven Chain equipped. The extra movement speed granted to monks by Unarmoured Movement is also not lost when wearing this armour.
• For the same reason as above, the Defence fighting style does not consider Elven Chain as armour proper. To work around this, the armour itself has a hidden passive that grants +1 AC if the wearer has the Defence passive. However, if the wearer also has another piece of armour equipped, which has a proficiency group, the normal +1 AC from Defence is additionally applied for a total of +2 AC.
notes: • As this item does not have an armour proficiency group, any class can wear it without the normal armour penalties that might otherwise be imposed.

One of the relics of Deep Duerra's rebellious children. Paranoid by nature, Duerra had erected a vast array of biting, blasting, blinding traps and safeguards to keep her enemies from gaining her sanctum.
Of course, this also meant her children were sealed in with her by those same deadly measures.

name: Executioner Sword
description: Executioner Sword is a rare, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Shortswords family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon wielded in one hand. As a finesse weapon, it can benefit from the wielder's Dexterity and not just their Strength. It is a light weapon that anyone can dual-wield without special training.
quote: Once there was a man who dreamed of unlocking every bit of his potential. It upset him when he couldn't; after all who can? When his daughter was born, she taught him about real dreams. She taught him with her eyes.

The ring is on the 5th ledge, on the opposite side of the room. A character with high Strength ( Shadowheart, Lae'zel or Karlach, for example) can make the jump without enhancement, otherwise using either Swiresy Shoes or Enhance Leap helps. While not required, a source of light helps to see and loot the skeleton, which is in the complete dark. Pressing Alt does not highlight the skeleton.

notes:
• Succeeding in identifying the armour awards the The Spider's Gift inspirational event to party members with the Guild Artisan background.
• The party must include a character who has +5 to History or higher, or one belonging to any Underdark race (Drow, Duergar, or Deep Gnome), at the moment when the armour is picked up. This includes hirelings belonging to these races.

name: Faithbreaker
description: Faithbreaker is an uncommon +1 Warhammer that grants the Absolute Power weapon action.
quote: A hand-like brand stamped into the leather handle obscures the notches that would normally signify a hobgoblin's rank.
notes: • The Absolute Power weapon action granted by this weapon also adds your strength modifier to its damage a second time.

name: Falataeric Cli Lyre
description:
Falataeric Cli Lyre is a unique instrument. It can be played with the Perform action.
This variant is functionally no different from the regular Lyre.
quote: This exquisite instrument is said to come from the shop of the legendary Moonshaean bard Falataer. Fewer than twenty of his handcrafted lyres still survive.
where_to_find: can be purchased from Thomas C. Quirkilious
notes: • In Forgotten Realms lore, the College of Cli was one of [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Falataer Falataer's] seven Bard colleges, located in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate. The Elfsong Tavern was once part of its campus.

name: False Spear of the Night
quote: While the handle is well made, the metal point is pitted with rust, and brittle as frozen underwear in the hands of a stone giant.

name: Family Ring
image: Ring A Gem A Gold 1 Faded.png
controller_icon: Ring A Gem A Gold 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Ring A Gem A Gold 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Family Ring is an uncommon Ring that grants +2 to Death Saving Throws.
quote: The ring's simplicity is a deceit. Its gold core is woven with iron-hard feathers from the wings of great black corvid birds, envoys of the Raven Queen.
where_to_find: In a burrow, down the cliff from Ellie May's grave and the camp
special: • Death Saving Throws +2
notes:
• A DC 10 Perception Check reveals the burrow.
• The nearby campsite was used by Ellie May's husband to mourn by her grave.
• Ellie was buried with the ring, but some small creature has since dug it up and brought it to its burrow. A successful Perception check near the grave will reveal a set of "beast tracks" leading to the cliff.
• The ring is mentioned in Unsent Letter. Ellie May's husband asked a robber to retrieve the ring for him, but they died before they could find it.

name: Fastidiously Perfect Outfit
icon: Camp Rich B Red Unfaded Icon.webp
description: Fastidiously Perfect Outfit is a set of common Camp Clothing.
quote: Nimble fingers designed and created this outfit.

name: Featherlight Boots
description: The Featherlight Boots are an uncommon pair of Boots that grants the wearer additional speed while greatly injured.
quote: The soft and supple leather glides over your skin. Wearing them feels like running barefoot.
where_to_find: Rewarded by Sovereign Glut for completing Avenge Glut's Circle (Early Access only)
notes:
• This reward was changed to Winter's Clutches in the full release of the game.
• The quest reward was a choice between this item and Ring of Fire.

name: Fetish of Callarduran Smoothhands
icon: Fetish of Callarduran Smoothhands Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Fetish of Callarduran Smoothhands is a rare Ring that allows the wearer to cast the Invisibility spell once per Long Rest.
quote: The smooth, six-pointed star on this ring is beset with small Underdark gemstones, as befits a talisman of the [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Callarduran_Smoothhands god] of mining and patron of deep gnomes.
where_to_find: On one of the dead deep gnomes that a pair of duergar are throwing into the lake
special:
Invisibility (Action)
Cast as a level 2 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
notes:
• If the party talk to the duergar they must succeed a Perception and Deception or Sleight of Hand check before this item can be looted. Alternatively, the ring can be taken directly from one of the duergar corpses after killing them. It is also possible to offer to lend a hand and loot the deep gnomes before they get shoved off.
• Looting the ring grants the You Can't Take It with You inspiration to party members with the Urchin background.

notes_links.text: You Can't Take It with You

name: Fey Semblance Amulet
image: Amulet Necklace C Gold A 1 Faded.png
controller_icon: Amulet Necklace C Gold A 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Amulet Necklace C Gold A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Fey Semblance Amulet is a very rare Amulet that gives the user advantage on all mental saving throws.
quote: Originally the kidney stone of an archfey, this object has been, ahem, passed down through the centuries.
where_to_find: Reward from Mayrina for completing the quest Avenge the Hag Survivors
notes: • If Mayrina is dead when Avenge the Hag Survivors is completed, this amulet is rewarded by Kled instead.

name: Fierce Golden Helm
description: A Fierce Golden Helm is a common Helmet.
quote: Aureate twists in the metal give a sheen like polluted sunlight.
where_to_find: On a table/shelf in the Morgue
special: • Constitution Saving Throws +1

name: Finely Crafted Ensemble
description: Finely Crafted Ensemble is a common Camp Clothing.
quote: Whoever crafted this outfit designed it to be both practical and stylish - an excellent combination.
where_to_find: Available only to Halsin in the epilogue

name: Fireheart
image: Amulet Necklace F Gold A 1 Faded.png
controller_icon: Amulet Necklace F Gold A 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Amulet Necklace F Gold A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Fireheart is an uncommon Amulet that grants the wearer 2 turns of Heat when they take Fire damage.
quote: The ruby's red reflections look like eerie flames dancing across your skin.
where_to_find: Inside a Heavy Chest
notes:
• The party must break a vine or jump through a window from the outside to enter the hidden room containing this amulet. This room can also be accessed by breaking some old planks on the roof section.
• Looting this item grants the Confiscated Works inspiration to party members with the Guild Artisan background.

name: Firestoker
description: The Firestoker is an uncommon Hand Crossbow that deals additional damage to Burning targets.
quote: Though the crossbow's bolts look burning hot, they are pleasantly warm to the touch.

name: Firm-Heeled Sandals
description: Firm-Heeled Sandals is a common pair of Camp Shoes.
quote: Supported round the heel, these sandals provide good comfort for the unhurried peruser of brooks, streams, and stony woods.

name: Firm-Soled Boots
controller_icon: Item ARM Boots Leather D Icon.png
icon: Item ARM Boots Leather D Unfaded Icon.png
description: Firm-Soled Boots are a common pair of Boots.
quote: These boots are well-maintained and clean, though their soles are thin from wear.

name: Firzu's Ring of Trading
description: Firzu's Ring of Trading is an uncommon Ring that grants +1 to Deception.
quote: Belonged to a trader Firzu. Increases Deception Checks by 1.
where_to_find: On a charred corpse in the hidden room immediately south of the entrance hall
special: • Deception +1

name: Fistbreaker Helm
description: Fistbreaker Helm is a rare Helmet that grants a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and +1 to Initiative Rolls.
quote: 'If your foe rains down blows upon your head, turn not the other cheek, but let your pricking helm bleed the bastards dry.'
where_to_find: Sold by Lann Tarv on the main floor

variants.name: Flail
variants.quote: The head of this flail is shiny and new, its wooden shaft still coarse and unmarked by blood.
variants.bugs:
• When dual-wielding a flail or morningstar with a non-Tenacity weapon using the Dual Wielder feat, Tenacity can be triggered by missing an attack with the non-Tenacity weapon. The damage will always be Bludgeoning, no matter the weapon used.
• Some non-Tenacity weapons can trigger their on-hit effects via Tenacity as well, such as the Ritual Dagger and Loviatar's Scourge.

name: Flail
quote: A browning piece of brain sticks stubbornly to one of the spikes.
bugs:
• When dual-wielding a flail or morningstar with a non-Tenacity weapon using the Dual Wielder feat, Tenacity can be triggered by missing an attack with the non-Tenacity weapon, dealing Bludgeoning damage regardless of the weapon used.
• Some non-Tenacity weapons can trigger their on-hit effects via Tenacity as well, such as the Ritual Dagger and Loviatar's Scourge.

quote: A browning piece of brain sticks stubbornly to one of the spikes.
bugs:

name: Flail +2
quote: The flail sits heavy in your hand - the weight of steel and magic.
bugs:

name: Flail of Ages
description: Flail of Ages is a rare +1 Flail that applies variable conditions depending on what type of damage the flail does.
quote: Created by a warmongering [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Rakshasa rakshasa] and kept for a time under the careful watch of an astute noble name [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Lord_de%27Arnise Lord de'Arnise], this flail is a tool of absolute destruction, and a versatile one at that.
special:
Elemental Age (Bonus Action)
Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
bugs:
• When dual-wielding a flail or morningstar with a non-Tenacity weapon using the Dual Wielder feat, Tenacity can be triggered by missing an attack with the non-Tenacity weapon, dealing Bludgeoning damage regardless of the weapon used.
• Some non-Tenacity weapons can trigger their on-hit effects via Tenacity as well, such as the Ritual Dagger and Loviatar's Scourge.
notes:
• Elemental Age's damage bonus can be applied to other weapons if the Flail of Ages is equipped in the off-hand slot when cast. The condition stays on the other weapon even when Flail of Ages is unequipped. It is removed after a long rest.
• Elements of an Epoch can trigger its effects via Tenacity when combined with an Acid Infusion, Cold Infusion, or Fire Infusion from the Ring of Elemental Infusion.
• The Flail of Ages is also found in [https://baldursgate.fandom.com/wiki/Baldur%27s_Gate_II:_Shadows_of_Amn Baldur's Gate 2]. The description of the item in Baldur's Gate 3 refers to the events of the previous storyline.

name: Flail of Dread Skulls
quote: Target must succeed a Wisdom Saving Throw. On failure, they are struck by Yeenoghu's curse. Depending on a dice roll, they will receive one of the following: Madness, 2d6 Psychic damage, or become Paralysed.
notes:
• This weapon looks to be an earlier version of the Shattered Flail
• This weapon also looks to be unfinished.
• The in-game quote is more like a description which is higly unusual.
• The quote says it may deal Psychic damage or Paralyse. This is false it can only apply madness.
• The Psychic damage is also not shown in the tooltip outside of the quote.
• The calculation for the saving throw shown in the tooltip may be wrong, but always results in 13.
• It may for example say 8 + 3 + 3 = 13 and state modifiers for other abilities than wisdom.

name: Flail of Myrkul
quote: A browning piece of brain sticks stubbornly to one of the spikes.
bugs:
• When dual-wielding a flail or morningstar with a non-Tenacity weapon using the Dual Wielder feat, Tenacity can be triggered by missing an attack with the non-Tenacity weapon, dealing Bludgeoning damage regardless of the weapon used.
• Some non-Tenacity weapons can trigger their on-hit effects via Tenacity as well, such as the Ritual Dagger and Loviatar's Scourge.
notes: • This can only be looted from Ketheric's corpse if he is disarmed in the initial encounter and a party member takes his weapon before he can pick it up. He will then have this weapon after defeating him in the second encounter.

name: Flail of the Vortex
icon: Flail of the Vortex Unfaded Icon.png
bugs: • This weapon grants the Tenacity passive but, as the Tenacity reaction is not usable while polymorphed, it never triggers.
notes:
• This is item cannot be obtained without exploits, because Air Myrmidons are Permanently Armed.
• A previous exploit involving getting the myrmidon arrested has been patched out.
• The version carried by NPC Myrmidons (as opposed to wildshape or player summons) is not enchanted and does not deal elemental damage.

name: Flame Blade
description: Flame Blade is a magical, conjured variant of the Scimitars family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon wielded in one hand. It adds the user's spellcasting modifier to its attack roll; Wisdom if summoned as a Druid spell, and Charisma if summoned by a Mephistopheles Tiefling using their subrace trait.
quote: An ethereal scimitar made of living fire
bugs: • A permanent version of this weapon can be obtained by having a druid hireling such as Danton cast Flame Blade, immediately recalling their soul, and hiring them again. A blade created in this way can be wielded by any other party member, performs up to (5d6 + Strength modifier) Fire damage, and is the only Scimitar without the Finesse property.
notes: • This weapon cannot be sheathed once equipped; it can be removed and placed in inventory.

name: Flame Enamelled Armour
description: Flame Enamelled Armour is a very rare Medium Armour. It grants a +2 bonus to Initiative, Resistance to Fire damage and +2 to all Saving Throws. It also allows the user to cast the Fire Shield: Warm spell.
quote: The air around this armour shimmers, oven-hot. From the seams of the armour you can hear a red-tinted rumble, like coals digesting in a furnace.
where_to_find: in a heavy chest in the corner of the armoury, south-west of the Wyrm's Rock waypoint, behind the iron gate
special:
Fire Shield: Warm (Action)
Cast as a level 4 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)

variants.name: Flaming Fist Helmet
variants.icon: Flaming Fist Helmet B Unfaded Icon.png
variants.description: A Flaming Fist Helmet is a common Helmet.
variants.quote: Unadorned yet intimidating for that factor, this helm speaks to the quiet nobility and equally quiet dread the Fist inspire.
variants.where_to_find: Carried by members of the Flaming Fist

variants.name: Flaming Fist Helmet
variants.description: A Flaming Fist Helmet is a common Helmet.
variants.quote: The brutish thuggery of the Enforcer's position is summarised in this helmet's design.
variants.where_to_find: Carried by members of the Flaming Fist

name: Flaming Fist Helmet
icon: Flaming Fist Helmet A Unfaded Icon.png
description: A Flaming Fist Helmet is a common Helmet.
quote: Unadorned yet intimidating for that factor, this helm speaks to the quiet nobility and equally quiet dread the Fist inspire.
where_to_find: Carried by members of the Flaming Fist
special: • Constitution Saving Throws +1

name: Flawed Helldusk Armour
description: Flawed Helldusk Armour is a rare Heavy Armour that reduces Piercing damage by 1 and possibly deals 1d4 Fire damage to attackers.
quote: 'I learned so much from Carixim. All sorts of forgecraft that... S-sorry. Just when I think of him, and the whimpers those people inside him made... I don't know. Anyway, it was worth it. Worth it to be the best.' - Overheard from the smith Dammon
where_to_find: Crafted by Dammon
notes:
• The party must give Dammon one piece of Infernal Iron. Upon obtaining the first piece, he crafts this item.
• Asking Dammon to create Flawed Helldusk Armour, the Flawed Helldusk Helmet or Flawed Helldusk Gloves requires a piece of Infernal Iron for each piece of equipment.
• Obtaining the first part of the set from Dammon grants the Hellish Armaments inspiration to characters with the Guild Artisan background.

name: Flawed Helldusk Gloves
description: Flawed Helldusk Gloves are a rare pair of gloves that grant +1d4 Fire damage to weapon attacks. Unarmed attacks deal +1d4 Necrotic damage and have a chance to inflict Bleeding.
quote: 'Beneath those horrible sounds of... well, let's call it what it was: torment, Beneath the tormented screams I heard this moaning sound like many people in pain, and I heard the ringing of a great hammer. Carixim's forge was close.' - Overheard from the smith Dammon
where_to_find: Crafted by Dammon after giving him a third piece of Infernal Iron
special: • Strength Saving Throws +1
notes: • Asking Dammon to create Flawed Helldusk Armour, the Flawed Helldusk Helmet or Flawed Helldusk Gloves requires a piece of Infernal Iron for each piece of equipment.

name: Flawed Helldusk Helmet
description: Flawed Helldusk Helmet is a rare Helmet crafted from Infernal Iron that improves the wearer's saving throws against spells by 2.
quote: 'When I found Carixim, he turned to me, all those poor people's souls crammed into him like too many bees in a rotten hive, and he... He grinned at me. And he said: I been expecting you, boy.' - Overheard from the smith Dammon
where_to_find: Crafted by Dammon
special: • Constitution Saving Throws +1
notes:
• The party must give Dammon two pieces of Infernal Iron. Upon obtaining the second piece, he crafts this item.
• Asking Dammon to create Flawed Helldusk Armour, the Flawed Helldusk Helmet or Flawed Helldusk Gloves requires a piece of Infernal Iron for each piece of equipment.

name: Fleetfingers
description: The Fleetfingers are an uncommon pair of Gloves that allow the wearer to Jump after using Dash without costing a bonus action.
quote: Plain leather with a faint but unmistakable buzz - as if eager to put idle hands to work.
where_to_find: In a buried chest after succeeding a DC 20 Perception Check
notes: • Looking at the War Map near Minthara in the Shattered SanctumX: 335 Y: 45 adds a map marker for the chest, bypassing the Perception check.

name: Fleshmelter Cloak
description: Fleshmelter Cloak is an uncommon Cloak. It deals acid damage to creatures that deal melee damage to the wearer.
quote: Droplets of foul acid drip from the tails of this cloak, as if from the stinger of a demonic scorpion.
where_to_find: In a gilded chest above the pit

name: Fleshrender
description: Fleshrender is a rare +2 Shortsword that allows the wielder to make a diabolical strike, possibly stymying their target's ability to heal.
quote: The previous owner was going to call this sword Barney, but he got such a bollocking from his friends that he named it Fleshrender instead, and sulked for a whole tenday afterward.
notes: • The player character can only purchase Fleshrender from the Echo of Abazigal if they accept becoming an Unholy Assassin of Bhaal. However, it can also be acquired through an exploit – see notes on the Echo of Abazigal page for details.

name: Flute
description: Flute is a starting instrument for the Bard. It can be played with the Perform action.
quote: It is said Diores the Charming once lured a nest of harpies to their deaths, using only a flute.
where_to_find: Starting Instrument for Bard

name: Foebreaker
description: Foebreaker is a very rare +2 Maul that ignores Bludgeoning resistance of targets.
quote: As heavy and opposed to nonsense as the kitchen cook in most stories about some young adventurous girl going to become a knight or a hedge witch or something. You've got to have a big no nonsense cook. It's like rules.
notes: • Once in the vault, upon finding the named doors, the party must go through the doors in the following order Silverhand -> Abjuration -> Silver to find a lever to unlock the Karsus vault door. Then the party must go through Demon to return to the starting room and proceed through the opened Karsus door. The chest is invisible and requires See Invisibility or Faerie Fire to reveal it.

name: Formidable Helmet
controller_icon: Item ARM Helmet Metal J Icon.png
icon: Item ARM Helmet Metal J Unfaded Icon.png
description: A Formidable Helmet is a common Helmet.
quote: Hammered from an alloy of strong mountain metals.
where_to_find: on top of a rack inside the Armoury
special: • Constitution Saving Throws +1

name: Fossilised Shell
description: The Fossilised Shell is a common Shield worn by the primitive kuo-toa of the Underdark.
quote: Sticky, rope-like seaweed is wrapped around this oversized shell, allowing it to be fashioned as a shield.
where_to_find: Equipped by several Kuo-Toa, in the Underdark

name: Frayed Drow Hood
description: A Frayed Drow Hood is a common Helmet.
quote: A supple leather cowl. Its spiderweb embroidery is stained, and pieces of leather and thread are slowly disintegrating.
where_to_find: In a backpack amongst the petrified drow, to the west of the Selûnite Outpost in the Underdark, at X: 125 Y: -253
special: • Dexterity Saving Throws +1
bugs: • Despite not having any specific magical effect, Gale can absorb this item's magic.

name: Frilly Outfit
description: Frilly Outfit is a common Camp Clothing.
quote: For the wearer who likes every ruffle and pleat just so.
where_to_find: Available in the epilogue

name: Frost Prince
image: Amulet Necklace B Silver A 1 Faded.png
controller_icon: Amulet Necklace B Silver A 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Amulet Necklace B Silver A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Frost Prince is an uncommon Amulet which grants the wearer the ability to cast the Ice Knife spell.
quote: Each sapphire feels like a tiny shard of sharpened ice.
where_to_find: In gilded chest in the southeast, near an ambush of Shadow-Cursed Needle Blights and Shadow-Cursed Vine Blights
special:
Ice Knife (Action)
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
notes: • The frost prince may be a reference to the [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Prince_of_Frost Prince of Frost], a mighty archfey of the Vale of the Long Night in the [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Feywild Feywild].

name: Frumpy Hat
description: Frumpy Hat is a common non-armour Headwear.
quote: There is something of the frumpy explorer who keeps lot of cats in the aesthetic of this hat.

name: Gale's Austere Clothes
description: Gale's Austere Clothes are a set of common Camp Clothing.
quote: Somehow, Gale has managed to make his clothes smell like a library. To inhale their aroma is to feel a sudden urge to speak more quietly. Or pay a fine.
where_to_find: Gale's starting camp clothing

name: Gandrel's Aspiration
description: Gandrel's Aspiration is an uncommon +1 Heavy Crossbow that grants Advantage against Monstrosity targets and grants the Sacred Munitions class action that Turns Undead.
quote: When Gandrel was seven, he was frightened badly by a vampire spawn during a public burning. Seized by the flames, the creature didn't shrivel up. It swelled and burst like a squeezed leech. Brains splattered the boy's shoes, grey-pink and pulpy. He would never forget it.
notes: • The description of this crossbow is almost identical to that of The Long Arm of the Gur.

description: Garb of the Land and Sky is rare piece of Clothing that grants the wearer Blade Ward when using Patient Defence. When using Step of the Wind, the wearer's next Attack Roll has Advantage and deals an additional 1d8 Force damage.
quote:
Long ago, [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Kushigo Kushigo] was a warrior. Bedecked in an enormous set of plate steel, its shoulder pauldrons fashioned like great antlered stags, his arrival on a battlefield spelled doom for the enemy.
Yet this armour - so light and fine - speaks nothing to the legacy.
where_to_find: Sold by Entharl Danthelon in Wyrm's Crossing
special: • Armour Class +1

name: Gargoyle Boots
description: Gargoyle Boots are a very rare pair of Boots that lets the wearer cast Gargoyle's Countenance, granting them resistance to Bludgeoning, Slashing and Piercing damage.
quote: These boots are heavy and slow to step in - perhaps due to the gargoyle spirit reportedly trapped within. While that legend's truth is debatable, the protection these boots offer against toe-stubbing is not.
special:
• Dexterity Saving Throws +2
Gargoyle's Countenance (Action)
Cast as a level 4 spell ( Recharge: Short rest.)

name: Gauntlet of the Tyrant
icon: Gauntlet of the Tyrant Unfaded Icon.png
description: Gauntlet of the Tyrant is a very rare Glove. It grants +1 Spell Save DC and the ability to cast the Command spell. It also adds Force damage to the wearer's unarmed attacks.
quote: A tyrant's grip must be one of cool, unforgiving, and intricately realised steel. It cannot budge, cannot falter, no matter the pressure, and its fingertips must deeply pierce those who would struggle against it.
where_to_find: Worn by Enver Gortash
special:
Command (Action)
Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
notes:
• After looting the Netherstone-Studded Gauntlet from Gortash's remains, the game automatically separates it into two new items in the interacting party member's inventory: Gortash's Netherstone and Gauntlet of Tyranny.
• Enver Gortash is in the audience hall during his coronation, and moves to his personal quarters on top of the fortress afterwards.

name: Gauntlets of Hill Giant Strength
image: Gauntlets of Hill Giant Strength Icon.png
controller_icon: Gauntlets of Hill Giant Strength Unfaded.png
icon: Gauntlets of Hill Giant Strength Unfaded Icon.png
description: Gauntlets of Hill Giant Strength are a very rare pair of Gloves that set the wearer's Strength ability score to 23.
quote: Your basic hill giant is just a landslide with a digestive system.
where_to_find: on a pedestal in the Archive
special:
• Strength Saving Throws +1
• Set the wearer's Strength to 23. The enchantment has no effect if their Strength score is higher without it.
notes:
• These gauntlets can be stolen without a fight, if the trap is disabled first with a DC 20 Sleight of Hand Check and if the Orphic Hammer / Soul-Sworn Contract and Hope are left untouched.
• These gauntlets can be stolen in lieu of perception and disarm checks, by placing an item of equal weight on the pedestal, prior to picking up the gauntlets, à la Raiders of the Lost Ark.
• According to D&D rules, this item should be named Gauntlets of Frost Giant Strength, because [https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/16867-frost-giant Frost Giants] have STR = 23 while [https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/16923-hill-giant Hill Giants] only have STR = 21. When spawned via a script, these gauntlets are named Gauntlets of Frost Giant Strength.
• These gauntlets can be pickpocketed from Helsik after given to her for the quest Acquire the Gauntlets for Helsik.

name: Gauntlets of Surging Accuracy
description: Gauntlets of Surging Accuracy are a rare pair of gloves that give the wearer a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls for the rest of their turn when using Action Surge.
quote: Made from steel hammered thin, these gauntlets are a fine investment for any warrior.
where_to_find: Sold by Lann Tarv on the main floor
special: • Strength Saving Throws +1
notes: • Disciple Z'rell must be convinced to give additional aid in finding Ketheric's relic.

name: Gauntlets of the Warmaster
icon: Gloves of Metal E Unfaded Icon.png
description: Gauntlets of the Warmaster are a very rare pair of Gauntlets. They grant their wielder +1 on Attack Rolls and subject the targets of their Manoeuvres to Disadvantage.
quote: Clothing doesn't tend to have much personality. That comes down to how it's worn. Yet these gloves exude a confidence, an intangible aura of expertise.
where_to_find: Sold by Entharl Danthelon in Wyrm's Crossing
special: • Attack rolls +1
notes: • This pair of gloves sells for more than any other in the game.

name: Gemini Gloves
description: The Gemini Gloves are a very rare pair of Gloves. They grant the wearer the ability to cast Cantrips which can target foes or allies twice.
quote: Designed by an arcane smith with half-vision. He made these gloves to make sure his spells hit their target.
where_to_find: Sold by Helsik once her special stock is unlocked

name: Giantbreaker
description: Giantbreaker is a rare +1 Heavy Crossbow that sends its targets Reeling on a successful hit.
quote: Legends say the Giantbreaker earned its name when an elven ranger singlehandedly defeated a score of hill giants. While the ranger's name is long forgotten, Giantbreaker's lives on.

name: Gibus of the Worshipful Servant
image: Gibus of the Worshipful Servant Icon.png
controller_icon: Gibus of the Worshipful Servant Unfaded.png
icon: Gibus of the Worshipful Servant Unfaded Icon.png
description: Gibus of the Worshipful Servant is a rare Headwear which grants Momentum equal to the wearer's Charisma Modifier at the start of combat and Advantage on Concentration Saving Throws.
quote: Corroded by Sceleritas' insouciant perversion, this little gibus hat was worn by the Butler before he sank throat-deep into Bhaal's clutches. Once, it was beyond besmirchment. Once, it was lovely.
where_to_find: On Sceleritas Fel if the Dark Urge refuses Bhaal's gift after defeating Orin
notes:
• This hat is not affected by most dyes, though Deep Lilac Dye applies a golden tint or wash effect, with the default colour scheme still mostly visible through the tint.
• A [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Opera_hat Gibus] is a collapsible top hat worn to the opera or other indoor venues.
• If The Dark Urge is wearing this hat when entering the Bhaal Temple, Sceleritas Fel comments on it, saying that he is honored but advising to take it off since it is "the garb of a lowly servant."

name: Githyanki Boots
description: Githyanki Boots are a common pair of Boots.
quote: Lavishly decorated boots, crafted on far-away planes from stolen metals and poached rubies.
where_to_find: Worn by Lae'zel
special: • Athletics +1

name: Githyanki Breastplate
description: Githyanki Breastplate is a rare Medium Armour
quote: Githyanki actually do have a comedy culture, and it's this: they attack anyone who makes them the butt of a joke.

name: Githyanki Crossbow
quote: This heavy crossbow is fashioned from a curious, tensile metal that doesn't seem to be native to Faerûn.

name: Githyanki Greatsword
description: The Githyanki Greatsword is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) greatsword.
quote: Though heavily decorated and inlaid with rubies, the blade's sharp edge suggests its use isn't merely ornamental.
notes: This sword can also be found in various places of githyanki influence.

name: Githyanki Greatsword
description: Githyanki Greatsword is an uncommon +1 greatsword that deals additional Psychic damage when wielded by a githyanki.
quote: Though heavily decorated and inlaid with rubies, the blade's sharp edge suggests its use isn't merely ornamental.

variants.name: Githyanki Half Plate
variants.icon: Githyanki Half Plate B Unfaded Icon.png
variants.description: Githyanki Half Plate is a common Medium Armour worn by the Githyanki.
variants.quote: This armour was forged to Vlaakith's standards under the exacting eye of a githyanki smith.

variants.icon: Githyanki Half Plate C Unfaded Icon.png
variants.description: Githyanki Half Plate is a common Medium Armour worn by the Githyanki.
