name: Githyanki Half Plate
description: Githyanki Half Plate is a common Medium Armour worn by Lae'zel and other Githyanki throughout the game.
quote: This armour was forged to Vlaakith's standards under the exacting eye of a githyanki smith.
where_to_find: Worn by Lae'zel

name: Githyanki Longsword
quote: Every tip and edge on this elaborate sword is sharpened to a deadly perfection.

name: Githyanki Longsword (+1)
icon: Githyanki Longsword Plus One Unfaded Icon.png
description: Githyanki Longsword is an uncommon, lightly enchanted longsword.
quote: Every tip and edge on this elaborate sword is sharpened to a deadly perfection.

name: Githyanki Longsword (Psionic)
quote: Every tip and edge on this elaborate sword is sharpened to a deadly perfection.

name: Githyanki Shortsword
quote: Despite its engravings, this lightweight sword is perfectly balanced - a flawless killing implement.

name: Githyanki Shortsword
icon: Githyanki Shortsword Plus One Unfaded Icon.png
quote: Despite its engravings, this lightweight sword is perfectly balanced - a flawless killing implement.

name: Gladitorial Sandals
description: Gladitorial Sandals is a common pair of Camp Shoes.
quote: Worn by warriors upon the bloodiest sands.
where_to_find: Throughout the game as set-dressing and random loot

name: Glaive
description: Glaive is a common variant of the Glaives family of weapons.
quote: Simple but sharp. The shaft of this glaive is worn smooth with use.
notes: • The room can be opened by sitting on the two thrones X: -664 Y: -407, X: -664 Y: -400 simultaneously or by placing objects on each throne.

name: Glaive +1
description: Glaive +1 is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) Glaive.
quote: Fashioned by expert elven hands to be both deadly and beautiful.

name: Glaive +2
description: Glaive +2 is a rare, enchanted (+2) Glaive.
quote: Tiny specks of blood are fused into the blade, as if the glaive is feeding on them.

name: Gleamdance Dagger
description: Gleamdance Dagger is a rare +2 Dagger that sheds light in a radius and increases the wielder's Armour Class if equipped in their off-hand.
quote: A pair of pixie wings were used to create this pretty blade - their delicate tracings can be seen all day and night, though they shine brightest by the light of a gibbous moon.

name: Glimmergad's Selgaunt Fiddle
description:
Glimmergad's Selgaunt Fiddle is a unique instrument. It can be played with the Perform action.
This variant is functionally no different from the regular Violin.
quote: The notorious gnomish bard Fiddlesticks Glimmergad was said to play violin tunes so sad they made bank guards weep - while his accomplices robbed the bank's vaults.
where_to_find: Can be purchased from Thomas C. Quirkilious
notes: • In Forgotten Realms lore, [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Selgaunt Selgaunt] is a city located on the [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Sea_of_Fallen_Stars Sea of Fallen Stars] and the capital of the country of [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Sembia Sembia].

name: Glittering Garb
icon: Camp Rich B Red Unfaded Icon.webp
description: Glittering Garb is a common Camp Clothing.
quote: Gold, gold, gold, from sternum to thigh - that's how you make an entrance.
where_to_find: Available in the epilogue

name: Glittering Slippers
description: Glittering Slippers is a common pair of Camp Shoes.
quote: Gold on your toes. The very height of luxury.
where_to_find: Available only in the epilogue

name: Gloomstrand Shield
description: Gloomstrand Shield is an uncommon Shield that adds +1 to Stealth
quote: Supposedly fashioned around a lock of hair stolen from the head of the Prince of Gloomwrought, shields of this ilk gladly welcome the dark.
where_to_find: In a locked traveller's chest on a pier across the Reithwin Tollhouse, next to the half-ruined wooden bridge. The chest can be opened with the Key (Reithwin Tollhouse).
special: • Stealth +1

variants.name: Gloves
variants.description: Gloves are a common pair of Gloves. While coming in varying appearances, these gloves offer no benefits beyond cosmetic appeal or as an item to sell off.
variants.quote: Treated animal hide is hammered taught into these gloves, offering protection against hostile climes but little else.
variants.where_to_find:
In the Morgue area of the Mind Flayer Colony in a pile of discarded armour and clothing
• In a crate at Dammon's forge in the Emerald Grove.

name: Gloves
description: Gloves are a common pair of Gloves. While coming in varying appearances, these gloves offer no benefits beyond cosmetic appeal or as an item to sell off.
quote: These padded vambraces balances light protection with a dextrous expression impossible in heftier gauntlets.
where_to_find: In the Morgue area of the Mind Flayer Colony in a pile of discarded armour and clothing

name: Gloves of Archery
description: Gloves of Archery are an uncommon pair of Gloves that grant the wearer Proficiency with Longbows and Shortbows, as well as +2 damage with ranged weapon attacks.
quote: Banded in dark iron, these gloves are embossed with the brass likeness of an elf against a trio of arrows in flight.
where_to_find: Sold by Grat the Trader

name: Gloves of Baneful Striking
description: The Gloves of Baneful Striking are an uncommon pair of Gloves. They apply a penalty to saving throws against the wearer's spells when previously struck by a weapon attack from the wearer.
quote: The slightest movement of leather makes a dark energy seep out of the gloves.
where_to_find: Sold by Lady Esther, north-east of the Trielta Crags waypoint

name: Gloves of Battlemage's Power
description: Gloves of Battlemage's Power is a rare pair of Gloves. They allow the wearer to gain Arcane Acuity whenever they hit a target with a spell or cantrip that uses a weapon.
quote: Bands of blue light snap and contract when the gloved fingertips are pressed together - evidence of the arcane polarity linking them.
where_to_find: in a locked opulent chest on the second floor in the room with two locked doors
special: • Strength Saving Throws +1
notes:
• DC 10 Sleight of Hand Check can be used to unlock the chest that contains these gloves.
• These Gloves' functions were redesigned in Patch 8.

name: Gloves of Belligerent Skies
icon: Gloves of Belligerent Skies Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Gloves of Belligerent Skies are an uncommon pair of Gloves that inflict Reverberation when the wearer deals Thunder, Lightning or Radiant damage.
quote: Balling your fingers into fists while wearing these gloves causes a sonorous chime, like the fusion of a tempest and a church bell, to resound inside your skull.
where_to_find: In an elegant chest in the Inquisitor's Chamber, along the southern wall of the room, on the western side

name: Gloves of Cinder and Sizzle
image: Gloves of Cinder and Sizzle Icon.png
controller_icon: Gloves of Cinder and Sizzle Unfaded.png
icon: Gloves of Cinder and Sizzle Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Gloves of Cinder and Sizzle are a rare pair of Gloves that add Fire damage to the wearer's unarmed attacks and the ability to cast Scorching Ray once per Long Rest.
quote: It was through scrying and observing blazing elementals that the monks of Plumgully Temple mastered the art of fighting fire with fists, and vice versa.
where_to_find: Sold by Lady Esther, north-east of the Trielta Crags waypoint
special:
Scorching Ray (Action)
Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
notes: • This is one of five Monk-oriented handwear items with similar properties. Each grants 1d4 bonus damage of a different type on unarmed attacks and allows casting a different upcasted spell once per long rest. The others are Seraphic Pugilist Gloves, Servitor of the Black Hand Gloves, Snow-Dusted Monastery Gloves, and Thunderpalm Strikers.

notes_links.text: Servitor of the Black Hand Gloves
notes_links.page: Servitor of the Black Hand Gloves

name: Gloves of Crushing
description: Gloves of Crushing are a rare pair of gloves that enhance unarmed attack rolls and grant bonus Bludgeoning damage to unarmed attacks.
quote: Stitched into the fabric of these gloves are the words: Largest and Largesse, For The Discerning Murderer.
where_to_find: Sold by Roah Moonglow on the main floor

name: Gloves of Dexterity
description: The Gloves of Dexterity are a very rare pair of gloves that give a character 18 Dexterity and increase their Attack Rolls by 1.
quote: The point at which the gloves meet the wrist is form-fitting and very snug; almost a hint at the supple quickness and skill these gloves permit the wearer.
where_to_find: Sold by A'jak'nir Jeera
special:
• Set the wearer's Dexterity score to 18. The enchantment has no effect if their Dexterity score is higher without it.
• Attack rolls +1
notes:
• If the character's base Dexterity is below 10, skill check screens will show a -1 from Dexterity and a +5 from the gloves.
• The +1 to attack rolls includes spell attacks.
• The +2 Dexterity bonus from The Graceful Cloth's Cat's Grace does not stack.

name: Gloves of Fire Resistance
icon: Gloves of Fire Resistance Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Gloves of Fire Resistance are an uncommon pair of gloves that grant the wearer Resistance to Fire damage while heavily wounded.
quote: These gloves are cool to the touch, chilling the tips of the wearer's fingers.
where_to_find: Rewarded by Derryth Bonecloak for completing Find the Mushroom Picker (Early Access only)
notes:
• This reward was changed to Gloves of Uninhibited Kushigo in the full release of the game.
• Quest reward was a choice between this item and Gloves of Flint and Steel

name: Gloves of Flint and Steel
description: The Gloves of Flint and Steel are an uncommon pair of gloves that allow the wearer to set enemies ablaze whenever they deal Fire damage.
quote: Carixim, a fiendish smith of hell who gorged himself fat on souls by the thousand, did not consider himself to have enemies, though many hated him dearly.
where_to_find: Rewarded by Derryth Bonecloak for completing Find the Mushroom Picker (Early Access only)
notes:
• This reward was changed to Gloves of Uninhibited Kushigo in the full release of the game.
• Quest reward was a choice between this item and Gloves of Fire Resistance.

name: Gloves of Hail of Thorns
description: Gloves of Hail of Thorns are an uncommon pair of Gloves that grants the wearer the to ability to cast Hail of Thorns.
quote: Grants wearer ability to cast Hail of Thorns. Whoever previously owned these gloves marked each with a series of thirty superficial scrapes, six per finger. What they indicate is unclear.
where_to_find: Sold by Brem after completing the quest Find the Missing Shipment
special:
Hail of Thorns (Action)
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Short rest.)
notes: • The version of Hail of Thorns cast using these gloves requires only an Action, while casting it normally with spell slots costs an Action and a Bonus Action.

name: Gloves of Heroism
description: The Gloves of Heroism are an uncommon pair of gloves that grants their wearer Heroism whenever using Channel Oath spells.
quote: Suede covers the palms of these gloves — ensuring a soft, comforting touch for anyone in need of help.
where_to_find: In a wooden chest at the back of the hidden room in the cellar of the Toll House
special: • Strength Saving Throws +1
notes: • The hidden room can be opened by sitting on the two thrones X: -664 Y: -407, X: -664 Y: -400 simultaneously (or by placing objects on each throne).

name: Gloves of Missile Snaring
icon: Gloves of Missile Snaring Unfaded Icon.png
description: Gloves of Missile Snaring is a rare pair of gloves that allow the wearer to use Missile Snaring to reduce incoming ranged damage as a Reaction.
quote: These gloves seem to meld to your skin - supple, snug and dextrous as one could hope for.
where_to_find: Sold by Arron next to the Silvanus statue
bugs: • Against ranged attacks that fire multiple projectiles, such as Multiattack (Ranged) or dual wielded Hand Crossbows, only the last attack can be intercepted to reduce its damage.

name: Gloves of Power
description: Gloves of Power are an uncommon pair of Gloves that allow the wearer to inflict Bane on weapon attacks.
quote: Blessed by Priestess Gut, these gauntlets provide additional aid to any who bear the Absolute's mark upon their flesh.
where_to_find: Carried by Za'krug in front of the Druid Grove
special: • Sleight of Hand +1

name: Gloves of Soul Catching
icon: Gloves of Soul Catching Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Gloves of Soul Catching are a legendary pair of Gloves. They grant additional Force damage to unarmed attacks, +2 Constitution, and heal the wearer after an unarmed attack.
quote: Formerly worn by Autumnal Baskin, a professional meditator turned bare-knuckle champion, who gained enlightenment via two methods. The second was getting a lot of fighting acumen. Advanced cosmic harmony is a nose. Sometimes you've got to break it a few times to get the best of things.
where_to_find: Given by Hope for completing her quest Save Hope
special: • Constitution +2, up to 20

name: Gloves of Succour
description: The Gloves of Succour are an uncommon pair of gloves that grant a creature healed by a Paladin's Lay on Hands resistance against weapon attacks.
quote: Suede covers the palms of these gloves - ensuring a soft, comforting touch for anyone in need of help.
special: • Strength Saving Throws +1
notes: • This item was only obtainable in Early Access. It was replaced by Gloves of Heroism in the full release of the game.

name: Gloves of The Duellist
description: Gloves of The Duellist are a rare pair of Gloves that enhance melee weapon Attack Rolls when the wearer only holds one weapon in their main hand.
quote: Ways of beginning a duel have varied over the years. Perhaps the most famous is the Bildumbacher Method, in which the instigator drips paint thinner onto the opponent's socks.
where_to_find: Sold by Lann Tarv on the main floor

name: Gloves of Thievery
description: Gloves of Thievery are an uncommon pair of Gloves that give the wearer Advantage on Sleight of Hand checks.
quote: Useful for bank vaults, locked chests, and bolted barns.
where_to_find: Sold by Brem after completing the quest Find the Missing Shipment
special: • Advantage on Sleight of Hand Checks.

name: Gloves of Uninhibited Kushigo
image: Gloves of Cinder and Sizzle Icon.png
controller_icon: Gloves of Cinder and Sizzle Unfaded.png
icon: Gloves of Cinder and Sizzle Unfaded Icon.png
description: Gloves of Uninhibited Kushigo is a rare pair of gloves that deals additional damage with Throw and Improvised Weapon attacks.
quote: Forsaking his infamous armour, [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Kushigo Kushigo] left Irishi's body and wandered naked, without thought or care, into the barren countryside. The land was flat and desolate under the red-gold sun, but compared to his lonely heart, it seemed alive with joy.
where_to_find: Reward by Derryth Bonecloak for saving Baelen Bonecloak during Find the Mushroom Picker
notes: • These gloves work well with the Ring of Flinging and Tavern Brawler feat.

name: Gloves of the Automaton
description: The Gloves of the Automaton are a rare pair of Gloves which, when activated, cause the wearer to be treated as a Construct and grant Advantage on weapon attacks for 10 turns.
quote: Llena the Many-Times-Married would use these gloves to blend in with the statues in her courtyard. This would allow her to avoid her plethora of husbands. Anything for a moment's peace.
where_to_find: Sold by Barcus Wroot at his workshop
special:
• Strength Saving Throws +1.
Circuitry Interface (Bonus Action)
You are considered a construct. Your weapon Attack rolls have Advantage, and you have resistance to Lightning damage. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
notes:
• Being treated as a construct via Circuitry Interface prevents the wearer from being targeted by healing spells. However, they can still be healed by drinking healing potions or having allies Throw these potions at them.
• While active, Circuitry Interface prevents Light of Creation from Stunning its wielder.
• If unequipped after activation, the remaining duration of Circuitry Interface still applies to the wearer.

name: Gloves of the Balanced Hands
description: Gloves of the Balanced Hands are a rare pair of Gloves that add the wearer's Ability Modifier to damage when they make an attack with their off-hand weapon.
quote: Formerly worn by Doubleway Douglas Fairbanks, who was so ambidextrous his tears ran down the back of his neck.
where_to_find: Sold by Quartermaster Talli near the Last Light Inn waypoint
notes:
• The gloves work with both melee and ranged weapons.
• These gloves do not stack with other sources of Two-Weapon Fighting.
• Despite the name, these are actually bracers which cover the wearer's forearms and leave their hands bare.

name: Gloves of the Growling Underdog
icon: Gloves of Metal E Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Gloves of the Growling Underdog are an uncommon pair of Gloves which grant the wearer Advantage on their melee attack rolls while surrounded by 2 or more enemies.
quote: Crowded taprooms. Packed feast halls. Bustling market bazaars. Chances to be social? Sure. Chances to be violent? Absolutely.
where_to_find: In Dror Ragzlin's treasure crates behind the locked iron gate
special: • Strength Saving Throws +1
notes:
• This item can sometimes instead be found inside a treasure crate after passing a Survival check on the Rosymorn Monastery Trail X: -118 Y: -134.
• Despite their appearance, these gloves do not count as Armour and can be used alongside Unarmoured Defence and similar effects.

name: Glowing Shield
description: The Glowing Shield is an uncommon Shield that grants its user Temporary Hit Points once per Short Rest when they take damage while greatly injured.
quote: Soft, loving whispers emanate from this shield. Though barely audible and spoken in some long-forgotten language, they make you feel safe.
where_to_find: In a locked chest on a ridge behind the camp

name: Gnarled Tree Branch
description: Gnarled Tree Branch is a Greatclub used by some ogres. It can only be obtained by disarming opponents and cannot be wielded by player characters.
quote: A heavy branch ripped from the trunk of an oak tree.
special: Not usable by humanoids.

name: Goblin Bow
description: Goblin Bow is the favoured ranged weapon among Goblins. Besides appearances, it functions exactly like a normal Shortbow.
quote: Fashioned together from a rough-cut branch and stinking sinew.

name: Goblin Scimitar
description:
Goblin Scimitar is a common variant of the Scimitars family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon wielded in one hand. As a finesse weapon, it can benefit from the wielder's Dexterity and not just their Strength. It's a light weapon that anyone can dual-wield without special training.
Beyond appearances, it has the same stats of a normal Scimitar.
quote: A cruel and crude blade forged en masse by goblin hordes.

name: Goblinbane Dagger
description: Goblinbane Dagger is an uncommon dagger that grants the wielder defensive capabilities against Goblins. Any goblin attacking the wielder of Goblinbane suffers from Disadvantage on its Attack Rolls.
quote: ‘No goblin will strike you down’ is etched into this dagger's handle. When goblin assailants realised they couldn't kill the dagger's original owner, they gave him to the worgs, who made short work of him.
notes: • This dagger is identical to Worgfang except for its name.

description: A Gold Ring is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for barter or sale to Traders.
quote: A date was once engraved on the inside of this ring, but most of it has long since been worn away by time.
where_to_find: In chests and carried by characters throughout the game

name: Gold Wyrmling Staff
description: Gold Wyrmling Staff is a rare +1 Quarterstaff that deals additional Fire damage with melee strikes and grants its wielder the Fire Bolt cantrip.
quote: The fire engulfing this staff seems to feed off thin air, never once burning the dark wood.
special:
Fire Bolt (Action)
Cast as a cantrip at will.
notes: • Despite being dippable, dipping this staff in surfaces such as fire or poison does not actually apply a damage buff to the weapon. Similarly, coatings also have no effect.

name: Goldgloss Heraldic Helm
description: The Goldgloss Heraldic Helm is a common Helmet.
quote: Hard as golden dragonscales.
where_to_find: On a table/shelf in the Morgue
special: • Constitution Saving Throws +1

name: Gontr Mael
description: Gontr Mael is a legendary +3 Longbow that can possibly inflict Guiding Bolt on its target and grants the wielder the Celestial Haste spell and Bolt of Celestial Light actions.
quote: Gontr Mael blasted from the corpse of the Steelwatcher Titan: a bow formed from the boiling slag and weird whispering gyros inherent to the mechanical giant. It must have acted as the Titan's abdomen, exchanging muscle for immaculate steel.
special:
Celestial Haste (Action)
Gain Hastened. ( Recharge: Long rest.)
notes: • Does not drop if the Steel Watcher Titan is killed by the Atrophied condition.

name: Gordis' Dog Collar
description: Gordis' Dog Collar is a common Amulet. Primarily of use for barter or sale to Traders.
quote: Smells a bit rusty, but looks stylish nonetheless
where_to_find: Carried by Houndmaster Pol
notes: • Belonged to Gordis when they lived.

variants.name: Greataxe
variants.description: Greataxe is a common variant of the Greataxes family of weapons.
variants.quote: A relatively austere greataxe of rough-hewn wood and sharpened iron.

name: Greataxe
description: Greataxe is a common variant of the Greataxes family of weapons.
quote: The rectangular engravings on this axe's wooden handle have been nearly scratched away by armoured hands.

name: Greataxe +1
description: Greataxe +1 is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) Greataxe.
quote: A small prayer decorates the hilt of this axe. It resonates in your head when you touch it.
notes: The room in the Risen Road Toll House can be opened by a party member sitting on each of the two thrones at X: -664 Y: -407, and X: -664 Y: -400 simultaneously or by placing objects on each throne.

name: Greataxe +2
description: Greataxe +2 is a rare, moderately enchanted (+2) Greataxe.
quote: This heavy axe emits a barely audible hum when swung.

name: Greatclub
quote: Traces of dried viscera ring many of the iron spikes embedded in this oak club.

name: Greatclub
controller_icon: Item WPN MINOTAUR Greatclub A Unfaded.png
icon: Item WPN MINOTAUR Greatclub A Unfaded Icon.png
description: Greatclub is a mundane, nonmagical variant of the Greatclubs family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon which is wielded with both hands. It cannot be wielded by humanoids.
quote: Heavy, spiked branches bound together with rope and sinew. It's hard to imagine a cruder weapon, but it is effective.
special: Not usable by humanoids.
notes:
• This weapon can only be obtained by forcing a Minotaur to drop their weapon.
• The Gloves of the Automaton do not enable the use of this weapon.

name: Greatclub +1
description: Greatclub +1 is an uncommon lightly enchanted (+1) Greatclub.
quote: Without the wrapped leather grip, the weight of the slab of iron at the end of this greatclub would send it flying with a single swing.

name: Greatclub +2
description: Greatclub +2 is a rare, moderately enchanted (+2) Greatclub.
quote: A blue glow radiates through the brass spirals at the end of this heavy club.

variants.name: Greatsword
variants.description: Greatsword is a common variant of the Greatswords family of weapons.
variants.quote: This sword's guard, held haphazardly in place by thin rope, wobbles slightly when swung.

name: Greatsword
description: Greatsword is a common variant of the Greatswords family of weapons.
quote: Innumerable whetstones have rendered this sword's blade nearly paper-thin.
notes:
• This greatsword is less common than than the primary variant.
• Both versions of this greatsword can be used to create the Sussur Greatsword as part of Finish the Masterwork Weapon.

name: Greatsword +1
description: Greatsword +1 is an uncommon, lightly enchanted Greatsword.
quote: The thick leather straps wrapped around the base of the blade creak under a solid grip.

name: Greatsword +1
description: Greatsword +1 is a common variant of the Greatswords family of weapons.
quote: A rune etched into the base of this expertly-forged sword identifies its dwarven blacksmith.
bugs: • Despite its name, this weapon does not provide a +1 enchantment bonus as the Stats value in its Item Template is incorrectly pointed towards the common version of a Greatsword.

name: Green Flare Leather Outfit
description: Green Flare Leather Outfit is a set of common Camp Clothing.
quote: A minimalist leather binding get-up that clings to the skin and creaks just the slightest bit when you move.
where_to_find:
Randomly sold by traders in Act Three:
• Carmen Pennygood at Carm's Garms in Wyrm's Crossing
• Figaro Pennygood at Facemaker's Boutique in the Lower City
• Randomly generated in wardrobes within Sharess' Caress and safes in The Counting House

name: Grovetender Boots
description: Grovetender Boots are a common pair of Boots.
quote: These boots are well-maintained and clean, though their soles are thin from wear.
where_to_find: Starting boots for Druids

name: Grubby Ochre Clothes
description: Grubby Ochre Clothes (Dark Urge) is a common Camp Clothing.
quote: Perhaps once pretty, now musty and worn.
where_to_find: Available only in the epilogue

name: Grubby Ochre Clothes (Dark Urge)
description: Grubby Ochre Clothes (Dark Urge) is a common Camp Clothing.
quote: Perhaps once pretty, now musty and worn.
where_to_find: Available only to the Dark Urge in the epilogue

name: Grymskull Helm
description: The Grymskull Helm is a very rare helmet. It grants fire resistance, protects its wearer from critical hits and grants the Hunter's Mark spell.
quote: Once home to an inscrutable machine intelligence, Grym's skull now serves as a simple helm.
where_to_find: Carried by Grym
special:
• Attackers can't land Critical Hits on the wearer.
• Grants Resistance to Fire damage.
Hunter's Mark (Action)
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
bugs: • This item can be unequipped after casting Hunter's Mark from it; the caster will still receive the use of Hunter's Mark until long rest or concentration is broken.
notes: • This item cannot be dyed, except by using Deep Lilac Dye, which changes the entire helmet to a golden tint (not the same as normally seen when using this dye on other items).

name: Guiding Light
icon: Ring D Gold A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Guiding Light is a story-related Ring that allows the wearer to cast the Light cantrip.
quote: Used by the previous owner to access both the Underdark's darkest corners and her own basement, this ring seems to reflect light where there should be none.
where_to_find: Carried by Bernard at the top floor
special:
Light (Action)
Cast as a cantrip at will.
notes:
• This ring can be obtained by telling Bernard the appropriate play line. Alternatively, it can be looted from Bernard after defeating it.
• While this ring is equipped, it reveals secret elevator buttons on the elevator panels of top and the bottom floors of the Arcane Tower. The buttons get the elevator down to the basement.
• Once the Light cantrip is cast on the wearer the ring can be unequipped and the spell effect remains.
• The spell can be cast by multiple party members this way, for multiple sources of light.

variants.name: Guild Ring
variants.description: Guild Ring is an uncommon ring found in Act 3.
variants.quote: Calishite emeralds are embedded in this heavy silver ring.

name: Guild Ring
description: Guild Ring is a story-related Ring found in Act 3.
quote: Calishite emeralds are embedded in this heavy silver ring.
where_to_find:
Carried by Tusgront in the Lower City at X: 58 Y: -102
• In a locked wooden chest ( DC 15 Sleight of Hand Check) in the Lower City at X: 58 Y: -102
• In the basement of the same house, in a trapped chest ( DC 15 Sleight of Hand Check) hidden behind a pressure-plate activated false wall at X: -2325 Y: 1056
notes: • This ring can be inserted into the wall slot at X: 59 Y: -97 to reveal the entrance to the Guildhall. Using it this way will transform it into the uncommon variant of this item.

name: Hag's Ring
description: Hag's Ring is an uncommon Ring that grants the wearer access to Vicious Mockery
quote: Grimy, discoloured, and revoltingly ugly. Auntie Ethel must have made it herself. Surprisingly, you feel no disgust. Instead it fills you with a longing, as if it's calling out for its like.
special:
Vicious Mockery (Action)
Cast as a cantrip at will.

name: Halberd
description: Halberd is a common variant of the Halberds family of weapons.
quote: Part of the spike affixed to the top of this halberd has snapped off, leaving a cruel barb.

name: Halberd +1
description: Halberd +1 is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) Halberd.
quote: This halberd's spike is black with ash that cannot be washed away.

name: Halberd of Vigilance
description: Halberd of Vigilance is a very rare +2 Halberd that deals additional Force damage, gives a bonus to Initiative, and grants Advantage on Perception checks and Reactions.
quote: A variant of this halberd's design was thrown out in the early stages of development by its forgemaster. This was because the halberd kept expressing itself. 'ALARM!' it would shriek in peril. 'POTENCY FILLS ME LIKE A SONG OF HOPE!' it roared in triumph.

variants.name: Half Plate Armour
variants.image: Half Plate Armour Flaming Fist Faded.png
variants.controller_icon: Half Plate Armour Flaming Fist Unfaded.png
variants.icon: Half Plate Armour Flaming Fist Unfaded Icon.png
variants.description: Half Plate Armour is a common Medium Armour.
variants.quote: This heavy, resilient breastplate is reinforced by a padded gambeson to protect soldiers from hip to neck.

variants.image: Half Plate Armour Flaming Fist B Faded.png

variants.description: Half Plate Armour is a common Medium Armour.
