name: Half Plate Armour
description: Half Plate Armour is a common Medium Armour.
quote: This heavy, resilient breastplate is reinforced by a padded gambeson to protect soldiers from hip to neck.
where_to_find: Sold by A'jak'nir Jeera
notes: • Shares an icon and possibly a model with the Flame Enamelled Armour.

variants.name: Half Plate Armour +1
variants.description: Half Plate Armour +1 is a uncommon Medium Armour that reduces Piercing damage.
variants.quote: Heraldic runes are sewn into the padding of this armour, offering a gift of protection to whoever dons it.
variants.where_to_find: Sold by traders using the levelled magic armour table if the player is between levels 6 and 8

name: Half Plate Armour +1
description: Half Plate Armour +1 is a uncommon Medium Armour that reduces Piercing damage.
quote: Heraldic runes are sewn into the padding of this armour, offering a gift of protection to whoever dons it.

name: Half Plate Armour +2
icon: Half Plate Armour PlusTwo Unfaded Icon.png
description: Half Plate Armour +2 is a rare Medium Armour that moderately reduces Piercing damage.
quote: This breastplate is far tougher than it appears, taking blows from common weapons without suffering so much as a scratch.
where_to_find: Sold by traders using the levelled magic armour table if the player is level 9 or above

name: Halsin's Grove Garments
description: Halsin's Grove Garments are a common set of Camp Clothing.
quote: Feeling the fabric, the strangest feeling occurs: your thumbs brush sun-dappled leaves, skim the water of a creek, tangle in the fur of some panting animal, heat and breath.
where_to_find: Halsin's starting camp clothing

name: Halsin's Underwear
description: Halsin's Underwear are common Underwear.
quote: Why does it smell like a herb garden?
where_to_find: Halsin's starting underwear
notes: • Underwear cannot be looted regularly. A party member must pick up the corpse to loot the underwear.

name: Hamarhraft
description: Hamarhraft is an uncommon Maul that deals Thunder damage in an area around the wielder when they land a Jump.
quote: The Dwarven grammar is garbled, but the weapon's name suggests something about the importance of first impressions.
notes:
• If the party long rest after saving Florrick and Benryn, the fire in the building is extinguished and the chest is destroyed, but the weapon inside is still intact and can be picked up.
• Because Shockwave triggers on every Jump taken during a turn, wielding this weapon while using Step of the Wind allows for many triggers of Shockwave in one turn.
• Shockwave does not require a jump in order to trigger. It can also trigger when landing from Fly and actions with similar effects but different names.
• This item pairs well with Crusher's Ring and / or Eagle Heart.

name: Hammer of the Just
description: Hammer of the Just is a rare +2 Warhammer which allows the wielder to cast Detect Thoughts and deals additional Radiant damage. It also deals additional Bludgeoning damage to Fiends and Undead.
quote: Tyr is often known as the Maimed God - a descriptor he shares with most victims of this heavy warhammer.
special:
Detect Thoughts (Action)
Cast as a level 2 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
notes:
• The basement of the Stormshore Tabernacle can be reached by entering the secret hatch in the corner of the tabernacle.
• Looting any of the items from the offering chests curses the player with Castigated By Divinity.

name: Hammergrim Mist Amulet
image: Amulet Necklace A Gold A 1 Faded.png
controller_icon: Amulet Necklace A Gold A 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Amulet Necklace A Gold A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Hammergrim Mist Amulet is an uncommon Amulet that grants the wearer the ability to cast the Fog Cloud spell.
quote: One of the relics of Deep Duerra's rebellious children. Drugging the Keykeeper of Duerra's vaults, the children crept in under cover of night and plundered their mother's treasure - searching desperately for anything that would aid in their flight.
where_to_find: In a locked chest tucked away in ruined house in the Shadow-Cursed Lands, east of the tollhouse
special:
Fog Cloud (Action)
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
notes: • This version of Fog Cloud does not require concentration.

name: Hand Crossbow
quote: The spring locks back with the tiniest, most satisfying click.

name: Hand Crossbow
description: A unique hand crossbow wielded exclusively by Yurgir.
quote: The spring locks back with the tiniest, most satisfying click.
special: Not usable by humanoids.
notes:
• This weapon is only obtainable by disarming Yurgir.
• If Yurgir is disarmed and survives the battle with Raphael, picking up his weapons causes him to become aggressive.

name: Hand Crossbow +1
quote: A subtle magic runs through both strings of this crossbow, keeping the bows even once the lack is released.

name: Hand Crossbow +2
quote: Though the crossbow is small and light, a heavy power runs through its bowstring.

variants.name: Hand Drum
variants.description: Hand Drum is a starting instrument for the Bard. It can be played with the Perform action.
variants.quote: Whether sounding war, celebration, or simple rhythm, the drum is a main-stay of any entertainer's arsenal.
variants.where_to_find: Starting Instrument for bards

name: Hand Drum
description: Hand Drum is a starting instrument for the Bard. It can be played with the Perform action.
quote: The skin and wood of this drum has been replaced countless times. Is it even the same instrument?
where_to_find: TBD

variants.name: Handaxe
variants.quote: A straightforward hatchet, dulled slightly from chopping wood - or bones.

name: Handaxe
quote: A straightforward hatchet, dulled slightly from chopping wood - or bones.
notes: • This variant of the handaxe deals less damage and can only be acquired by disarming a Lesser Imp, for example, with Command: Drop.

name: Handaxe +1
quote: This axe's hooked blade is crafted to cleave flesh and bone.

name: Handmaiden's Mace
description: Handmaiden's Mace is a very rare +2 Mace which sets the wielder's Strength to 18.
quote: This mace was designed by Lolth's assassins to fell heretics who dared turn their back on the Spider Queen. However, even the best-laid designs fall to nothingness when brought to bear against Shar's faithfull.
special: • Set the wearer's Strength score to 18. The enchantment has no effect if their Strength score is higher without it.
bugs: • It is not stated anywhere in-game, but this mace Poisons targets on hit if a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw is failed. The save for this effect is not shown in the combat log.
notes: • The Handmaiden's Mace is also found in Baldur's Gate 2. The description of the item in Baldur's Gate 3 refers to the events of the previous storyline.

notes_links.page: List of references to previous Baldur's Gate games

name: Hardily Constructed Boots
description: Hardily Constructed Boots are a common pair of boots.
quote: Made of tough, well-worn leather, these boots have survived years of use, and can survive many more.

name: Harmonic Dueller
description: Harmonic Dueller is a rare +1 Rapier that when activated, can grant all the wielder's melee attacks extra damage equal to their Charisma modifier.
quote: Unsheathed, the steel of this rapier shivers and thrums mellifluously in response to nearby surfaces - the motion brings to mind an actor struck with pre-show nerves.
notes: • Mellow Harmony can apply its damage bonus multiple times to a single melee weapon attack.

name: Harmonium Halberd
description: Harmonium Halberd is a rare +1 Halberd that grants its wielder additional Strength at the cost of some Intelligence and Wisdom.
quote: The platinum inlays of this halberd hum an otherworldy harmony in the key of C, heightening the wielder's vigour but diminishing their mental faculties. The sound it makes is pining, as if far from its rightful home.
special:
• Strength +2 (up to 23)
• Intelligence -1
• Wisdom -1
notes:
• [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Harmonium_halberd Harmonium Halberds] are enchanted polearms wielded by the members of the [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Harmonium Harmonium] faction in the planar city of [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Sigil Sigil].
• It also previously appeared in Baldur's Gate II: Shadows of Amn.

notes_links.text: previously appeared in ''Baldur's Gate II: Shadows of Amn''
notes_links.page: List of references to previous Baldur's Gate games

name: Harold
description: Harold is a rare +1 Heavy Crossbow that can possibly Bane targets that it hits.
quote: Named after Harold Butterbisk, who opened the Butterbisk Inn in Waterdeep before it was renamed by new owners. The stock of the crossbow reads: Quaffing is a shootable offence.
notes:
• For Zarys to reward the party with this item, they must either have not made a deal with Rugan to pretend that the shipment is lost, or they must have killed Rugan and Olly after doing so and before entering the Zhentarim hideout. If Zarys learns of any misdealing the party members are locked out of acquiring this item, since it cannot be looted or bought.
• Harold is also found in [https://baldursgate.fandom.com/wiki/Baldur%27s_Gate:_Siege_of_Dragonspear Baldur's Gate: Siege of Dragonspear]. However, the description of the item [https://baldursgate.fandom.com/wiki/Harold Harold] differs slightly from the new one. That weapon had a chance of inflicting [https://baldursgate.fandom.com/wiki/Doom Doom], as the spell Bane did not exist in the Advanced Dungeons & Dragons 2nd Edition ruleset used by the older games.

name: Harper Blade
quote: A common and effective sword, carried by adventurers, thieves, and watchmen alike.
notes: • The Harper Blade can be given to Meygan at the Last Light Inn for 125 Gold reward.

name: Harper Boots
description: Harper Boots is a common pair of Camp Shoes.
quote: Standard issue boots that may or may be modified depending on the wearer's needs. Examples include hidden knives, poison darts, and so on.
where_to_find: Available only to Jaheira in the epilogue if she remains a member of the Harpers

name: Harper Finery
description: Harper Finery is a common Camp Clothing.
quote: Scrubbed to an inch of its life, the barely visible bloodstains on this Harper garb suggest it has seen more than a few 'parties'.
where_to_find: Available only to Jaheira in the epilogue if she remains a member of the Harpers

name: Harper Sacredstriker
description: Harper Sacredstriker is a rare +1 Quarterstaff that grants the wielder the Spiritual Weapon spell at level 6.
quote: This quarterstaff is as solid as the bond between each member of the Harpers - even working in anonymity, they do so with a common and righteous cause.
special:
Spiritual Weapon (Bonus Action)
Cast as a level 6 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Haste Helm
description: The Haste Helm is a rare helmet that grants the wearer a burst of speed at the start of combat.
quote: The helm throbs when violence is near, filling the wearer with a compulsion to act.
where_to_find: Inside the Moss-Covered Chest

name: Hat Of Uproarious Laughter
icon: Hat Of Uproarious Laughter Unfaded Icon.png
description: Hat Of Uproarious Laughter is a rare hat that tries to make targetted creatures fall on the floor laughting.
quote: The insides of this hat have clasps, not for gloves or cards, but rather for a portable custard pie gag.

name: Hat Of Eminent Giggles
icon: Item ARM Hat Circushat Unfaded Icon.png
description: Hat Of Eminent Giggles is a common Non-Armour Headwear.
quote: 'What do you get when you cross a fiend with a rogue? A thiefling' - nameless comedian moments before his (perhaps timely) murder.
where_to_find: On a shelf in the Infiltration Training room

name: Hat of Fire Acuity
description: Hat of Fire Acuity is an uncommon hat that grants the wearer Arcane Acuity whenever they deal Fire damage.
quote: It is said some wizard hats grant the power to keep your head cool - both literally and figuratively.
where_to_find: Carried by the Strange Ox in Dammon's blacksmith in Act Two
notes:
• Slaying the Strange Ox at the Druid Grove will only reward the Shapeshifter's Boon Ring, because it does not have the Hat of Fire Acuity until reaching the Last Light Inn at the beginning of Act Two.
• Killing the Strange Ox will prevent summoning them during the Gather Your Allies quest in Act 3. However, there is no other way to acquire this hat.

name: Hat of Storm Scion's Power
description: Hat of Storm Scion's Power is an uncommon hat that grants Arcane Acuity whenever the wearer deals Thunder damage.
quote: Two sigils glow white where the hat brushes your temples - something is being tapped into; something distant and fearsome.
where_to_find: Sold by Araj Oblodra on the main floor
notes: • If the Drakethroat Glaive is used to enchant a weapon with Thunder damage and the weapon's wielder is wearing the Hat of Storm Scion's Power, then Thunderous Acuity becomes functionally identical to Battle Acuity from the Helmet of Arcane Acuity, a beneficial feature for classes without light armour proficiency.

name: Hat of Uninhibited Kushigo
icon: Hat of Uninhibited Kushigo Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Hat of Uninhibited Kushigo is a rare hat that grants +1 bonus to their Spell Save DC after dealing damage with an unarmed attack.
quote:
Coming upon a wise woman, Kushigo got drunk and grew maudlin, and told her about Irishi's scalping. She gave him some clothes - light and fine - and encouraged him to take his time to grieve. He did.
And, when he was ready, he fought again, uninhibited by steel or fellowship - for they only weighed him down.
where_to_find: Sold by Quartermaster Talli near the Last Light Inn waypoint

name: Hat of the Sharp Caster
image: Hat of the Sharp Caster Icon.png
controller_icon: Hat of the Sharp Caster Unfaded.png
icon: Hat of the Sharp Caster Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Hat of the Sharp Caster is a rare Helmet. It rerolls the die(s) on spell damage rolls if they are a 1 or 2.
quote: All you need now is a holster for your wand, tobacco to chew, and some sort of pack animal to ride, and you'll look like a complete and utter bingus.
where_to_find: Sold by Tara on the roof of the Devil's Fee
notes:
• Tara only appears at this location after having spoken to her on the roof of the Open Hand Temple with Gale present after having started the Find the Missing Letters quest.
• In patch 8, Tara does not sell this item, instead it appears on top of the canopy at the entrance to Sorcerous Sundries at X: -16 Y: -67. The hat can be obtained by casting Telekinesis on it and moving it to the ground; for easier targeting, switch to tactical view.
• If Tara is first spoken to without Gale in the party, Tara does not appear at the next location, and this item is not present on the canopy.

name: Headband of Intellect
description: The Headband of Intellect is a rare Circlet that raises the wearer's Intelligence to 19.
quote: An elegant circlet, best worn by those with an affinity for the magical arts.
special: • Set the wearer's Intelligence score to 19. The enchantment has no effect if their Intelligence score is higher without it.
notes: • This item was originally carried by Lump, before it was changed in Early Access to the Warped Headband of Intellect and its effect reduced to setting the Intelligence score to 17.

name: Heavy Boots
description: Heavy Boots are a common pair of Boots.
quote: These boots are well-maintained and clean, though their soles are thin from wear.

name: Heavy Crossbow
quote: A standard-issue crossbow, used by many guardsmen.

name: Heavy Crossbow +1
quote: Despite the heaviness of this crossbow, the latch pulls back with an effortless ease.

name: Heavy Spiked Club
quote: Rusted iron spikes and mismatched stones are haphazardly lashed to the end of this thick oak branch.
special: Not usable by humanoids.
notes:
• This item can only be obtained by forcing a Buthir or Lump to drop their weapon.
• This item cannot be equipped; prior to patch 3 it was possible by dragging the weapon already in hand into the oversized weapon.

name: Hedge Wanderer Armour
description: The Hedge Wanderer Armour is an uncommon Medium Armour that provides a small boost to Dexterity related rolls and towards Nature Skill Checks.
quote: This simple cured goat hide was enchanted by a travelling druid. A goatherd once helped her negotiate a strange maze of hedges, so she blessed all his goats in thanks.
where_to_find: Sold by Arron next to the Silvanus statue
special: • Nature +1.
notes: • Essentially a superior variant of Hide Armour +1, being visually identical and having all the same features plus the Nature skill bonus.

name: Hellbeard Halberd
description: Hellbeard Halberd is a rare +2 Halberd which deals additional Poison damage and possibly Poisons the target.
quote: Salvaged from the beard of a dead infernal leviathan, whose facial hair was formed from the weapons of an army it had once vanquished.
bugs: • Although not stated anywhere in-game, this halberd Poisons targets on hit if a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw is failed. The save for this effect is not shown in the combat log.

name: Helldusk Armour
description: Helldusk Armour is a legendary heavy Armour which can be worn without any proficiency. It grants Fire resistance, reduces damage by 3 from all sources, and grants the Fly spell.
quote: Carixim, soul-stuffed forgemaster of hellish Avernus, hammers away ceaselessly at new creations. Questions of morality and destiny do not concern him. Conscience is for his betters. He works with cheer, his swollen skin moaning soothingly.
where_to_find: Carried by Raphael
special:
Fly (Bonus Action)
Bestow the ability to Fly upon yourself. ( Recharge: Long rest.)
bugs:
• Because this item does not have a proficiency group, items such as the Bracers of Defence, Bonespike Boots, and Corellon's Grace that are not supposed to give their bonuses to characters wearing armour still provide their benefits with the Helldusk Armour equipped. The extra movement speed granted to monks by Unarmoured Movement is also not lost when wearing this armour.
• For the same reason as above, the Defence fighting style does not consider the Helldusk Armour as armour proper. To work around this, the armour itself has a hidden passive that grants +1 AC if the wearer has the Defence passive. However, if the wearer also has another piece of armour equipped, which has a proficiency group, the normal +1 AC from Defence is additionally applied for a total of +2 AC.
notes:
• This item is carried by Raphael at all times. If deprived of it, his armour class remains the same.
• Unlike the spell Grant Flight, the version of Fly granted by this armour does not require concentration.
• This armour sells for more than any other item in the game.
• As this item does not have an armour proficiency group, any class can wear it without the normal armour penalties that might otherwise be imposed.

name: Helldusk Boots
description: The Helldusk Boots are a very rare pair of Boots that allows the wearer to ignore Difficult Terrain, and to use a Reaction to succeed on a Saving Throw. It also grants the Hellcrawler bonus action.
quote: No ore takes better to being forged than the infernal iron of Avernus, where the archdevil Zariel presides.
where_to_find: in a locked Gilded Chest on the top floor
special:
Hellcrawler (Bonus Action)
Teleport to an area and deal 2d8Fire damage where you land. The impact blast spreads in a 3 m / 10 ft zone. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
notes:
• Taking this item after Gortash's coronation makes Gortash and all Steel Watchers on this floor permanently hostile.
• Taking this item before the coronation or before Gortash leaves the throne room does not turn them hostile.
• If Gortash's deal is taken and Orin is killed, taking this item does not make them hostile.
• Along with the rest of the Helldusk Set, these boots are said to have been made by Carixim.

name: Helldusk Gloves
description: Helldusk Gloves are a very rare pair of Gloves. They grant bonuses to spellcasting, weapon attacks, and unarmed attacks.
quote: What precisely confers eternal punishment, reward, absolution? Perhaps it's not just belief in a god. Perhaps the deciding factor is whether the gods believe in you.
where_to_find: Worn by Haarlep in the Boudoir
special:
• Strength Saving Throws +1
Rays of Fire (Action)
Cast as a cantrip ( Recharge: Short rest.)
notes: • Along with the rest of the Helldusk Set, these gloves are said to have been made by Carixim.

name: Helldusk Helmet
description: Helldusk Helmet is a very rare Headwear. It grants the wearer the ability to see in magical darkness, and they cannot be blinded. They also gain a +2 bonus to saving throws against spells and can use Immolating Gaze to frighten enemies.
quote: It is said that Carixim, the fiending titan whose flesh squirms with twenty-thousand trapped souls, forged the pieces of this armour set.
where_to_find: In Raphael's Vault across from the entrance to the Boudoir
special:
• Attackers can't land Critical Hits on the wearer.
Immolating Gaze (Action)
Sear and Frighten a target with nothing but your glower. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
notes: • A party member must pass a DC 10 Wisdom Check to activate the Inert Infernal Gem and then a DC 20 Arcana Check to use the Infernal Control Gem to open the door. Each party member has only one chance at each check. The helmet is located in the treasure pile.

name: Hellfire Engine Crossbow
description: Hellfire Engine Crossbow is a very rare +2 Heavy Crossbow. It grants the Lightning Arrow spell and can pull targets with the Reposition Malefactor weapon action.
quote: 'Trundling, mashing, mincing, crushing, grinding, blasting, biting! Hear their peeling thunder, their roaring flames, their clicking, whirring, metallic melody, and know that the hellfire engines of Avernus are on the move!' - Edict in Elturel
special:
Lightning Arrow (Action)
Cast as a level 4 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Hellfire Greataxe
description: Hellfire Greataxe is a very rare +2 Greataxe that deals additional Fire damage, afflicts its wielder with Heat on each successful hit, and grants the Hellflame Cleave weapon action.
quote: Anything hit by this has the life expectancy of a glass hammer.
bugs: • This weapon has a hidden condition MAG_FIRE_DIPPED_HELLFIRE which is supposed to make its 1d6 Fire damage ignore fire resistance. Additionally, Hellflame Cleave and the Hellfire surface it creates are also both supposed to ignore fire resistance. Neither of these effects are currently ignoring fire resistance.
notes:
• Once in the vault, upon finding the named doors, the party must go through the "Silverhand" door and in the next area destroy the door labeled "Illusion" (trying to enter the door normally will not work). Through the door is the room with the chest.
• This is one of very few non-Dippable weapons in the game, as its special property functions largely the same as being dipped in Fire.

name: Hellfire Hand Crossbow
description: Hellfire Hand Crossbow is a very rare +2 Hand Crossbow that has a chance to set targets burning when attacking while Hiding or Invisible.
quote: Rigged to draw on the skin-peeling hellfire of Avernus by a resourceful devil, this crossbow's size is no indication of its deadly potential.
special:
Scorching Ray Shot (Action)
Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Short rest.)
notes: • Obtaining the crossbow grants the Tools of the Trade inspiration to party members with the Outlander background.

name: Hellrider Longbow
description: Hellrider Longbow is an uncommon +1 Longbow that grants the wielder a large bonus to Initiative and Advantage on Perception checks. It may also apply Faerie Fire to a creature on a successful attack.
quote: This longbow was forged from the remnants of Stanislav the Silver's shield, found near the wreckage of [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Castle_Ravenloft Castle Ravenloft] some years ago.
notes: • Ferg Drogher does not sell any items (including this one) if Shadowheart is nearby, unless she killed The Nightsong earlier in Act Two.

name: Hellrider's Pride
description: Hellrider's Pride are an uncommon pair of Gloves that grant creatures healed by the wearer resistance to the physical damage of weapon attacks.
quote: A waft of sulphur emanates from these proudly-kept gauntlets.
where_to_find: Carried by Zevlor and can be looted from him, stolen, or earned as a reward for Kill Kagha or Investigate Kagha
special: • Strength Saving Throws +1
notes:
• The Reviving Hands are essentially an upgraded version of these.
• Unlike The Reviving Hands, Hellrider's Pride are not classified as armour, allowing them to be equipped by a character benefiting from the effects of Mage Armour, Unarmoured Defence, or other effects that require a character to be unarmoured.

name: Helm of Arcane Gate
icon: Helm of Arcane Gate Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Helm of Arcane Gate is a rare Helmet that allows the wearer to cast Arcane Gate.
quote: The skullcap inside the helm is embroidered with the likeness of a pair of gorgeous gateways, tethered by a cord of light.
special:
Arcane Gate (Action + Level 6 Spell Slot)
Cast as a level 6 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Helm of Balduran
description: Helm of Balduran is a legendary Headwear once worn by the fabled founder of Baldur's Gate, Balduran, and grants hit points every turn along with stun and critical hit immunities.
quote: This helm, worn atop the pate of Balduran the Brave, still gleams as if with the untarnished splendour of his legacy. Baldur's Gate itself bears his name, and tales of his exploits have turned the heads and hearts of many.
where_to_find: On a stone altar next to Ansur
special: • Attackers can't land Critical Hits on the wearer.
notes:
When picked up, the following inspiration points are granted:
• Heavy is the Head ( Sage backgrounds)
• Great Helm of Legends ( Soldier backgrounds)

variants.name: Helmet
variants.image: Item ARM Shar Crown B Broken.png
variants.controller_icon: Item ARM Shar Crown B Broken Icon.png
variants.icon: Item ARM Shar Crown B Broken Unfaded Icon.png
variants.description: A Helmet is a common Helmet.
variants.quote: Eaten by time, this rusted helmet once bore a prominent sigil. Alas, it's long since faded to nothing.

name: Helmet
description: A Helmet is a common Helmet.
quote: Any padding that once lined this helmet has long since worn away.
where_to_find: Sold by numerous traders around the game
special: • Constitution Saving Throws +1

name: Helmet of Arcane Acuity
icon: Helmet of Arcane Acuity Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Helmet of Arcane Acuity is an uncommon Helmet that imparts Arcane Acuity upon the wearer when they deal damage with a weapon attack.
quote: Subtle magics are woven into the helmet's leather panes - for a powerful offence is sometimes still the best defence.
where_to_find: in a locked and trapped Gilded Chest in a secret basement area
special: • Dexterity Saving Throws +1
notes:
• The chest can be opened with a DC 14 Sleight of Hand Check, and can be perceived as trapped with a DC 15 Perception Check, then disarmed with a DC 21 Sleight of Hand Check. If lockpicked before disarming, the trap triggers a level 4 Guiding Bolt with a save DC of 15 to negate it.
• The basement is accessed through a trapdoor in the Mason's Guild, and the secret area can be opened by lockpicking or using the Tower-Shaped Key on the Keyholed Herald.
• This helmet pairs well with the (bugged) passive Mortal Reminder.

name: Helmet of Autonomy
description: The Helmet of Autonomy is an uncommon Helmet that grants the wearer Proficiency in Wisdom Saving Throws.
quote: The metal bolted to the helmet's forehead is engraved with a faded script. Though the words have become unintelligible, their magic remains.
where_to_find: On a skeleton at the entrance to The Festering Cove
special: • Proficiency in Wisdom Saving Throws

name: Helmet of Grit
description: The Helmet of Grit is a very rare Helmet. It grants the wearer an additional Bonus Action at 50% or lower Hit Points.
quote: At the barest touch, you feel a surge of exuberance and stamina - like you could take on anyone and anything.
where_to_find: in a locked opulent chest, in the room with the cursed corpse of Victoria
special: • Dexterity Saving Throws +1

name: Helmet of Smiting
description: The Helmet of Smiting is an uncommon Helmet which grants the wearer Temporary Hit Points whenever they apply a Condition using a Smite spell.
quote: A set of runes have been expertly worked into the helmet's filigree. Almost imperceptibly - but powerful nonetheless.
where_to_find: Inside a locked gilded chest south-west of the waypoint
special: • Constitution Saving Throws +1

name: Herbalist's Gloves
description: The Herbalist's Gloves are an uncommon pair of gloves that cleanse poison from those healed by the wearer.
quote: The leather smells faintly of herbs, as if washed in a herbal bath.
where_to_find: Sold by Derryth Bonecloak in the Underdark

name: Hide Armour
description: Hide Armour is a common Medium Armour.
quote: Constructed from carefully-chosen animal hides tanned, hardened and varnished to a gleaming finish.
notes: Since Patch #7, this armour can be found worn by Lae'zel in the cage after the crash of the Nautiloid, if she was stripped of her personal armour in the Prologue. Her original armour must not be in her inventory or she will requip it instead of having this armour.

name: Hide Armour +1
description: Hide Armour +1 is a uncommon Medium Armour.
quote: Tight stitches bind panels of hard leather into a formfitting carapace that moves like a second skin.
where_to_find: Sold by traders using the levelled magic armour table if the player character is between levels 2 and 4

name: Hide Armour +2
description: Hide Armour +2 is a rare Medium Armour that grants a +1 bonus to Dexterity Saving Throws and Ability Checks, as well as Initiative.
quote: This hide armour, soft to the touch but hard as a zaratan's hide, is stitched together of narrow panels allowing for the wearer's ease of movement and comfort.
where_to_find:
Sold by traders using the levelled magic armour table if the player character is level 5 or above
• Sold by Grat in the Goblin Camp regardless of level
notes: • Aside from Elixirs of Vigilance, this is one of the earlier items available in quantity that can boost initiative for those with medium armour proficiency.

name: Hoarfrost Boots
description: Hoarfrost Boots are an uncommon pair of Boots that allow the wearer to not slip on icy surfaces.
quote: A smattering of tiny ice crystals have formed cleats on the soles of these hardy boots.
where_to_find: Inside a display case in the Inquisitor's Chamber

name: Hollow's Staff
description: Hollow's Staff is a rare +1 Quarterstaff which makes it difficult for enemies to resist the wielder's spells, and grants the wielder the Arms of Hadar spell.
quote: This staff was wielded by Thibault Hollow, a supremely talented necromancer notable for his overwhelming fear of zombies. Many was the time when his dread lair would echo with a high-pitched shriek when one of them surprised him in a corridor, or when he was taking a bath.
special:
Arms of Hadar (Action)
Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
notes: • Relevant Necromancy spells for Heightened Necromancy include Toll the Dead, Ray of Sickness, Blindness, Bestow Curse, Blight, Circle of Death, Eyebite, and Harm.

name: Holy Lance Helm
description: A Holy Lance Helm is an uncommon Helmet that potentially deals radiant damage to creatures that attack the wearer.
quote: Brief halos of divine light wrap your head when you don and doff this helmet.
where_to_find: In a painted chest, accessible from the top level
special: • Constitution Saving Throws +1

name: Homely Clothes
description: Homely clothes are the player character's starting camp clothing. They are largely identical to the Swarthy Wayfarer outfits (e.g., Swarthy Wayfarer in Cream). If the character is Dragonborn, only the trousers are included.
quote: Perfect for ambling around a campsite, enjoying the starlight and good conversation.
where_to_find: Tav's and the Dark Urge's starting equipment.

name: Hood of the Weave
icon: Hood of the Weave Unfaded Icon.png
description: Hood of the Weave is a very rare Helmet that boosts its wearer's Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls by 2.
quote: Worn by the [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Tenser Tenser] when he was inducted into the Circle of Eight.
where_to_find: Sold by Mystic Carrion
bugs: • When worn, hair fails to render making the character seem bald. This bug does not seem contingent on the character's body type.

name: Hoppy
description: Hoppy is an uncommon +1 War Pick that allows the wielder to use Revitalising Strike (Weapon Action).
quote: Not the most elegant of weapons, the warpick's cumbersome weight certainly allows it to be deadly in combat, when wielded by a strong arm. Inexplicably, this one has a small rabbit carved into the handle.

name: Horns of the Berserker
icon: Horns of the Berserker Unfaded Icon.png
description: Horns of the Berserker is a very rare Helmet which grants a +2 bonus to Attack Rolls against damaged creatures, and an extra 2 Necrotic damage to melee hits made while damaged.
quote: This was created by a designer and an enchanter who were going through a messy divorce at the time. As such, the armour is filled with active-aggressive rage. It also makes you feel like you've wasted the last ten years picking up after a complete tit.
where_to_find: Sold by Entharl Danthelon in Wyrm's Crossing
notes: • In British English, "a complete tit" is a derogatory term used to describe someone who is foolish, an idiot, or a clumsy person. It is considered a vulgar expression, though not as offensive as some other insults.

name: Hot Pants
description: Hot Pants is a common Camp Clothing.
quote: Hewn with rough style, these trousers are fire-resistant, blood-proof, and tough to pull off unless you're a big barbarian lady.
where_to_find: Available to Karlach in the epilogue if she does not become a mind flayer and goes to Avernus
notes: • This clothing is also available to the player character if they join Karlach in Avernus.

name: Hr'a'cknir Bracers
description: Hr'a'cknir Bracers is a very rare pair of Gloves that allows the wearer to cast Mage Hand as a Bonus Action and cast Telekinesis once per Short Rest.
quote: The planar silver cladding of these forearm bracers allows the wielder to channel the latent astral energies floating in the Weave.
where_to_find: Worn by Ch'r'ai Tska'an near the bridge leading to the To Baldur's Gate waypoint
special:
• Strength Saving Throws +1
Telekinesis (Action)
Cast as a level 5 spell ( Recharge: Short rest.)

name: Humbly Cobbled Shoes
description: Humbly Cobbled Shoes are a common pair of Shoes.
quote: Made of tough, well-worn leather, these boots have survived years of use, and can survive many more.

name: Hunter's Dagger
description: Hunter's Dagger is an uncommon +1 dagger that applies Rupture to the target on a melee hit.
quote: Prey often thinks it has escaped the worst of the predator's bloodthirst and fury - but there are always further torments to be meted out.
bugs: • Hunter's Dagger has a chance to reappear in Roah's merchant stock whenever it resets, like non-unique equipment, and can be acquired multiple times.

name: Hunting Shortbow
description: Hunting Shortbow is an uncommon +1 Shortbow that grants Advantage against Monstrosity type enemies and the ability to cast Hunter's Mark.
quote: Supple and strong, this shortbow has been imbued with a ranger's solemn magic - running your fingers along the smooth ash, you can feel that solemnity like a ghost in the shaped wood.
special:
Hunter's Mark (Bonus Action)
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
bugs: • This item can be unequipped after casting Hunter's Mark from it; the caster will still receive the use of Hunter's Mark until long rest or concentration is broken.

name: Icebite Robe
description: Icebite Robe is a rare piece of Clothing. It grants the wearer Resistance to Cold damage and allows them to cast Armour of Agathys as a 3rd level spell once per Long Rest.
quote: Delicate ferns of frost glitter in the lining of this robe.
where_to_find: Inside a sarcophagus north of the iron gate
special:
• Resistance to Cold damage.
Armour of Agathys (Action)
Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
notes: • If the robe is removed while its version of Armour of Agathys is active, the spell ends.

name: Ichorous Gloves
description: Ichorous Gloves are an uncommon pair of Gloves that can inflict Noxious Fumes on targets that are dealt Acid damage.
quote: These gloves smell like beef mince left to rot in a privy pail.
where_to_find: In a metal chest in the storeroom behind the bar

name: Ignoble Hat
description: Ignoble Hat is a common Non-Armour Headwear.
quote: Foppish and fluffy and built for just the right sort of dome accustomed to having it set upon the head by other people.
where_to_find: Found as random loot throughout the game

name: Ilmater's Aid
description: Ilmater's Aid is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to deal additional force damage with non-cantrip spells when their health drops below half.
quote: Named after the god of martyrs, this amulet seems to shine in the presence of the wearer's blood.
where_to_find: In a gilded chest near Polma (Early Access only)
notes: • Replaced by Amulet of Misty Step after release.

name: Incandescent Staff
description: Incandescent Staff is a very rare Quarterstaff which grants the wielder a bonus to ranged spell Attack Rolls and resistance to Fire damage. It also grants the ability to cast the Fire Bolt and Fireball spells.
quote: Etchings course red-hot through the length of this staff, the script of primordial fire writ in flame.
special:
• Ranged Spell Attack +1
• Resistance to Fire damage
Fire Bolt (Action)
Cast as a cantrip at will.
Fireball (Action)
Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Infernal Longsword
description: Infernal Longsword is a rare, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Longswords family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon that can be wielded in one hand, or with both hands for extra damage.
quote: Precise infernal runes are woven into this weapon's filigree, implying a creator well-versed in hellish arcana.

name: Infernal Mace
description: Infernal Mace is a rare +2 Mace which deals an extra 3 Poison damage and possibly Poisons the target on a hit.
quote: Precise infernal runes are woven into this weapon's filigree, implying a creator well-versed in hellish arcana.

name: Infernal Mace
description: Infernal Mace is an uncommion +1 Mace that deals an extra 3 Poison damage and possibly Poisons the target on a hit.
quote: Precise infernal runes are woven into this weapon's filigree, implying a creator well-versed in hellish arcana.
notes: • This mace Poisons targets on hit if a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw is failed. The save for this effect is not shown in the combat log.

name: Infernal Mask
controller_icon: Item ARM Helmet Metal B Icon.png
icon: Item ARM Helmet Metal B Unfaded Icon.png
description: Infernal Mask is an uncommon Helmet carried by Orpheus.
quote: Power radiates from this like heat from the sun.
where_to_find: Carried by Orpheus if he is freed and joins the party during the assault on the Upper City.
notes: • This helmet has no model when equipped by a party member.

name: Infernal Rapier
description: The Infernal Rapier is a very rare +2 rapier and a possible reward for following Wyll's companion quest. It raises the wielder's Spell Save DC and, unlike other rapiers, uses their Spellcasting Modifier for Attack Rolls and Damage Rolls instead of Strength or Dexterity.
quote: Imagine the soul as a blade. A good one, carefully looked after. A bad one suited for rusting in the rain. Flame-chewed and narrow, this blade is Wyll's soul summarised in steel.
special:
Planar Ally: Cambion (Action)
Cast as a level 6 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
bugs: • Despite not stating such anywhere, and unlike most summons, the Cambion is automatically dismissed if the summoner is Knocked Out.
notes:
• The party must bring Wyll along when entering the Tadpoling Centre, free Mizora, then pass a DC 14 Persuasion Check check to convince her to give a reward.
• The summoned Cambion from Planar Ally: Cambion is immediately dismissed if the Infernal Rapier is unequipped.

name: Infernal Robe
description: Infernal Robe is a very rare piece of Clothing that grants its wearer resistance to Fire damage as well as the ability to cast Fire Shield (Warm), once per Long Rest.
quote: Presumably Mizora was not always a sensuous and manipulative benefactor of troubled souls like Wyll. Negotiating the hierarchies of hell result in changes of form - but was she ever less beautiful, less erudite, less willful?
where_to_find: Rewarded by Mizora
special:
• Grants Resistance to Fire damage.
• Armour Class +1
Fire Shield: Warm (Bonus Action)
Cast as a level 4 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
notes:
• After recruiting Wyll, the party must find and kill Karlach. Mizora then rewards Wyll with this robe when taking a Long Rest.
• This robe shares a model with the Selûnite Robe; the only visual difference is the colouring.

name: Infernal Spear
description: Infernal Spear is a rare +1 Spear that deals an extra 3 Poison damage and possibly Poisons the target on a hit.
quote: Precise infernal runes are woven into this weapon's filigree, implying a creator well-versed in hellish arcana.
bugs: • It is not stated anywhere in-game, but this spear Poisons targets on hit if a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw is failed. The save for this effect is not shown in the combat log.

name: Infernal Warhammer
description: Infernal Warhammer is a rare +1 Warhammer that deals an additional 3 Poison Damage on hit and has a chance to Poison targets it strikes.
quote: Precise infernal runes are woven into this weapon's filigree, implying a creator well-versed in hellish arcana.

name: Intransigent Warhammer
description: Intransigent Warhammer is an uncommon Warhammer that knocks nearby foes Prone after killing a hostile target or landing a Critical Hit.
quote: The elegant design of this hammer belies its brutal, crushing power. This weapon does not give ground.

name: Iron-Banded Shield
description: The Iron-Banded Shield is a common Shield.
quote: This thick oak shield is reinforced with a frame of rough-hammered iron.
where_to_find: Carried by Sharran Sentries

variants.name: Iron-Banded Shield +1
variants.description: Iron-Banded Shield +1 is a rare Shield with an enchantment increasing its Armour Class bonus.
variants.quote: This thick oak shield is reinforced with a frame of rough-hammered iron.
variants.where_to_find: leaning against a rack next to the bugbear merchant Lann Tarv
variants.special: • No special properties, beyond the Armour Class enchantment.

name: Iron-Banded Shield +1
description: Iron-Banded Shield +1 is a rare Shield with an enchantment increasing its Armour Class bonus.
quote: Despite numerous small scratches on the shield's surface, not a single blade has been able to make an actual dent in the heavy wood.
where_to_find: on the ground next to Incontinentia Figgin, who lies in a cave behind the basement
special: • No special properties, beyond the Armour Class enchantment.

name: Ironvine Shield
description: Ironvine Shield is an uncommon Shield that damages the attacker if the wielder is using a weapon empowered with Shillelagh.
quote: Each whorl and groove and worm-curled twist of this shield evokes a tangle of bog-stuck trees in rain-swollen vines.
where_to_find: In a chest

name: Ironwood Breastplate
description: Ironwood Breastplate is an uncommon Medium Armour that reduces Slashing damage by 1.
quote: This armour's material has the coarse texture of a bramble patch, and the fragrance of a rose garden in springtime.
special: • Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws.

name: Ironwood Club
icon: Wood Woad Twisting Branch Unfaded Icon.png
description: Ironwood Club is an uncommon +1 Club that deals extra Bludgeoning damage when Shillelagh is cast on it.
quote: Fashioned from the hard, unforgiving trunk of an oak, this club still retains the perfume of the forest.
special: • When Shillelagh is cast on this weapon, it gains Ironwood Harmony.
bugs: • Ironwood Harmony is not displayed on the weapon, and is only visible in the combat log.

name: Jagged Spear
description: Jagged Spear is an uncommon Spear that allows the wielder to possibly give their targets Disadvantage on Constitution Saving Throws.
quote: The blade of this spear is blackened and melted, leaving a cruel, rugged edge.

name: Jaheira’s Boots
controller_icon: Item ARM Boots Leather D Icon.png
icon: Item ARM Boots Leather D Unfaded Icon.png
description: Jaheira’s Boots are a common pair of Boots worn by Jaheira.
quote: As well travelled as any set of boots on Toril.
where_to_find: Worn by Jaheira

name: Jaheira's Respectable Clothes
description: Jaheira's Respectable Clothes are a set of common Camp Clothing.
quote: Though humble in appearance, these clothes bear little hints at Jaheira's fashionability. Minimalism offset by the subtle hues shining brighter at night and softening in sunbeams.
where_to_find: Jaheira's starting camp clothing

name: Jaheira's Underwear
description: Jaheira's Underwear are common Underwear.
quote: Embroidered with little ducks.
where_to_find: Jaheira's starting underwear
notes: • Underwear cannot be looted regularly. A party member must pick up the corpse to loot the underwear.

name: Jannath's Hat
description: Jannath's Hat is a very rare headwear that gives advantage to persuasion and deception checks.
quote: The corner of modern fashion that this hat currently occupies might well be called Optimistic.
where_to_find: In the High Security Vault nº2
special:
• Advantage on Persuasion Checks.
• Advantage on Deception Checks.

name: Javelin
quote: A rusted fishing harpoon, repurposed as a weapon.

name: Javelin +1
quote: The worn leather strap at the end of this javelin loops around the wrist to let it be thrown with devastating force.

name: Jhannyl's Gloves
description: Jhannyl's Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that let the wearer automatically cast Lesser Restoration on themselves when they become Blinded, Paralysed or Poisoned.
quote: Divine runes accentuate the finger pads. While not a religious sect, the Harpers do not demand the occlusion of religion in their members.
where_to_find: Worn by Isobel if she is killed after dealing with the Nightsong but before completing the assault on Moonrise
special: • Saving Throws +1
notes: • Likely related to [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Jhannyl%27s_wristlet Jhannyl's wristlet], a magic item also used by the Harpers.

name: Jorgoral's Greatsword
description: Jorgoral's Greatsword is a rare +1 greatsword that grants its wielder the Colossal Onslaught weapon action.
quote: Strong castle-forged steel surmounts a grip of sturdy leather - this immense sword is capable of disembowelling giants in a single swipe.
bugs: • Pushing Greymon off the party's raft via the Athletics dialogue option during the initial cutscene results in his loot being permanently lost, as his body does not wash ashore. To guarantee this item and the rest of his gear is recoverable, it is recommended to initiate combat and shove him into the water manually during the ship-to-ship battle.
notes: • If he is not shoved off the party's raft, Greymon sells this item at his trader spot in the Duergar encampment. If he drowns after turning hostile on the raft, his body washes up on the beach near the southern pier at the Decrepit Village, from which this weapon can be looted.

name: Justiciar Helmet
description: A Justiciar Helmet is a common Helmet.
quote: Round-topped and fashioned to protect from errant arrows.
where_to_find: Beside a skeleton in the room opposite to the Altar to Shar
special: • Constitution Saving Throws +1

name: Justiciar's Greatshield
description: Justiciar's Greatshield is a rare Shield that allows the wielder to cast Darkness Cloak to hide themselves, and gains advantage on Perception checks.
quote: It's never the shield that kills you - but hearing your frantic steel thudding uselessly against this reinforced oak in the darkness is a good sign the end is near.
where_to_find: Carried by Lyrthindor
special:
• Advantage on Perception Ability Checks.
Darkness Cloak (Bonus Action)
Create a cloud of magical darkness and immediately attempt to Hide. ( Recharge: Short rest.)

name: Justiciar's Scimitar
description: Justiciar's Scimitar is a very rare +2 Scimitar weapon that can blind an opponent if the wielder strikes with Advantage. It also grants the Shadowsoaked Blow weapon action.
quote: This light, curved blade is as unusual and unforgiving as the Darkness it strikes from.
bugs:
• Due to the missing proficiency classification, this weapon cannot be used to activate Bladesong when equipped in the mainhand weapon slot, although equipping it does not apply Bladesong Impeded (condition).
• This issue does not occur when equipped in the offhand weapon slot.
• This weapon has a hidden version of the Shadow Blade applied to it, which grants advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls while active, including weapon attack rolls for another equipped melee weapon while dual-wielding.
notes: • This weapon does not have a proficiency classification, and does not require proficiency in Scimitars to use.

name: Karlach's Boots
description: Karlach's Boots is the default Boots for Karlach.
quote: Warmed by occasionally wiggling infernal toes.
where_to_find: Worn by Karlach

name: Karlach's Infernal Trousers
description: Karlach's Infernal Trousers is the default Camp Clothing for Karlach.
quote: Torn and hell-scented, these trousers have seen a good deal of action - though not perhaps the sort Karlach might prefer.
where_to_find: Karlach's starting camp clothing

name: Karlach's Underwear
description: Karlach's Underwear is the default Underwear for Karlach.
quote: How do these not burn off?
where_to_find: Karlach's starting underwear
notes: • Underwear cannot be looted regularly. A party member must pick up the corpse to loot the underwear.

name: Kass' Practice Sword
quote: A wooden sword coated in a thick layer of varnish. Clumsy and covered in crude painted handprints like blood, the sword is engraved with the name 'Kass'.
notes:
• Presumably the property of Kass
• Practice swords are the only Finesse weapons that deals Bludgeoning damage, and the only way to deal Bludgeoning damage with Sneak Attack (Melee) (since the Sneak Attack dice inherit the damage type of the weapon).

name: Katana
quote: The hilt of this slender sword is wrapped with soft, black silk — the dark colour hiding any possible stains.
notes:
• Golbraith's Cellar can be accessed through a hatch.
• Another Katana can be found on a shelf behind Akabi in the Circus of the Last Days, but this one is not interactable.

name: Keepsake Ring
image: Ring A Gem A Gold 1 Faded.png
controller_icon: Ring A Gem A Gold 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Ring A Gem A Gold 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Keepsake Ring is a rare Ring that allows its wearer to cast Dominate Beast as a 5th level spell once per Long Rest.
quote: Created by a conglomerate of druids one moonlit night when all the stirring violins of insect, elms, and whispering winds consorted, and when wild beasts in need of taming prowled unseen.
where_to_find: In the Basement, in the middle of the room with the rats.
special:
Dominate Beast (Action)
Cast as a level 5 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Ketheric's Shield
description: Ketheric's Shield is a rare Shield. It grants the Shield Bash action, improves the wielder's spellcasting-related rolls, and also gives them Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws.
quote: In the theatre of dreams, Ketheric killed his wife every night. That wasn't how things happened... but always upon waking, he would glare into the dark, long-faced and solemn, and he would think: 'I keep you alive with my memories, beloved. I kill you with what I've become.'
where_to_find: Carried by Ketheric Thorm when fought atop Moonrise Towers and in the Mind Flayer Colony (see notes)
special: • Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws
notes: • This shield can be obtained early – while fighting Ketheric Thorm atop Moonrise Towers – by disarming him, placing any two-handed weapon near him, waiting for him to equip that weapon, then pickpocketing the shield while he is still invulnerable.

name: Ketheric's Warhammer
quote: This hammer's weight is centred on enchanted obsidian at the base of the head. Some nights before bed, Ketheric would sneak a whey-faced glance at the hammer, and think about the stone, and wonder what unknown facet of his heart bore his weight.
notes: • This weapon can also be obtained by disarming Ketheric Thorm while fighting him atop Moonrise Towers or in the Mind Flayer Colony.

variants.name: Key of the Ancients
variants.icon: Key of the Ancients Unfaded Icon.png
variants.description: This version of the Key of the Ancients is a story rarity Helmet which grants the wearer a bonus to Nature checks.
variants.quote: The branches of this circlet are half-fossilised, passed down through generations of druids. Fabricated during the founding of the grove, the wreath is forever linked to its lands, the tiny rubies connected to its stones and structures, bidding them to do their bidding.
variants.where_to_find: Carried by Findal in the Underground Passage that connects to the Druid Grove
variants.special:
• Nature +1
• While standing in front of the stone door in Nettie's room in the Druid Grove, you can open a shortcut to the Underground Passage.

icon: Key of the Ancients Unfaded Icon.png

where_to_find: Carried by Nettie
special:

name: Khalid's Gift
image: Amulet Necklace A Bronze A 1 Faded.png
controller_icon: Amulet Necklace A Bronze A 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Amulet Necklace A Bronze A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Khalid's Gift is a very rare Amulet that was gifted to Jaheira by Khalid and stored away in the basement of her home. While wearing it, Jaheira cannot be cursed.
quote: A gift from Khalid for Jaheira.
where_to_find: in a display case in the basement
special:
• Wisdom +1 (up to 21)
Khalid's Gift: Aid (Action)
Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
notes:
• This item is always present, even if Jaheira is not recruited or is killed.
• The bookcase which holds this amulet can be opened with a DC 18 Sleight of Hand Check.
• This item has a hard cap at Wisdom 21. This means it does not grant a +1 bonus to Wisdom if the character would exceed this limit from other ability bonuses.
• Khalid is Jaheira's deceased husband, and a companion from the original Baldur's Gate. Helping him gather the materials for this amulet is the subject of a side quest in Baldur's Gate: Siege of Dragonspear after which it becomes an item in the game. See: [https://baldursgate.fandom.com/wiki/The_Gift The Gift]

name: Kiam Goda's Kilat Drum
description:
Kiam Goda's Kilat Drum is a unique instrument. It can be played with the Perform action.
This variant is functionally no different from the regular Hand Drum.
quote: A Lulutiun hand drum covered in sealskin, like those played at koatulit peace festivals. Kiam Goda was famous for his finger-thumb taradiddles.
where_to_find: Can be purchased from Thomas C. Quirkilious
notes: This variant is unable to perform songs from the Digital Deluxe Edition DLC, even when that content is unlocked. Using its perform action only includes Bard Dance, Old Time Battles, and The Power, while it will be missing Of Divinity and Sin, The Queen%27s High Seas, and Sing for Me.

name: Kill Collar
description: Kill Collar is an uncommon Amulet that represents the collars used by Gortash to keep the Gondians within the Iron Foundry in check.
quote: Smells a bit rusty, but looks stylish nonetheless.
where_to_find: Carried by Zanner Toobin in the Steel Watch Foundry, Lower City
notes:
• Despite wearing the collars, no other Gondian will drop one.
• If a character has this collar equipped, is within the Lower Foundry area of the Steel Watch Foundry, and a Black Fist's Motivator is allowed to activate then the character wearing the collar will explode and be instantly killed. If a Motivator is allowed to activate under any other circumstances then the collar will instead be replaced with an unequippable Destroyed Kill Collar.
• Despite the Gondians having a visible model of a collar this item has no model for the player.

name: Killer's Sweetheart
icon: Ring I Gold A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Killer's Sweetheart is a very rare Ring that makes the wearer's next Attack Roll a critical hit after killing a creature, once per Long Rest.
quote: Though the ring is highly polished, darkened slivers of blood still cling to small scrapes and corners.
where_to_find: On the ground where the shadow copy appearing next to the Brazier is defeated in the Self-Same Trial

name: King's Knife
description: King's Knife is a Duergar variant of the common Longsword. It is identical to a Longsword in all but appearance.
quote: Crudely forged with mismatched components, nearly rusted through, and plenty sharp.
bugs:
• In the game files, the root template of this sword (UUID 5908898d-5d9e-40de-ab07-3f8fb5f0174c) actually describes a shortsword, which is also used as the basis for the Knife of the Undermountain King. In fact, the magical properties of that sword are also added to this root template (via the tag), meaning that this item should have those properties as well, and will do so if spawned via the console. However, the weapon that's spawned in-game is not directly based on the root template but rather on a stat entry called WPN_KingsKnife which inherits properties from WPN_Longsword. This ends up making this item functionally identical to a common longsword.
• Equipping a hireling with this weapon, then dismissing and re-hiring them, changes this weapon's stats and weapon actions to those of Knife of the Undermountain King, as its root template has the same stats.

name: Klagga's Pants
description: Klagga's Pants are common pair of underwear, which Klagga took from the mutilated dwarf Brian.
quote: These pants, cinched at the waist, are stained with splotches of brown and crimson.
where_to_find: Carried (but not worn) by Klagga
notes: • Normally, underwear cannot be looted regularly; party members must pick up the character's corpse to loot it. However, this particular pair of underwear can be looted because it is not equipped/worn by the character carrying it.

name: Knife of the Undermountain King
image: Knife of the Undermountain King Faded.webp
controller_icon: Knife of the Undermountain King Unfaded.png
icon: Knife of the Undermountain King Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Knife of the Undermountain King is a very rare +2 shortsword which increases the frequency of scoring Critical Hits and grants Advantage against obscured enemies.
quote: Snatched from the realm of the mad wizard [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Halaster_Blackcloak Halaster Blackcloak], this knife became a prized keepsake of a duergar king.

name: Knock Knuckle Gloves
description: Knock Knuckle Gloves are an uncommon pair of Gloves that grant the Knock spell and increase Sleight of Hand by 1.
quote: In the palm of the left glove is a glossy scarlet solution that coats Thieves' Tools, making them more reliable. In the right, arcane symbols wax and wane.
where_to_find: In the High Security Vault nº7
special:
• Sleight of Hand +1
Knock (Action + Level 2 Spell Slot)
Cast as a level 2 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Komira's Locket
icon: Keepsake Locket A Glowing Unfaded Icon.png
description: Komira's Locket is an uncommon Amulet given to the party by Arabella's parents.
quote: Worked carefully into the locket's metal back are the words, 'Never dark again.'
where_to_find: Given to the party by Arabella's parents Komira and Locke, after protecting her from Kagha in Save Arabella
special:
Dancing Lights (Action)
Cast as a cantrip ( Recharge: Per turn.)

name: Kruznabir's Asylum Amulet
image: Amulet Necklace A Gold A 1 Faded.png
controller_icon: Amulet Necklace A Gold A 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Amulet Necklace A Gold A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Kruznabir's Asylum Amulet is a rare Amulet that lets the user cause their targets to go mad.
quote: The bauble is emblazoned with fiendish words that, when translated, mean, 'May your throat be educated in new screams.'
special:
Crown of Madness (Action + Level 2 Spell Slot)
Cast as a level 2 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Kurwin's Cauteriser
description: Kurwin's Cauteriser is an uncommon +1 Scimitar that deals extra Fire damage on hit, and possibly Burns the target as well.
quote: Mortician Kurwin was known to use his trusty Cauteriser on all sorts of interesting subjects. At first there were cadavers, then people who wouldn't be missed, and it was only after he targeted a well-liked tavern owner that he was ratted out to the law.

name: Lacey Garb
description: Lacey Garb is a common Camp Clothing.
quote: Do not be fooled by this ensemble. While delicately made, it will not impede you in a fight - should the need arise.
where_to_find: Available only to Jaheira in the epilogue if she leaves the Harpers

name: Lae'zel's Clothes
description: Lae'zel's Clothes are a set of common Camp Clothing.
quote: As exciting as a trade deposition and as functional as a brick.
where_to_find: Lae'zel's starting camp clothing
notes:
• Like Umber Trousers, Lae'zel's Clothes only cover the lower half.
• If Underwear is worn, it appears on the upper body of female characters when wearing these clothes.

name: Lae'zel's Underwear
description: Lae'zel's Underwear is a common Underwear. According to Lae'zel, the under-harnesses are used for strapping oneself onto a red dragon.
quote: Built for function rather than fun.
where_to_find: Lae'zel's starting underwear
notes:
• Underwear cannot be looted regularly. A party member must pick up the corpse to loot the underwear.
• Lae'zel's Underwear for Male body types is different from regular Githyanki Underwear (see gallery).

name: Lantern
description: A Lantern can be used as a Light Source and doubles as improvised weapon of the Clubs family. It is a simple melee weapon wielded in one hand. It's a works exactly like a Torch in utility and combat functions.
quote: A deep oily smell wafts from this crude tree branch.

name: Larethian's Wrath
description: Larethian's Wrath is a rare +1 Longsword that grants the wielder the Razor Gale weapon action, and is a Finesse weapon, unlike most Longswords.
quote: Deceptively light, the blade rasps through castle-forged plate as easily as Corellon Larethian's own anarchic holy sword through the hearts of evil orcs.

name: Least Expected
description: Least Expected is a rare + 2 Shortbow which grants the Blinding Shot weapon action, and increases Attack Rolls while Obscured.
quote:
One of the relics of Deep Duerra's rebellious children. It was to the tremendous surprise of all that Ludmilla, the quiet, the weepy, the daughter most under her mother's thumb, took up this bow and fired.
The arrow flashed, and while Duerra and her blinded court wailed impotently, the children escaped into an uncertain, yet sweetly free, future.

variants.quote: Warm, supple boots, made to cross the roughest of terrains with ease.

name: Legacy of the Masters
description: The Legacy of the Masters are a very rare pair of Gloves that grant +2 to the wearer's attack and damage rolls.
quote: Formerly the property of the royalty of [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Threskel Threskel], these gauntlets impart some of the prince of Threskel's legendary skill with weapons.
where_to_find: Sold by Dammon in Act Three
special: • Strength Saving Throws +1

variants.name: Light Crossbow
variants.quote: This crossbow’s cast iron latch is mottled with blooms of rust.

name: Light Crossbow
quote: This crossbow’s cast iron latch is mottled with blooms of rust.
notes: • This variant of the light crossbow deals less damage and can only be acquired by disarming a Lesser Imp, for example, with Command: Drop.

name: Light Crossbow +1
quote: Though this crossbow's stock is hollowed out, its heavy trigger mechanism keeps it well balanced.

name: Light Crossbow of Speed
description: Light Crossbow of Speed is a rare Light Crossbow.
quote: Bolts slot into this crossbow with wonderful ease, as if eager to nestle against the stock, soon to fly.
notes: • The Light Crossbow of Speed exists in Baldur's Gate and Baldur's Gate 2 - Shadows of Amn, also known as the [https://baldursgate.fandom.com/wiki/The_Army_Scythe The Army Scythe].

variants.name: Light Hammer
variants.quote: Years of working hot iron have caused both of this hammer's faces to bulge slightly.

name: Light Hammer
quote: A blacksmith's pride and joy, repurposed for combat. Its steel head is tarnished from years in the forge.

name: Light Hammer +1
quote: A skillful smith decorated the wooden handle with a fine golden filigree.

name: Light of Creation
description: Light of Creation is an uncommon +1 Halberd that deals additional Lightning damage, but has a chance to Stun its wielder on each successful attack.
quote: Small lodestones have been inserted along the halberd's shaft, a strange blue current running through them.
notes:
• The only known way to be considered a Construct is to wear the Gloves of the Automaton, purchased in Act Two.
• Despite being considered a halberd, its appearance is more akin to a glaive.

name: Lightning Jabber
description: Lightning Jabber is an uncommon +1 Spear that deals extra Lightning damage when thrown, and also has a chance to Shock a target on hit.
quote: A makeshift spear fashioned from a giant crab's claw and the charged imagination of kuo-toa fishfolk.
bugs: • Despite being labelled as a Spear, the Root Template is erroneously tagged as a Javelin and as such does not work with the Polearm Master feat.
notes:
• The description of Throwing: Lightning Damage is somewhat misleading, as the spear does the same 1d4 Lightning damage when thrown as when used in a melee attack. However most thrown weapons do not apply their extra damage when thrown, which is what the passive enables.
• When the Lightning Jabber is dipped into a dippable surface, it receives the coating but it also removes the dippable surface.

name: Lihala's Lute
description: Lihala's Lute is a unique instrument. It can be played with the Perform action.
quote: This lute's wooden body is worn dull from time and use, but its strings and frets are still in excellent condition.
where_to_find: Given by Alfira during conversation.
notes:
• Alfira gives this lute to the player if they agree to help her with her song. The player can choose to pocket it as soon as they receive it or perform with Alfira by passing a DC 10 Performance Check.
• Helping Alfira finish the song also grants proficiency in Musical Instruments.

name: Moonlantern
description: The Moonlantern is a special utility item that sheds a magical Light in a large radius while equipped.
quote: Each framed facet of the lantern glass is pierced by lances and long tendrils of eerily beautiful moonlight.
bugs: • The Moonlantern containing Dolly Dolly Dolly still produces a stationary Moonshield Aura when dropped on the ground even after she has been freed from it.
notes:
• The Moonlantern carried by Kar'niss contains a foul-mouthed pixie Dolly Dolly Dolly who wants out. If freed using Inspect Moonlantern, she grants the party a Pixie Blessing. Also, characters with the Guild Artisan background get the Trust and a Little Pixie Dust inspiration, but only when the Moonlantern is inspected for the first time in a playthrough.
• If Dolly is freed, her Moonlantern remains in the inventory of the character who freed her, but its inventory icon changes to a broken version and the lantern cannot be equipped anymore.
• Taking the Moonlantern from Kar'niss (regardless of the way it is obtained) grants the inspiration Shiny Trinkets and Baubles ( Criminal background).
• If Kar'niss arrives at Moonrise Towers with the lantern (whether he escorted the party or not), Dolly dies inside it. This earns the inspiration Fly-Swatter ( Haunted One background).
• If Kar'niss is killed at the ambush and the lantern is taken by the Harpers, the party can follow them back to Last Light Inn. There Isobel gives the party the same Moonlantern with Dolly Dolly Dolly alive inside; she can be freed and the Pixie Blessing may then still be obtained.
• Switching to ranged weapons while having a Moonlantern equipped retains the Moonshield effect but removes the illumination, allowing darkness-requiring effects such as Covert Critical and Shadow Step to be safely used within the Shadow-Cursed Lands.
• See also:
• Broken Moonlantern
• Dead Pixie
• Filigreed Feywild Bell
• Shadow Lantern

name: Nyrulna
description: Nyrulna is a legendary +3 Trident which can be thrown to create an explosion that deals Thunder damage in an area. It grants additional movement speed and jump distance and returns to the wielder after being thrown.
quote: The forgemaster Lirrico designed this weapon for the champion of the wind goddess [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Akadi Akadi]. A key component in the forging was his home city's wind, and for a year after the weapon was made, no wind blew there at all.
notes:
• Akabi, in the Circus of the Last Days, teleports the character who is talking with him to the Jungle - after they win the jackpot. While in the jungle, just prior to the exit, the chest can be found.
• A DC 20 Sleight of Hand Check is necessary to unlock the chest.
• This is arguably one of the most powerful thrown weapons in the game, especially when used in conjunction with Tavern Brawler and Enraged Throw. In addition to its returning quality as a thrown weapon and its +3 enchantment bonus, Zephyr Connection is quite potent:
• The explosion caused by it happens whenever a thrown attack roll is made, even if the attack misses; it does not happen if the weapon is thrown to a location on the ground without targeting something (no attack roll).
• The 3d4 Thunder damage from throwing this weapon applies to all creatures and destructible objects within its 6m area of effect. Dealing damage to non-hostile targets in populated areas (such as the Lower City) counts as a hostile action and causes nearby civilians or guards to attack the party.
• Dyes cannot be applied to this weapon.

name: Phalar Aluve
description: Phalar Aluve is a rare +1 Longsword that can be made to Sing or Shriek, granting nearby allies or enemies a bonus to Attack Rolls or damage rolls, depending on the choice.
quote:
The Drow inscription on this blade appears to have been recently carved. It translates to;
“
'Though I have to leave you, I will dance forever in Eilistraee's Light.'
„
special:
• Performance +1
Phalar Aluve: Melody (Action)
The sword hums in anticipation, ready to Sing or Shriek (see bugs on their respective pages). ( Recharge: Short rest.)
notes:
• The sword can be freed in these ways:
• Passing a DC 15 Strength Check to yank it from the stone.
• Passing a DC 15 Religion Check to learn how to release the magic holding it in place. Clerics of Lolth have Advantage on this check.
• Paladins can pass a DC 10 Religion Check (with Advantage) to consider what the appropriate ritual for releasing the sword is. If successful, they can perform the ritual, or use their oath to prove their worth ( DC 10 Charisma Check).
• Clerics of Eilistraee can release the sword without passing an ability check.
• Spilling Blood on the stone surface beneath the sword outside dialogue makes it light up, so it can be pulled out without any ability check. It is possible to make one party member hit another, or inflict the Bleeding condition (f.e., perform a Blood Sacrifice with the Ritual Dagger, or throw a Spiked Bulb). It is also possible to throw a dead body on the sword.
• Longswords do not normally have the Finesse property; Phalar Aluve is special in this regard. The only other example is Larethian's Wrath.
• Phalar Aluve is Drow language. Phalar means 'battle-marker' or 'grave', and Aluve means 'I/we leave you'.
• Obtaining the sword by correctly performing the rite grants the inspiration Last Rites of the Dark Dancer for party members with the Acolyte background. If the sword was freed through a Strength check, or through class-based options of a Paladin, the inspiration is not awarded.
• Although it has a distinctive appearance during the cutscene for its retrieval, when equipped this sword has an appearance similar to that of a Longsword +1, save for its blade, hilt and pommel, which are gold instead of polished steel.

notes_links.text: Last Rites of the Dark Dancer

name: Phasmid Cloak
description: Phasmid Cloak is a common Cloak that provides no bonuses to the wearer.
quote: Zhentarim spies have been known to take on the aspect of the phasmid - an insect sometimes called the devil's darning needle - to blend into their surroundings.

name: Pickaxe
description: War Pick is a mundane, nonmagical variant of the War Picks family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon wielded in two-handed, making it unique among other War Picks.
quote: A plain tool, covered almost entirely in coppery rust.

name: Pike
quote: This pike's broad steel head has been repeatedly bent and hammered back into its original shape.

name: Pike +1
quote: The base of this polearm's shaft is splintered, likely having borne the weight of a rider plucked from their mount.

name: Pitchfork
description:
Pitchfork is a mundane, nonmagical variant of the Spears family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon that must be wielded in both hands as it lacks the Versatile quality. It also cannot be used as a proper Thrown weapon as it also lacks that trait.
Overall, it is a last-resort weapon among even the lowest quality of simple weapons.
quote: A farming tool crafted from mismatched branches, held together by fraying twine.

name: Plague-Green Torch
description: The Plague-Green Torch can be used as a Light Source or as an improvised club. It can be wielded as a simple melee weapon in one hand. It is a light weapon that anyone can dual wield without special training. It can ignite flammable surfaces or clouds if it makes contact.
quote: A deep oily smell wafts from this crude tree branch.
notes:
• When equipped, the Plague-Green Torch is automatically lit and it deals an additional 1d4 Fire damage and gains the Burning condition until extinguished.
• As the name would imply, this torch burns with a green flame when lit.

name: Plain Boots
description: Plain Boots are a common footwear.
quote: These boots are well-maintained and clean, though their soles are thin from wear.

name: Planeslayer Flail
quote: Passed from hand to hand by those who hunt creatures from beyond the Material Plane, this flail has two words scrawled on it: 'No Trespassing.'

name: Plate Armour
description: Plate Armour is a common Heavy Armour.
where_to_find: Sold by A'jak'nir Jeera
notes: • Plate Armour has no in-game item description.

name: Plate Armour +1
description: Plate Armour +1 is an uncommon Heavy Armour that reduces Piercing damage.
where_to_find: Sold by traders using the levelled magic armour table if the player character is between levels 8 and 10
notes: • Plate Armour has no in-game item description.

name: Plate Armour +2
description: Plate Armour +2 is a rare Heavy Armour that reduces damage from Piercing, Bludgeoning and Slashing sources by 2.
where_to_find: Sold by traders using the levelled magic armour table if the player character is level 11 or above
bugs: • This armour is missing pauldrons when worn by body type 1 humanoids ('non-strong female').
notes: • Plate Armour has no in-game item description.

name: Pointed-Toe Shoes
description: Pointed-Toe Shoes is a common pair of Camp Shoes.
quote: The height of modern Sword Coastian fashion, provided you like being targetted by muggers and thugs and other interesting friendly people.
bugs: • Dwarves, gnomes, and female halflings use the 3D model of Tasteful Boots instead of the correct visual.

name: Poisoner's Gloves
description: Poisoner's Gloves are a rare set of Gloves. They afford their wearer a chance to poison a target (DC 13) every time it receives Poison damage.
quote: While the leather is clean and well-maintained, a cold, acrid smell permeates these gloves.
where_to_find: in a chest at the back of the building

name: Poisoner's Ring
icon: Ring G Gold A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Poisoner's Ring is an uncommon Ring which allows the wearer to cast Virulent Venom.
quote: Strange, green fumes seep from the ring's emerald.
where_to_find: Sold by Roah Moonglow on the main floor
special:
Virulent Venom (Action)
Point your ringed finger at a target to make it vulnerable to Poison damage, unless it is immune to Poison damage. ( Recharge: Long rest.)
notes:
• Contrary to the description, Virulent Venom may be cast on up to three targets, or up to three times on the same target.
• A target does not automatically receive Poison vulnerability. It must first fail a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw.
• Targets that have Poison resistance lose the resistance (instead of becoming vulnerable).
• Targets that have Poison immunity will see no change, despite being able to be targeted by this effect.

name: Poisoner's Robe
description: The Poisoner's Robe is an uncommon piece of Clothing that makes the wearer's poison spells deal more damage.
quote: Found in the Spider Queen's stomach, this robe emanates a sour smell and stings to the touch.
where_to_find: Carried by the Phase Spider Matriarch in her lair

name: Polished Dagger
quote: The dagger's leather grip is stamped with a stag's head - the symbol of the Emerald Enclave.

variants.icon: Amulet Necklace F Bronze A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
variants.description: Polished Necklace is a common amulet with no magical enchantment, simply serving as valuable clutter for the player to sell.
variants.quote: Heavily set with gemstones, this necklace weighs more than expected.

variants.image: Amulet Necklace F Gold A Faded.png
variants.controller_icon: Amulet Necklace F Gold A Unfaded.png
