variants.name: Polished Ring
variants.icon: Ring E Silver A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
variants.description: A Polished Ring is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.
variants.quote: Each purple gemstone set in this thin silver band has been polished until it gleams.
variants.where_to_find: In chests and carried by characters throughout the game

name: Polished Ring
icon: Ring E Silver A Unfaded Icon.png
description: A Polished Ring is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.
quote: Each purple gemstone set in this thin silver band has been polished until it gleams.
where_to_find: In chests and carried by characters throughout the game

name: Poo-Scraper
description: Poo-Scraper is a named non-magical dagger.
quote: Fecund and revolting, the Abyss is not the worst place this has been.
notes:
• Possibly a reference to an [https://www.reddit.com/r/MuseumOfReddit/comments/ke8skw/the_poop_knife/ infamous Reddit post] about a "family poop knife."
• To be "fecund" means that one has lots of children, so it's likely that the word Larian meant was "fetid," which means to be filthy and harboring of disease.

name: Potent Robe
description: The Potent Robe is a very rare piece of Clothing that uses the wearer's Charisma modifier to increase their cantrips' damage as well as give them temporary hit points.
quote: This robe is a difficult look to pull off unless one is blessed with an otherwordly charisma.
where_to_find: Rewarded by Alfira for successfully completing Rescue the Tieflings
special: • Armour Class +1
notes: • Alfira must be alive to receive this item. Although the quest can technically be completed with her dead, there is no one else to provide this specific reward. The only way to obtain this robe as the Dark Urge is to knock Alfira out (in Act One) by using non-lethal attacks prior to actually going to sleep on the night she appears at camp, thereby forcing a substitute, Quil, to appear and be murdered in her place as a victim of the Dark Urge.

name: Practice Sword
description: The Practice Sword is a common Shortsword. It lacks the weapon actions of other shortswords, but is also the only shortsword that deals Bludgeoning damage.
quote: Though carefully coated in a thick layer of varnish, the edges of the wooden sword are already starting to chip away.
notes:
• This is the only finesse weapon that deals Bludgeoning damage, thus capable of bludgeoning via Sneak Attack. This makes it highly valuable in some situations, enabling a single, high-damage strike against enemies naturally vulnerable to Bludgeoning, or those under the Brittle, Frozen, or Superheated conditions.
• Practice Sword does not have a "faded image", and the tooltip is simply empty where the image normally is. (See Gallery).
• Unlike other shortswords, this sword is sheathed on the wielder's hip instead of the back.

name: Prison Tatters
description: Prison Tatters is a common Camp Clothing.
quote: Infested with vermin and stiff with dirt, this garb - if you can call it such - reeks to high heaven.
where_to_find: Available only to Minsc in the epilogue if the Zhentarim take over the Guild

name: Pristine Meshtoe Sandals
description: Pristine Meshtoe Sandals is a common pair of Camp Shoes.
quote: A mesh of webbed material protects the toes from errant spiders - these seem brand new, and never worn.
where_to_find: Can be received as a gift from Scratch

name: Promise
quote: A leafy pattern is carved into the dagger's blade. It glows faintly in the dark.

name: Protective Plate
description: Protective Plate is a set of Heavy Armour that grants Resistance to Necrotic damage.
where_to_find: Worn by the Hollow Armour at the bottom of the pit
special:
• Grants Resistance to Necrotic damage
• Does not give disadvantage on stealth checks.
notes: • This item shares a visual model with Plate Armour.

name: Psionic Ward Armour
description: Psionic Ward Armour is a set of rare Medium Armour. It heals the wearer if they if they pass a Saving Throw against a spell, and gives them Resistance to Psychic damage if they are Githyanki.
quote: After all that was done to them at the illithids' caprice, it is little wonder that the gith would construct armaments fit for combating the psionic might
where_to_find: Worn by Ch'r'ai Tska'an near the bridge leading to the To Baldur's Gate waypoint

name: Psychic Spark
image: Amulet Necklace B Silver A 1 Faded.png
controller_icon: Amulet Necklace B Silver A 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Amulet Necklace B Silver A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Psychic Spark is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to cast a stronger version of Magic Missile.
quote: Every gem hanging from this necklace is warm to the touch, as if waiting to ignite.
where_to_find: Sold by Blurg
special:
Magic Missile (Action)
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Punch-Drunk Bastard
description: Punch-Drunk Bastard is a rare +1 Greatclub. While the wielder is drunk it grants them Advantage on weapon attacks and also creates a Thunder blast on each melee hit.
quote: You see... *hic* the thing... the really, really important thing *hic*... about this item is *belches copiously*... oh sod it, it's a club. Enjoy.

name: Pyroquickness Hat
description: Pyroquickness Hat is a very rare Hat that burns the wearer when casting a Fire spell, but also grants them an extra Bonus Action.
quote: Merely holding the circlet makes your skin flush, filling you with determination and righteous fury.
where_to_find: In an invisible chest in the vault of Elminster
notes:
• See Invisibility or Faerie Fire can be used to see the invisible chest.
• The Helldusk Armour or Wet condition can negate the self-burning effect on the wearer while still allowing them to receive the extra bonus action.
• The description and uid reference a circlet, as this item was adapted from the Circlet of Fire

variants.name: Quarterstaff
variants.quote: Part of this staff has taken on a deep red colour.

variants.name: Quarterstaff
variants.description: The Druid Quarterstaff is a visually different variant of the regular Quarterstaff. The only change is in appearance; all actual attributes are exactly the same. Custom characters of the Druid class start the game with this weapon.
variants.quote: Someone has carved twenty-seven small lines into the hard wood.

name: Quarterstaff
quote: Someone has carved twenty-seven small lines into the hard wood.

name: Quarterstaff +1
quote: A polished wooden staff, embellished with knobs and steel for both function and design.

name: Quarterstaff +2
quote: Steel bands wrap around a wooden core, giving this staff extra momentum.

name: Quickspell Gloves
description: Quickspell Gloves are a pair of Very Rare Gloves that grant the wearer the ability to cast a Cantrip as a Bonus Action instead of an Action, once per Short Rest.
quote: These gloves were worn by the wizard Bucknard, who always maintained that speed was most important in spellcasting. This, because even if you royally bugger up the spell, you've got enough time to leg it away afterward.
where_to_find: Sold by Lorroakan's Projection or Rolan on the ground floor

name: Quite Fashionable Boots
description: Quite Fashionable Boots are a common pair of Shoes.
quote: Made of tough, well-worn leather, these boots have survived years of use, and can survive many more.
where_to_find: On a table in the south-eastern room

name: Raffish Bronze-Red Outfit
description: Raffish Bronze-Red Outfit is a set of common Camp Clothing.
quote: Raffish (meaning sly and disreputable in an alluring way) comes from Raffish Buck Daederum, whose fashion this ensemble mimicks closely.

name: Raffish Chestnut Outfit
description: Raffish Chestnut Outfit is a set of common Camp Clothing.
quote: Raffish (meaning sly and disreputable in an alluring way) comes from Raffish Buck Daederum, whose fashion this ensemble mimicks closely.

name: Raffish Garb
description: Raffish Garb is a set of common Camp Clothing.
quote: Something slightly perilous and fun imbues this design of garments.
notes: • This item is visually identical to Raffish Metallic-Shaded Outfit.

name: Raffish Metallic-Shaded Outfit
description: Raffish Metallic-Shaded Outfit is a set of common Camp Clothing.
quote: Raffish (meaning sly and disreputable in an alluring way) comes from Raffish Buck Daederum, whose fashion this ensemble mimicks closely.
notes: • This item is visually identical to Raffish Garb.

name: Raffish Midnight Outfit
description: Raffish Midnight Outfit is a set of common Camp Clothing.
quote: Raffish (meaning sly and disreputable in an alluring way) comes from Raffish Buck Daederum, whose fashion this ensemble mimicks closely.

name: Rain Dancer
description: Rain Dancer is an uncommon Quarterstaff that grants the wielder the ability to cast Create Water, once per Short Rest.
quote: A pale staff inlaid with a droplet-shaped topaz. It is cool to the touch.
special:
Create Water (Action)
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Short rest.)

name: Rapier
quote: A slender but deadly sword, favoured by Waterdhavian nobility.

name: Rapier +1
quote: A skillful smith decorated the wooden handle with a fine golden filigree.

name: Rapier +2
quote: The thin edge of this sword seems to blur and become nigh imperceptible with even the slightest movement.

name: Rat Bat
description: The Rat Bat is a rare Greatclub that grants the wielder Advantage on their Attack Rolls against beasts.
quote: A club with nails hammered through it. Classic.
bugs: • It is not listed anywhere in-game, but the Rat Bat deals an extra 1d6 PiercingDamage Rider As Source damage (non-magical).
notes:
• Unlike other greatclubs, this weapon does not have the Tenacity feature.
• This weapon is a possible reference to the American sitcom It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia, where in episode 10 of season 6, "Charlie's Surprise Party", one of the characters, Charlie, is gifted a bat covered with chains and nails, dubbed the "Rat Stick".

name: Raven Gloves
description: Raven Gloves are rare Gloves that allow the wearer to summon a Raven.
quote: Dark and suitably moody, these gloves are perfect for wearing while thinking about poetry.
where_to_find: Given by He Who Was as a reward for completing the quest Punish the Wicked
special:
Summon Quothe the Raven (Action)
Summon a raven familiar that can Blind enemies with its beak. ( Recharge: Short rest.)

name: Ravengard's Scourger
description: Ravengard's Scourger is a rare +2 Morningstar that allows the wielder to cast Commander's Strike.
quote: Duke Ravengard's father was the sort of man who works with his hands, and communicates in grunts. In his heart his son vowed to do better. But when Wyll was born, Ravengard felt a strange gravity that drew him away from his son.
special:
Commander's Strike (Action + Bonus Action)
Direct an ally to strike a foe. The ally uses a reaction on their next turn to make a weapon attack. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
bugs:
• When dual-wielding a flail or morningstar with a non-Tenacity weapon using the Dual Wielder feat, Tenacity can be triggered by missing an attack with the non-Tenacity weapon, dealing Bludgeoning damage regardless of the weapon used.
• Some non-Tenacity weapons can trigger their on-hit effects via Tenacity as well, such as the Ritual Dagger and Loviatar's Scourge.

name: Reaper's Embrace
description: Reaper's Embrace is a very rare heavy Armour that reduces incoming damage by 2 and makes the wearer immune to being moved by force. It also grants the Howl of the Dead class action.
quote: Heavy steel bones and teeth enclose the armour's chest and neck like a grotesque exoskeleton that both swallows and protects the wearer.
where_to_find: Worn by Ketheric Thorm
special:
Howl of the Dead (Bonus Action)
Let out a bone-chilling howl that Numbs all nearby creatures. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
bugs: • When equipped on characters who have Body Type 4 the shoulder pauldrons of this armour may appear stretched or distorted, particularly when viewed from the side. Body Type 4 is Strong Masculine, and is available for Humans (e.g., Minsc), Elves, Drow, Half-Elves (e.g., Halsin), and Tieflings.

name: Reason's Grasp
description: Reason's Grasp are an uncommon pair of Gloves that give the wearer Temporary Hit Points if they choose to end their Rage.
quote: The snug fit of these gloves resist a balled fist - as if favouring the open hand of peace.
where_to_find: In a locked chest in the cave where survivors of the attacked caravan are fending off a pack of gnolls, behind the survivors, against the cave wall

name: Rebound Battleaxe
quote: This axe is so loyal, it will sometimes return to wielders it favours.
special: • This blade's magical powers only function if it's Bound to an Eldritch Knight or is a Warlocks's Pact Weapon.
bugs:
• If this weapon is bound by an Eldritch Knight or Pact of the Blade Warlock, the weapon will retain its Favoured Weapon passive until the next long rest even if the character binds another weapon. The weapon will even retain this passive if the weapon is used by another character, different from the one who bound it.
• If this weapon is bound by an Eldritch Knight or Pact of the Blade Warlock, this weapon will permanently retain the thunder damage bonus from It's All In The Wrists while the thrown property will remain until the next long rest even if the character binds another weapon. The weapon will even retain this passive if the weapon is used by another character, different from the one who bound it.

name: Red Carmine Mask
controller_icon: Item ARM Helmet Leather B Icon.png
icon: Item ARM Helmet Leather B Unfaded Icon.png
description: A Red Carmine Mask is a common Helmet.
quote: Dyed as red as gladiatorial blood.
where_to_find: on the top floor, sitting on a table
special: • Dexterity Saving Throws +1

name: Regal Helm
description: A Regal Helm is a common Helmet.
quote: As royal as taxation.
where_to_find: On a table/shelf in the Morgue
special: • Constitution Saving Throws +1

name: Reinforced Greatsword
description: Reinforced Greatsword is a common variant of the Greatswords family of weapons.
quote: This cumberstone blade looks strong enough to survive journey through all nine Hells.
notes:
• This greatsword cannot be used as an ingredient for the Finish the Masterwork Weapon quest.
• This sword can be found next to the Reinforced Helmet.
• Upon a successful perception roll, if Karlach is in the party, she will say. "Nice sword. Jaunty hat. Karlach like."

name: Reinforced Helmet
controller_icon: Item ARM Helmet Metal J Icon.png
icon: Item ARM Helmet Metal J Unfaded Icon.png
description: A Reinforced Helmet is a common Helmet.
quote: Forged from an unfamiliar alloy. Uncommonly rugged.
where_to_find: In the swamp north of Riverside Teahouse, Sunlit Wetlands at X: -4 Y: 277
special: • Constitution Saving Throws +1
notes:
• This helmet can be found next to the Reinforced Greatsword.
• Upon a successful perception roll, if Karlach is in the party, she will say. "Nice sword. Jaunty hat. Karlach like."

name: Reliably Built Boots
icon: Vanity Circus Shoes A Unfaded Icon.png
description: Reliably Built Boots is a common pair of Camp Shoes.
quote: Made of tough, well-worn leather, these boots have survived years of use, and can survive many more.
where_to_find: on the ground, next to Elyna

name: Render of Mind and Body
description: Render of Mind and Body is an uncommon +1 Shortsword that deals additional Psychic damage whenever the attack is made at Advantage.
quote: The best offence is a struck cognisance.
notes: • Disciple Z'rell needs to be convinced to give additional aid in finding Ketheric's relic.

name: Render of Scrumptious Flesh
description: Render of Scrumptious Flesh is a rare, moderately enchanted (+2) variant of the Longswords family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon that can be wielded in one hand, or with both hands for extra damage.
quote: It might be your imagination, but when blood runs over the blade, you could swear you hear... slurping.

name: Resonance Stone
description: This stone gives you and those around you the Steeped in Bliss condition. Resonance Stones heighten emotion in those who stand within their radius.
quote: This unique and weird looking stone grants euphoria to all who bask in its glory, but all things come at a cost.
effect: Everyone within AoE: 9 m (30 ft) Radius gains Steeped in Bliss.
notes: • The player character and their companions remark on the stone's effect, noting they suddenly feel happier when gaining the condition. They also sometimes comment, if they realize, that it was only a psionic manipulation when they lose it.

name: Returning Pike
description: Returning Pike is an uncommon +1 Pike that returns to the wielder automatically after being thrown.
quote: A 'Crazy Wilbur' is a technique invented by the dwarvish Ticklebeard Clan. It involves getting your larger enemies to swallow your weapon, then calling it back to you - as messily as possible.
notes:
• Returning Pike is the only pike in the game with the Thrown property.
• Returning Pike is automatically equipped to the Main Hand (melee) of the thrower after being thrown even if it was not already equipped, potentially replacing any currently equipped melee weapons. This can allow for swapping weapons in combat without using an action.
• With higher than normal base damage for a thrown weapon (d10 versus a typical d8 or d6) and its returning property, the Returning Pike works well early in the game with Tavern Brawler and Enraged Throw.

name: Reverse Rain Cloak
description: Reverse Rain Cloak is an uncommon Cloak that grants the user the condition Wet while worn, increasing resistance to Fire, but granting vulnerability to Lightning and Cold damage.
quote: The wearer is perpetually just a little bit damp.
where_to_find: Given as a consolation prize by Akabi after failing to win the jackpot at the Wheel of Fortune
special: Wet
notes:
• Act Three: Although referenced by the tooltip quote, the in-game tooltip omits informing that the wearer becomes (and remains) Wet while wearing this item.
• If worn before resting the Wet condition is removed from the wearer until taken off and re-equipped.

name: Rhapsody
description: Rhapsody is a very rare +1 Dagger that grants better Attack Rolls, damage, and Spell Save DC for every foe slain (up to 3) and possibly inflicts Bleeding while the wielder is Hiding or Invisible.
quote: Cazador's love of poetry arose after he read one on the naked stomach of a dead child in his homeland. The child was hung from the lowest branch of a tree. Cazador read the poem, and looked at the child, and he knew that here was the artform for him.
special:
At 3 stacks of Scarlet Remittance:
Scarlet Feast (Bonus Action)
If you have a +3 bonus from
Scarlet Remittance, consume it to empower yourself in combat. ( Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Rich Arcanist Helmet
icon: Helmet of Arcane Acuity Unfaded Icon.png
description: A Rich Arcanist Helmet is a common Helmet.
quote: Years of sweat and use have slowly darkened the leather of this cap.
where_to_find: On a shelf in the Infiltration Training room
special: • Dexterity Saving Throws +1

name: Ring Mail Armour
description: Ring Mail Armour is a common Heavy Armour.
where_to_find: Sold by Dammon in The Hollow
notes: • Ring Mail Armour has no in-game item description.

name: Ring Mail Armour +1
icon: Ring Mail Armour PlusOne Unfaded Icon.png
description: Ring Mail Armour +1 is a uncommon Heavy Armour that grants a +1 bonus to Strength Saving Throws and Ability Checks.
where_to_find: Sold by traders using the levelled magic armour table if the player is between levels 2 and 4
notes: • Ring Mail Armour has no in-game item description.

name: Ring Mail Armour +2
icon: Ring Mail Armour PlusTwo Unfaded Icon.png
description: Ring Mail Armour +2 is a rare Heavy Armour that reduces Slashing damage by 1 and grants a +1 bonus to Strength Saving Throws and Ability Checks.
where_to_find: Sold by traders using the levelled magic armour table if the player is between levels 5 and 8
notes: • Ring Mail Armour has no in-game item description.

name: Ring of Absolute Force
icon: Ring of Absolute Force Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Ring of Absolute Force is an uncommon Ring. It allows the wearer to cast the Thunderwave spell and deal 1 additional thunder damage if they have the Absolute's Brand.
quote: Darkness seems to blossom from this ring, heightened by the menacing glare of the Absolute's symbol, though for the Branded this symbol holds the promise of power.
where_to_find: Carried by Sergeant Thrinn
special:
Thunderwave (Action)
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Short rest.)
notes:
• This ring is not an independent source of thunder damage; it requires that the wearer deal Thunder Damage (through spell, attack, or condition such as Reverberation) for Absolute Tempest to activate.
• This ring pairs well with Nyrulna's various types of thunder damage.

name: Ring of Arcane Synergy
icon: Ring B Silver A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Ring of Arcane Synergy is a rare Ring. It grants Arcane Synergy when the wearer deals damage with a cantrip.
quote: The sharp silver corners of this ring almost cut into the stone set in its centre - a gem of which you've never seen the like before.
where_to_find: Worn by Gish Far'aag

name: Ring of Beguiling
icon: Ring B Silver A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Ring of Beguiling is an inaccessible rare Ring that allows the wearer to cast the Charm Person spell once per Long Rest.
quote: Whispers in the Deep Speech of the Underdark insinuate themselves into the mind of whoever so much as brushes against the burnished metal of this ring
special:
Charm Person (Action + Level 1 Spell Slot)
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Ring of Being Really Invisible
icon: Ring A Simple Gold Unfaded Icon.png
description: A Ring of Being Really Invisible is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.
quote: This ring is missing its gem - or perhaps it's just very invisible.
where_to_find: Sold by Mattis

name: Ring of Blink
image: Ring A Gem A Gold 1 Faded.png
controller_icon: Ring A Gem A Gold 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Ring A Gem A Gold 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Ring of Blink is a rare Ring that allows the wearer to cast Blink once per Long Rest.
quote: Fashioned by the wizard [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Bigby Bigby] in honour of his faithful hound Bigboy, who could use teleportation to fetch, snare errant cats, and generally harass postmen.
where_to_find: Reward from Tara, on the roof of the temple
special:
Blink (Action)
Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
notes: • No skill check is required with Tara if playing as Gale or he is in the active party.

name: Ring of Colour Spray
description: Ring of Colour Spray is an uncommon Ring which allows the wearer to cast Colour Spray once per short rest.
quote: When the light hits it just so, the centre jewel shimmers with every colour of the rainbow.
where_to_find: In the Harpy Nest to the south of the harpy encounter
special:
Colour Spray (Action)
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Short rest.)

name: Ring of Crabsight
description: Ring of Crabsight is an uncommon Ring that grants +2 Perception.
quote: Mud cakes the tiny letters of an inscription - 'A Cursed Sight Doth Dwell Beneath'.
special: • Perception +2
notes: • This ring's UID suggests it was intended for an unfinished/cut quest.

name: Ring of Elemental Infusion
icon: Ring H Gold A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Ring of Elemental Infusion is an uncommon Ring that infuses your weapon with the element of your spells or cantrips, dealing additional damage.
quote: The mysterious gem set in this ring seems to change hues whenever you aren't looking.
where_to_find: Worn by Gish Umr'a'ac in the southern section of the Infirmary

name: Ring of Evasion
description: Ring of Evasion is a very rare Ring that grants the wearer Dextrous Evasion.
quote: Decorated with a hummingbird wrought of jade and sapphire, this ring evokes the sheer wonderful quickness of that animal.
where_to_find: Given by Tara during the first Long Rest following the completion of the Escape the Nautiloid quest (only if Gale is chosen as Origin)

name: Ring of Exalted Marrow
icon: Ring of Exalted Marrow Unfaded Icon.png
description: Ring of Exalted Marrow is a rare Ring that grants the wearer the ability to cast Exhort the Risen and Ghoulish Touch.
quote: Gazing through this ring, you find that there is no other side, only a small sucking blackness that defies explanation.
where_to_find: In a heavy chest at the altar
special:
Exhort the Risen (Action)
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
Ghoulish Touch (Action)
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Ring of Feywild Sparks
icon: Ring H Gold A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Ring of Feywild Sparks is a very rare Ring. It forces Wild Magic Surges to always trigger while Tides of Chaos feature is active. It also grants a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC.
quote: This otherwise unassuming ring ties a spellcaster indelibly to the sporadic arcana of the Faerie realm.
where_to_find: Carried by Auntie Ethel
special: • You gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC.
bugs: • The bonus to Spell Save DC is not indicated by the in-game tooltip.

name: Ring of Fire
icon: Ring I Silver A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Ring of Fire is an uncommon Ring that grants the wearer additional fire damage when dealing fire damage.
quote: A burning heat radiates from this ring, warming the wearer from head to toe.
where_to_find: Rewarded by Sovereign Glut for completing Avenge Glut's Circle (Early Access only)
notes:
• This reward was changed to Winter's Clutches in the full release of the game.
• The quest reward was a choice between this item and Featherlight Boots.

name: Ring of Flinging
icon: Ring C Silver A Unfaded Icon.png
description: Ring of Flinging is an uncommon Ring that improves throwing damage.
quote: Organisations like the Harpers do not relegate their activities to head-to-head combat - many a moonlit chase with an evildoer has been resolved with a loose roof tile and a decent throwing arm.
where_to_find: Sold by Arron next to the Silvanus statue

name: Ring of Free Action
icon: Ring of Free Action Unfaded Icon.png
description: Ring of Free Action is a rare Ring which allows the wearer to ignore the effects of Difficult Terrain and confers immunity to Paralysis and being Restrained.
quote: The heart of the gem seems to flow like liquid - yet it contains neither quicksilver nor mercury.
where_to_find: Sold by Araj Oblodra on the main floor

name: Ring of Geniality
icon: Ring H Silver A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Ring of Geniality is an uncommon Ring that grants a boost to Persuasion and Deception.
quote: Glibness is not only in the tongue, but in the body. Gesture is powerful. Think of how many words of comfort can be stored and saved, when a hug will do just as sweetly.
where_to_find: Sold by Barcus Wroot at his workshop
special:
• Persuasion +1
• Deception +1

name: Ring of Infinite Wishes
icon: Ring A Simple Gold Unfaded Icon.png
description: A Ring of Infinite Wishes is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.
quote: The exterior of this ring is roughly carved with nonsensical runes.
where_to_find: Sold by Mattis

name: Ring of Jumping
description: Ring of Jumping is an uncommon Ring that grants the wearer the ability to cast Enhance Leap once per Short Rest.
quote: The ring is scuffed and twisted out of shape, as if worn by big stony fingers. The owner of those fingers has carved 'Karthol' into the warped metal in a fit of affection or possessiveness.
where_to_find: Sold by Derryth Bonecloak in the Underdark
special:
Enhance Leap (Bonus Action)
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Short rest.)
notes: • The spell being cast as a bonus action (rather than the usual full action) is actually a detriment as it means that most characters will not be able to cast the spell on themselves and then jump in the same turn.

name: Ring of Mental Inhibition
description: Ring of Mental Inhibition is an uncommon Ring that places a mentally weakening condition on enemies who fail to Save against the wearer's spells and abilities.
quote: The patterns in the ring's swirling metal make your head spin whenever you look at them for too long.
where_to_find: in a locked chest, just east of the Waypoint of the Shadowed Battlefield

name: Ring of Mind-Shielding
icon: Ring G Silver A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Ring of Mind-Shielding is a rare Ring that gives advantage on saving throws against being Charmed.
quote: This ring is forged from a smooth, alien metal, capped with eyes of emerald that watch the world unblinking.
where_to_find: Offered by Omeluum upon completion of the quest Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite
notes:
• Although offered by Omeluum, it does not do so for free. The player character must persuade or intimidate it, or pay for it; either with gold or by trading a story or information about the Nautiloid. It is also possible to pickpocket the ring, once it becomes available.
• This ring was originally called the Ring of Psionic Protection in Early Access. It blocked the use of Illithid powers for the wearer.
• This ring is particularly useful in Act One as it grants advantage on the saving throws against the Luring Song of the Harpies.

name: Ring of Murderous Opportunity
icon: Ring H Silver A Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Ring of Murderous Opportunity is a unique Ring.
quote: Formless, unsettling dread fills any normal folk that don this ring - the transpositional magic thrumming within wishes to be used by only one specific scion of murder.
where_to_find: Carried by Orin
notes: • While this ring has no mechanical function, Orin can be seen twisting it when she teleports.

name: Ring of Poison Resistance
description: The Ring of Poison Resistance is a rare Ring that grants the wearer Resistance to Poison damage.
quote: The ring's emerald glows a deep, deadly green.
where_to_find: On a skeleton inside an opened sarcophagus just before the Worg Pens area
special: • Resistance to Poison damage.

name: Ring of Protection
description: The Ring of Protection is a rare Ring that grants the wearer a bonus to Armour Class and Saving Throws.
quote: Elegant motifs of warding - shields, targes, bucklers, and buffers - are faintly impressed into the metal round of the ring.
where_to_find: Rewarded by Mol for completing the quest Steal the Sacred Idol in the Emerald Grove
special:
• Armour Class +1
• Saving Throw +1

name: Ring of Regeneration
description: Ring of Regeneration is a very rare Ring that heals the wearer at the beginning of their turn while in combat.
quote: This ring is, in effect, a tiny field medic that won't charge you 70 gold pieces for a fifteen-minute consultation.
where_to_find:
Act Three:
• If Rolan is dead: Sold by Lorroakan's Projection in Sorcerous Sundries
• If Rolan and Lorroakan are both alive: Sold by Rolan in Sorcerous Sundries
• If Rolan is alive but Lorroakan is dead: Carried by Rolan in Ramazith's Tower shortly after Lorroakan is killed (may disappear from Rolan's inventory later)
• If both Rolan and Lorroakan are dead or missing: Ring is unavailable

name: Ring of Resistance to Ants
icon: Ring A Simple Gold Unfaded Icon.png
description: A Ring of Resistance to Ants is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.
quote: A glob of tree sap studded with dead ants occupies the space where this ring's stone once sat.
where_to_find: Sold by Mattis
notes: • As there are no hostile ants in Baldur's Gate 3, it is impossible to gauge this item's actual effectiveness.

name: Ring of Restorative Gravity
icon: Ring D Silver A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Ring of Restorative Gravity is an uncommon Ring that pulls creatures towards the wearer when healed by them.
quote: A hymn to Eilistraee is inscribed along the inside of this ring, which is surprisingly heavy when worn.
notes:
• This ring was only available in Early Access. It was sold by Omeluum in the Myconid Colony after completing his quest Help Omeluum investigate the parasite. In the Release Version, it was replaced by the Ring of Salving, though its 'gravity-themed' flavour text was retained.
• Prior to release, Saviour's Allure had the following effect: When the wearer heals another creature, it is pulled 2m / 7ft towards them.

name: Ring of Salving
icon: Ring D Silver A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Ring of Salving is an uncommon Ring which restores additional hit points every time the wearer heals another creature.
quote: A hymn to Eilistraee is inscribed along the inside of this ring, which is surprisingly heavy when worn.
where_to_find: Sold by Omeluum after completing the quest Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite
notes: • The flavor text reflects the fact that in Early Access, the effect of Saviour's Allure was to pull creatures the wearer healed toward them. The item itself was called Ring of Restorative Gravity.

name: Ring of Self Immolation
icon: Ring C Silver A Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Ring of Self Immolation is an uncommon Ring that grants its wearer the ability to use the Self Immolation ability to gain the Heat condition.
quote: Every one of the three gems in this ring is searing hot - enough to burn yourself with the slightest brush of your fingers.
where_to_find: In a locked wooden chest in the tower north of the Shadow-Cursed Shambling Mound ambush
special:
Self Immolation (Bonus Action)
Set yourself on fire to gain Heat. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
notes: • If needed, the key to the chest is nearby on a skeleton, alongside a note.

name: Ring of Shadows
icon: Ring I Gold A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Ring of Shadows is an uncommon Ring that grants its wearer the ability to cast Pass Without Trace once per Long Rest.
quote: For some, darkness is wielded like a black opal stud embedded in a signet ring - fashioned to a sharp and unforgiving point.
where_to_find: Rewarded by Oliver, for playing both rounds of hide and seek with him (regardless of winning or losing)
special:
Pass Without Trace (Action)
Call forth a veil of shadow and silence that gives you and nearby allies a +10 bonus to Stealth Checks. ( Recharge: Long rest.)
bugs: • This item can be unequipped after casting Pass Without Trace from it; the caster will still receive the use of Pass Without Trace until long rest or concentration is broken.
notes: • This ring can also be obtained by knocking out Oliver out or through pick-pocketing him at the exact moment the encounter becomes a tactical turn based encounter and before he vanishes, or if invisible creatures such as he can be seen. Pick-pocketing Oliver does not change how he interacts with the party.

name: Ring of Spiteful Thunder
icon: Ring D Gold A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Ring of Spiteful Thunder is a uncommon Ring that may Daze Reverberating creatures upon which the wearer deals Thunder damage.
quote: When you slip this ring on your hand and flex your fingers, a boom of discontented thunder grumbles in the air around you.
where_to_find: Sold by Roah Moonglow on the main floor
bugs: • If a hireling is dismissed with the Ring of Spiteful Thunder equipped, then they are later resummoned, the ring will have turned into a nonmagical version of itself. This is due to the item template not including the ring's Stats entry.
notes: • This ring pairs well with conditions which inflict disadvantage on constitution saving throws (e.g., Bleeding), and items which inflict reverberation (e.g., Boots of Stormy Clamour).

notes_links.text: conditions which inflict disadvantage on constitution saving throws
notes_links.page: List of features and items that affect saving throws

name: Ring of Truthfulness
icon: Ring C Gold A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Ring of Truthfulness is a rare ring that grants its wearer Advantage on Insight Checks.
quote: 'Fib now, and forever hold your teeth.' - Folk saying
where_to_find: Worn by the newborn Mind Flayer hiding in the basement

name: Ring of Twilight
icon: Ring I Silver A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Ring of Twilight is a rare Ring that increases the wearer's Armour Class while obscured.
quote: Dark smoke swirls in the ring's onyx, protecting something within.
where_to_find: In a traveller's chest hidden behind some pots inside a ruined tower

name: Ring of the Lekinesus
icon: Ring A Simple Gold Unfaded Icon.png
description: A Ring of the Lekinesus is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.
quote: A small pebble swings from a length of fishing line tied to this copper ring.
where_to_find: Sold by Mattis
notes: • The name is a play on ring of telekinesis, a magic item from tabletop D&D that allows the wearer to cast Telekinesis at will.

name: Rippling Force Mail
description: Rippling Force Mail is a rare Heavy Armour that reduces physical damage taken and causes its wearer to deal force damage around them after being struck with physical attacks enough times.
quote: Dents, notches, and nicks add character to each ring of this mail - yet each blemish also speaks to those who tasted magical vengeance on the armour's behalf.
where_to_find: in a locked Rustic Chest on the second floor of Dammon's blacksmith

name: Risky Ring
icon: Ring E Gold A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Risky Ring is a rare Ring. The wearer gains Advantage on Attack Rolls but receives Disadvantage on Saving Throws.
quote: Life is just a series of risks taken while blindfolded.
where_to_find: Sold by Araj Oblodra on the main floor

name: Ritual Axe
description: Ritual Axe is an uncommon Handaxe which inflicts Bane against the wielder's targets.
quote: Though shiny and recently polished, dried blood still fills the deepest crevices of this axe.

name: Ritual Dagger
description: Ritual Dagger is an uncommon dagger that temporarily Blesses the wielder when dealing damage to an enemy - or to themselves.
quote: The leader handle is smooth with use, and slick with fresh blood.
special:
Blood Sacrifice (Bonus Action)
Pain is a path to power. Take 1d4 Slashing damage to receive +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws.
notes:
• Depending on when the party members arrive, Abdirak may be carrying it, or it may be on the table or the floor near him.
• Both effects of this weapon grant the condition The Pain Maiden's Blessing, which is equivalent to a 1-turn duration Bless for the wielder. It does not stack with other conditions with the same stack ID as Bless or with itself.
• In comparison to the Ritual Axe, the self-damage caused by Blood Sacrifice is not magical, so it can be reduced even by non-magical damage reduction effects like Heavy Armour Master.

name: Ritual Dagger of Shar
description: Ritual Dagger of Shar is an uncommon +1 Dagger that deals an additional 1d4 Necrotic damage.
quote: The blade is sharp, and the handle firm. Yet death exudes from this dagger as it might from a fresh corpse.
notes:
• Picking up this dagger:
• Is disapproved of by Shadowheart (-1), unless she does this herself.
• Grants the following inspirations: A Dark Edge ( Criminal background) and Ruthless Craftsmanship ( Guild Artisan background).
• Spawns three powerful sentinels that attack the party.
• The fight with sentinels is still triggered if the dagger is moved from the altar, which also prevents the party from picking up the dagger at all, even after defeating the sentinels – unless it is thrown so Scratch can fetch it.
• As with most weapons, the extra elemental damage (in this case, 1d4 Necrotic) is not applied if Thrown.

name: Ritual Staff
description:
The Ritual Staff is a mundane, nonmagical variant of the Quarterstaves family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon that can be wielded in one hand, or with both hands for extra damage.
Beyond its unique appearance, this staff has the same stats of a normal Quarterstaff.
quote: Streaks of tendon and sinew cling to the animal skull lashed atop of this wooden staff.

name: Road-Dust Grey Clothes
description: Road-Dust Grey Clothes is a set of common Camp Clothing.
quote: Grey with accumulated road dust, these clothes are nothing special.
where_to_find: Throughout the game as set-dressing and random loot
notes: • This item is visually identical to Rustic Dark Outfit.

variants.name: Robe
variants.description: A Robe is a common piece of Clothing.
variants.quote: Crafted with care, this robe will protect you from the elements. It won't do much against a sword's thrust, though.
variants.where_to_find: In a mahogany wardrobe in the Chamberlain's Office

variants.name: Robe
variants.description: A Robe is a common piece of Clothing.
variants.quote: Crafted with care, this robe will protect you from the elements. It won't do much against a sword's thrust, though.
variants.where_to_find: On a shelf

name: Robe
description: A Robe is a common piece of Clothing.
quote: Crafted with care, this robe will protect you from the elements. It won't do much against a sword's thrust, though.

name: Robe +1
description: The Robe +1 is an uncommon enchanted robe.
quote: Artfully crafted, this robe is comfortable and elegant.

name: Robe of Exquisite Focus
icon: Robe of Exquisite Focus Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Robe of Exquisite Focus is a rare article of Clothing that increases its wearer's Spell Save DC.
quote: This robe once belonged to one of the great wizard [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Tenser Tenser's] lecturers. While in university, Tenser used to practise spells on this robe, sometimes resulting in wonderful arcane discovery.
where_to_find: Sold by Araj Oblodra on the main floor
notes: • Despite having less features, this robe sells for more than three times the value of The Protecty Sparkswall.

name: Robe of Spell Resistance
icon: Robe of Spell Resistance Unfaded Icon.png
description: Robe of Spell Resistance is a rare Clothing that allows the wearer to resist the effects of spells.
quote: Handed out to all students during orientation at the arcane universities of the world. However, a bit of enchanted cloth is a meagre defence against one's classmates.
special: • Saving Throws +2

name: Robe of Summer
description: The Robe of Summer is an uncommon piece of Clothing that grants its wearer Resistance to Cold damage.
quote: This robe's thin fabric is pleasantly warm to the touch.
where_to_find: inside a crate in the Hidden Vault within the Druid Grove
special: • Resistance to Cold damage.

name: Robe of Supreme Defences
icon: Robe of Supreme Defences Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Robe of Supreme Defences is a very rare piece of Clothing. It adds the wearer's Spellcasting Modifier to their Saving Throws while concentrating on a spell.
quote: Long ago, the young wizard [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Bigby Bigby] noticed his friend [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Tenser Tenser] spending a lot of time with his robe. One of nature's pranksters, Bigby sent his dog, Bigboy, to savage the garment. The ensuing struggle between canine and nude wizard was brutal, and eventually led to Tenser designing more durable robes like this one.
where_to_find: Sold by Ferg Drogher near the Requisitioned Barn
notes: • This Robe is part of Ferg Drogher's special stock, which requires a Persuasion check to be accessed. He does not sell any items (including this one) if Shadowheart is nearby, unless she killed The Nightsong earlier in Act Two, in which case no persuasion check is needed.

name: Robe of the Weave
icon: Robe of the Weave Unfaded Icon.png
description: Robe of the Weave is a very rare piece of Clothing. It heals the wearer when they succeeding a saving throw against a spell, and boosts their Spell Save DCs and Spell Attack Rolls rolls by 1 each.
quote: Earnest little Edith Cluckle was a small girl when she asked to be the great wizard [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Otiluke Otiluke's] apprentice. He scoffed at her, but was quickly abashed when Mystra herself endowed Edith with this very cloak.
where_to_find: in a Globe of Invulnerability
special: • Armour Class +2
notes: • A party member must use See Invisibility to reveal the lever that controls the globe. Once revealed, each character has a single chance to pass a DC 20 Arcana Check to disable it. If their first attempt fails, a trap triggers for them, and another party member must then make the attempt to obtain this item.

name: Robes of the New Moon
icon: Item EPI Camp Shar Unfaded Icon.png
description: Robes of the New Moon is a common Camp Clothing.
quote: These Sharran robes emphasise authority and austerity over comfort - a negative, like the black hole of the new moon.
where_to_find: Available only to Shadowheart in the epilogue if she embraces Shar

name: Robust Chain Shirt
description: The Robust Chain Shirt is an uncommon Medium Armour that deals Piercing damage to enemies that damage the wearer with a melee attack while the wearer is greatly injured.
quote: A multitude of names is embroidered on the inside collar - the lives of those this shirt has saved.
notes: • Initially a reward given by Sergeant Thrinn for Find the Missing Boots, this armour was substituted for Armour of Uninhibited Kushigo.

name: Rocky's Dog Collar
description: Rocky's Dog Collar is a common Amulet. Primarily of use for barter or sale to Traders.
quote: Smells a bit rusty, but looks stylish nonetheless
where_to_find: Carried by Houndmaster Pol
notes: • Belonged to Rocky when he lived.

name: Rod of Resurrection
description: Rod of Resurrection is a common Quarterstaff
quote: The piece of electrum embedded at the top of this staff is filed to a point so it can 'pierce the Weave itself' - symbolically, at least.
notes: • The Rod of Resurrection is an Item in Baldurs Gate 2.

variants.name: Ruby Ring
variants.icon: Ring C Silver A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
variants.description: Ruby Ring is a common Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.
variants.quote: The setting around the ruby is chipped and scratched, as if somebody had tried to lever the gem free.
variants.where_to_find: In chests and carried by characters throughout the game

variants.name: Ruby Ring
variants.icon: Ring H Silver A Unfaded Icon.png
variants.description: Ruby Ring is a common Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.
variants.quote: The setting around the ruby is chipped and scratched, as if somebody had tried to lever the gem free.

icon: Ring C Silver A Unfaded Icon.png

quote: The setting around the ruby is chipped and scratched, as if somebody had tried to lever the gem free.
where_to_find: In chests and carried by characters throughout the game

name: Rufflesome Blaggart Hat
description: Rufflesome Blaggart Hat is a common Non-Armour Headwear.
quote: For the discerning raconteur, spinner of stories, and peacockish personality.
where_to_find: Found throughout the game as set-dressing and random loot

name: Rupturing Blade
description: Rupturing Blade is an uncommon +1 Rapier that grants the Searing Blood weapon action that deals extra Fire damage on hit, but deals Slashing damage to the wielder. In addition, it also may cause Bleeding and Burning.
quote: The point of the rapier is capable of splitting into heated barbs should the wielder device to prick themselves to activate them - sacrifice for reward.

name: Rusted Blade
quote: Ages of rust have eaten away at this blood-soaked knife.

name: Rustic Dark Outfit
description: Rustic Dark Outfit is a set of common Camp Clothing.
quote: An ensemble very fitting for a relaxing sit by the campfire, wheupon stories are exchanged, generally over hipflasks.
where_to_find: Throughout the game as set-dressing and random loot
notes: • This item is visually identical to Road-Dust Gray Clothes.

name: Rusty Battleaxe
quote: A rust-pitted axe, malodorous in its degradation.

name: Rusty Dagger
quote: Useful for writing your name in damp slush and not much else.

name: Rusty Flail
quote: A pitiful excuse for a flail, pitted with rust.
bugs:
• When dual-wielding a flail or morningstar with a non-Tenacity weapon using the Dual Wielder feat, Tenacity can be triggered by missing an attack with the non-Tenacity weapon, dealing Bludgeoning damage regardless of the weapon used.
• Some non-Tenacity weapons can trigger their on-hit effects via Tenacity as well, such as the Ritual Dagger and Loviatar's Scourge.

name: Rusty Glaive
quote: Ruined with decay.

name: Rusty Greataxe
quote: The beard of this axe is ginger with rust, and therefore soulless.

name: Rusty Greatsword
description: Rusty Greatsword is a common variant of the Greatswords family of weapons.
quote: Large and crusted with rust, and about as useful as a drink of water to a drowning man.

name: Rusty Halberd
quote: A dilapidated old shanker of a weapon.

name: Rusty Hand Crossbow
quote: This adroit little crossbow is undone with rust.

name: Rusty Handaxe
image: Item WPN HUM Battleaxe A 0 Rusty A Faded.png
controller_icon: Item WPN HUM Battleaxe A 0 Rusty A Unfaded.png
icon: Item WPN HUM Battleaxe A 0 Rusty A Unfaded Icon.png
quote: This handaxe is so banjaxed, it'sThis text is written as it appears in the game only possible use could be as a kind of flaky backscratcher.

name: Rusty Heavy Crossbow
quote: Try firing a bolt from this rust-encrusted stock, see if you keep all your fingers.

name: Rusty Light Crossbow
quote: The stock of this crossbow is devoured by decay.

name: Rusty Light Hammer
quote: Pockmarked in rust like flaking red tears, this light hammer is good as a doorstop, and not much else.

name: Rusty Longsword
quote: Mottled with rust, this longsword is a hideous excuse for a blade.

name: Rusty Mace
quote: The head of this mace is a scratchboard of peeling orange rust.

name: Rusty Maul
quote: Rust has eaten clean-through the heavy head of this maul.

name: Rusty Morningstar
quote: The heavy head of this steel star is malefic with rust.
bugs:
• When dual-wielding a flail or morningstar with a non-Tenacity weapon using the Dual Wielder feat, Tenacity can be triggered by missing an attack with the non-Tenacity weapon, dealing Bludgeoning damage regardless of the weapon used.
• Some non-Tenacity weapons can trigger their on-hit effects via Tenacity as well, such as the Ritual Dagger and Loviatar's Scourge.

name: Rusty Pike
quote: Truly the amount of rust accumulated on this pike is a lesson in how not to keep your weapons.

name: Rusty Rapier
quote: So brittle, you could flick it in half.

name: Rusty Scimitar
quote: Only an utter gibbon would consider swinging this in combat.

name: Rusty Shortsword
quote: Leopard spots of rust mottle this sword.

name: Rusty Sickle
image: Item WPN HUM Sickle A 0 Rusty A Faded.png
controller_icon: Item WPN HUM Sickle A 0 Rusty A Unfaded.png

special:
Only useable by the Apostle of Myrkul
• Reaper's Scythe: Swing your weapon in a large arc that knocks targets back 3 m / 10 ft and deals an additional 3d6 Necrotic.
notes:
• This item is used by the the Apostle of Myrkul and cannot be acquired under normal gameplay conditions.
• An Oathbreaker Paladin levelled up to level 12 (e.g., by using mods, cheats, or – possibly – meticulous XP management) before facing the apostle, can use Control Undead on Ketheric Thorm. Level 12 is salient here because Control Undead requires the target's level be under the user's level, and Ketheric is level 11. Killing him while under this condition causes him to drop the scythe. However doing this severely hampers the party and also softlocks the game under most circumstances, as Ketheric's body does not appear, and his Netherstone cannot be obtained. This also likely results in the party being unable to leave the Mind Flayer Colony.
• However, if Ketheric is killed using the method listed above, a party member can ring the Filigreed Feywild Bell and insult Dolly Dolly Dolly, prompting her to polymorph them; in turn circumventing the restriction on fast traveling out of the colony.

name: Sentient Amulet
description: Sentient Amulet is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast Shatter once per Short Rest (with a drawback) and Ki Restoration (lesser) once per Long Rest.
quote: Sun-graced warmth radiates from both the pendant and its chain. Somehow, even a brief glance of it brings a smile to your face.
where_to_find: In a locked Adamantine Chest on the island with the broken structure near the Lava Elemental in Grymforge
special:
Shatter (Action)
Cast as a level 2 spell ( Recharge: Short rest.)
Talk to the Sentient Amulet
Speak with the consciousness lingering inside the Sentient Amulet.
Ki Restoration (Action)
Using the spiritual energy in the amulet, you restore 2 Ki Points. ( Recharge: Long rest.)
Wearing this amulet applies the condition:
• High Spirits
• The amulet's spirit lingers, making everything seem a little more vibrant. Must succeed a Wisdom Saving Throw (DC 10/15/20, see notes) when using the amulet's power, or become Hysterical (equivalent in effect to Tasha's Hideous Laughter with a duration of 1 turn).
notes:
• Picking up the amulet triggers a conversation in which the amulet tries to get party member to surrender to a fit of laughter. This is a hint at the curse the amulet bears. Once the conversation is over, the quest Help the Cursed Monk is received.
• The amulet is voiced by [https://www.imdb.com/name/nm1372889 John O'Mahony].
• Wisdom Saving Throws are only required when using this amulet to cast Shatter. Using the Ki Restoration (lesser) ability does not prompt a Wisdom save.
• The default Wisdom Saving Throw for Hysterical is a DC 10. However, after succeeding the Saving Throw at least three times and upon either equipping the amulet or leaving camp (whichever happens first), a special cutscene plays where passing a DC 10 Wisdom Saving Throw to resist the curse is necessary. If failed, the Hysterical DC is increased to 15. If the Wisdom Saving Throw for Hysterical is succeeded a further three times (and then equipping the amulet or leaving camp again), a similar cutscene plays whereby failing a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw increases the Hysterical DC to 20. After this, no additional cutscenes will occur.
• Depending on the outcome of the Help the Spirit of the Amulet quest in Act Three, the party may receive a version of this amulet that is visually identical but missing all of its special properties (UID: UNI_WYR_MonkAmulet_NoGhost / UUID: 14a6da9a-6689-4c70-96a1-d03319ba3278). Alternatively, the player may receive the Sentient Amulet (Very Rare).
• While the player character carries the Sentient Amulet, the Cursed Monk occasionally makes comments at various locations and after specific interactions.

where_to_find: Rewarded by Arabella for completing the quest Find Arabella's Parents
special:
Shadow Blade (Bonus Action)
Cast as a level 2 spell ( Recharge: Short rest.)
bugs:
• Unequipping this ring will break the character's current Concentration spell so long as the shadow blade is currently summoned.
• Due to a miscoded SummonInInventory functor:
• The ring's shadow blade can be:
• Transferred between characters and equipped by anyone in the party,
• Dropped on the ground without it de-spawning.
• Previously conjured blades do not disappear from the caster's inventory upon a new spell casting.
notes:
As of Patch 8:
• The spell does not require concentration anymore and the conjured blade lasts until long rest.
• As a result, the ring can produce multiple shadow blades - one per each short rest.
• The ring can be unequipped after summoning the shadow blade.
• The ring's shadow blade can be summoned and equipped in addition to one summoned using spell slots.
• The ring's shadow blade can also be transferred between characters and equipped by anyone in the party, or even dropped on the ground without it de-spawning, meaning that it can have spells and other effects cast upon it, such as Draconic Elemental Weapon granted by the Drakethroat Glaive.

quote: Encased in a cocoon of shadow within the lantern, the mangled pixie lies like some deformed pupa, its mouth slack, and those same shadows crawling over its graying tongue.
special:
Conjure Shadow Lantern Wraith (Action)
Cast as a level 6 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
bugs:
• Despite being tagged as a Rare item, the in-game tooltip for the lantern is coloured as a Story Item, like any other Moonlantern.
• Despite this spell's name, the creature summoned is a Shadow, not the more powerful Wraith. It is is unable to climb surfaces such as ladders and knotted roots, and is unable to Jump, Fly, or Warp, meaning it may be unable to follow the party to certain areas. Regrouping is possible by entering a new area or using Waypoints.
notes:
• Both ingredients can be found in Baltazar's hidden room.
• See Balthazar's Experiment for more information. While in-game dialogue also allows the slim possibility for the player character to craft this item, the option is only available if Gale is present.
• Merely equipping the lantern in the light source slot is not sufficient to gain the Conjure Shadow Lantern Wraith ability and the Moonshield condition; it must be actively wielded, such as by switching to it via the light source toggle button or equipping it directly in the weapon slot.
• Although not clear from the flavour text's description, the lantern emits a bright sphere of light when used in a weapon slot, providing full protection from the Shadow Curse.
• Unequipping the lantern or switching back to active weapons via the light source toggle button automatically dismisses the conjured Shadow.

bugs: • After application of Mark of the Shifter, the wearer can unequip this ring for others to use without losing the condition. However, while under the effects of any Starry Form, equipping other rings afterwards that apply passives to the wearer will remove the condition.
notes:
• This ring is one of few pieces of equipment that works while under the effect of wild shape. Note that it works with a Circle of Stars Druid's Starry Form, but not with a Circle of Spores Druid's Symbiotic Entity.
• Two ways among many to trade for this item are:
• Have the player character stand next to the entrance to the Tiefling Hideout and use a ranged attack, then immediately enter the hideout; upon climbing back up the ladder, the attacker will be able to speak with the Ox and trade to "...smooth things over".
• Have the attacking character flee via stealth and / or invisibility.
• The Mark of the Shifter condition is only applied during transformation and lasts until Long Rest; it will not be applied if this ring is put on after the wearer has already shapeshifted.
• Shapeshifter's Boon does not take effect if the party member is shape changed via a Seeming spell cast by a different party member. However, the targeted party member can then gain this effect by casting Adjust Seeming themselves and picking a different appearance.

• As of Patch 7, Radiant damage from this weapon no longer applies when thrown.

This can only be done during the initial conversation with Pooldripp after killing BOOOAL, after this you will not be able to barter with him again.

id: Silver Sword of the Astral Plane
page: Silver Sword of the Astral Plane
name: Silver Sword of the Astral Plane
description: The Silver Sword of the Astral Plane is a legendary +3 Greatsword which grants its wielder the Soulbreaker weapon action and provides special bonuses when wielded by a githyanki.
quote: The fervour with which the githyanki express devotion to their queen is admirable to some, disquieting to others. When confronted with the fallibility of the divine (since no one is wholly perfect), who knows what reactions such folk might evince.
notes:
• This sword may also be obtained in Act One, by disarming Voss via Command (Drop), Heat Metal, Fear, Disarming Attack (Ranged), Honeyed Paws, or Dirty Trick: Flick o' the Wrist before entering the Mountain Pass X: -139 Y: 561.
• Voss must be disarmed before beginning the encounter, as he immediately flies away when any hostile action is taken by the party or its allies, and he locks party members into dialogue when they approach close enough.
• Due to his high stats, the chance of failing the disarm attempt against him is very high, so this method may require multiple reloads or extensive preparation. See: Guide: Early Silver Sword.
• Using Honeyed Paws while having a divination wizard with a 15 or higher portent die nearby guarantees that he drops his weapon. It is possible to long rest until getting 15 or higher and then make the bear invisible. After placing a Potion of Invisibility on the ground, the bear companion can drink it and then approach Voss.
• Sometimes, Voss appears with a Githyanki Crossbow instead of the sword or, when dropped, it simply phases out of existence. The triggers for these anomalies are not known. If Voss appears with a crossbow instead of the sword, this Guide explains how to obtain it.
• If this sword is obtained in Act One, a second one of this will not be given as a quest reward.
• Otherwise, this sword can be acquired in Act Three before entering the Lower City during Deal with the Devil. If the party declines or skips signing the contract with Raphael but successfully lies to Voss, he gives the party the sword ( DC 30 Deception Check).

Sorrowful Lash (Bonus Action)
Cast as a cantrip ( Recharge: Per turn.)
notes:
• The altar is unlocked by solving the Enclave Library Puzzle in the Druid Grove.
• All characters besides the Dark Urge comment when picking this glaive up for the first time.
• The Druid Notebook beside Halsin's bed implies that Sorrow first belonged to Ketheric Thorm.
• Sorrowful Lash is a versatile cantrip at the cost of a Bonus Action, enabling many different tactics for the Sorrow holder:
• Elimination of enemies with very low Hit Points, without expending a full attack
• Pulling enemies off ledges, removing their advantageous position and dealing both cantrip and fall damage, or pulling them into chasms for instant eliminations

quote: When on the wrong side of a few sherries, the powerful wizards [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Bigby Bigby] and [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Tenser Tenser] would sometimes see how many spells they could fit into amulets like this one before they burst.

name: Spellcrux Amulet
controller_icon: Amulet Necklace D Gold A 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Amulet Necklace D Gold A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Spellcrux Amulet is a very rare Amulet that allows the wearer to restore any one spell slot once per Long Rest.
quote: Some scholars have speculated that spells have a mind of their own, suggesting that the spells get bored between being cast and restored.
where_to_find: Worn by the Warden
special:
• Spell Slot Restoration
• Replenish an expended spell slot of any level as a Bonus Action once per Long Rest.
notes:
• The amulet cannot create new spell slots, only restore used ones. If you do not have a used spell slot of the level you chose, the amulet has no effect.
• The amulet can recover spell slots that the caster does not innately have from their class, such as ones gained from Create Spell Slot, or ones from gear, such as Shield of Devotion.
• It is capable of recovering both Warlock spell slots and regular spell slots. If you have empty spell slots of both types for the chosen level, it restores one slot for each type.
• Likewise, if the amulet is equipped by Gale and he has the Consumed Shadow Weave feature, selecting third level will restore both a normal third-level spell slot and the third-level "shadow spell slot" granted by this feature.
• The spell slot is not lost when the amulet is removed, meaning you can put the amulet on, restore a slot, and switch back to another amulet of your choice. The recharge is still tied to the amulet, so this cannot be done with multiple characters at once.

description: Stiffly-Shod Boots are a common pair of Boots.
quote: These boots are well-maintained and clean, though their soles are thin from wear.

name: Stillmaker
description: Stillmaker is a very rare +2 Dagger that grants the wielder the Hold Person spell once per Long Rest.
quote: The dagger's twisting blade is designed to nick the flesh as many times as possible, allowing its paralytic poison to flow effortlessly into any unfortunate target.
special:
Hold Person (Action)
Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
notes:
• A successful DC 5 Perception Check is needed to spot the dagger. The hole is just at the top of the cragged rock and can be missed easily. There is blood right next to the hole.
• The dagger is the murder weapon of the Open Hand Temple murders and serves as proof when reporting your findings to Valeria.

notes_links.page: Solve the Open Hand Temple Murders

name: Stolyarof's Table Lute
description:
Stolyarof's Table Lute is a unique instrument. It can be played with the Perform action.
This variant is functionally no different from the other regular Lute variants.
quote: This heavy, deep-voiced instrument is of the type called a 'table lute' due to its weight. Famously, the late Ahndri Stolyarof refused to let anyone else play it.
where_to_find: Can be purchased from Thomas C. Quirkilious
notes: • The "Ahndri Stolyarof" referred to in the description is likely a reference to real-world composer and music theory professor [https://www.youtube.com/@darushkii Andrey Stolyarov].

name: Strange Conduit Ring
icon: Ring F Silver A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Strange Conduit Ring is a uncommon Ring that grants additional Psychic damage to the wearer's weapon while Concentrating.
quote: In his speculative writing on arcane displacement, the wizard [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Tenser Tenser] notes the possibility for keenly focused minds to maintain spells, and even unlock hidden potential while doing so.
where_to_find: Inside an elegant chest in the Inquisitor's Chamber

name: Streamhopper Loafers
description: Streamhopper Loafers are common shoes.
quote: Traversing fast-paced bodies of water is a chore for all - apart from the fashionable folk clad in this footwear.

name: Studded Leather Armour

quote: A surgeon is only as reliable as her tools. And, indeed, as depraved.
where_to_find: Worn by Malus Thorm

name: Sussur Dagger
description: The Sussur Dagger is a Rare +1 Dagger which can Silence the targets it strikes, making it very useful against spellcasters.
quote: Smoke-like whorls of sussur sap darken the metal of this dagger's blade and silence its victims.
special: • Silences the target on hit if it fails a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw.
bugs: • The Sussur Dagger is missing a critical SourceFile from its physics template, which can cause the weapon to fall through world floors when thrown or dropped. Additionally, the weapon can only be picked up from the ground while holding the 'Alt' key.
notes:
• To obtain this item, a Dagger must be combined with the Sussur Tree Bark in the Blacksmith's Forge.
• Certain non-standard daggers, (the Polished Dagger being a known example) cannot be used to craft this weapon.
• The Silencing effect only works on melee hits; not when throwing the dagger.
• Prior to Hotfix #33, the item description incorrectly omitted the mention of a saving throw.
• Sussar weapons cannot be dyed.

name: Sussur Greatsword
description: Sussur Greatsword is a rare +1 Greatsword, which can Silence targets on hit.
quote: Sussur roots extend from this sword's hilt into the blade itself. It yearns to drink magic, silencing every creature it strikes.
special: • Silences the target on hit if it fails a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw.
notes:
• To obtain this item, a Greatsword must be combined with the Sussur Tree Bark in the Blacksmith's Forge.
• The Silencing effect only works on melee hits, not when throwing the weapon, even if the weapon gains the Thrown property through an effect like Elemental Cleaver.
• Prior to Hotfix #33, the item description incorrectly omitted the mention of a saving throw.

name: Sussur Sickle
description: The Sussur Sickle is a Rare + 1 Sickle which can silence the targets it strikes, making it very useful against spellcasters.
quote: The sheen of sussur sap forged into this sickle glows blue, silencing every creature it cuts.
special: • Silences the target on hit if it fails a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw.
notes:
• To obtain this item, a Sickle must be combined with the Sussur Tree Bark in the Blacksmith's Forge.
• Certain non-standard sickles, (the Redcap Sickle being a known example) cannot be used to craft this weapon.
• The Silencing effect only works on melee hits; not when throwing the item at a target.
• Only two enchanted Sickles exist in game, with the other being Wavemother's Sickle.
• Prior to Hotfix #33, the item description incorrectly omitted the mention of a saving throw.
• Sussur weapons cannot be dyed.

name: Svartlebee's Woundseeker
description: Svartlebee's Woundseeker is an uncommon +1 greatsword that grants its wielder bonus to Attack Rolls against already damaged creatures.
quote: Wielded by Svartlebee The Custodian, so named because he had the following reputation: Have you got someone in your life causing a mess? Send Svartlebee a missive. He shall clean them up, and then clean up the crime scene.
notes:
• Upon first approaching Waukeen's Rest, Yeva's sword must be acquired before any zone or fast travel (e.g., by waypoint or going to camp). If the party visit the area again after travelling to a different zone, Yeva will be gone.
• In the Tadpoling Centre in Act Two. One method to keep her non-hostile is to use a disarming action on her during the fight where she appears. As long as she is not killed, she remains an ally.

name: Sweetly Tailored Outfit
description: Sweetly Tailored Outfit is a set of common Camp Clothing.
quote: Fashioned at the hands of someone deeply skilled... or, at the very least, someone who was having a good day at the loom and tailor shop.
notes: • This item is visually the same as Winter Gala Doublet.

name: Swires' Sledboard
description: Swires' Sledboard is a very rare shield that grants the wearer Force Conduit at the start of combat. It also grants Shield Bash.
quote: A gnomish adventurer once used this to outpace his enemies down a slope.
where_to_find: Sold by Exxvikyap in Rivington during Act Three
notes:
• The runes inscribed on the interior of the shield translate to "Clan Duergar" in the [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Dethek Dethek] script. The 3D model was originally created by artist Jane Katsubo as part of the Duergar asset set (see concept art below).
• One of several references to the gnome adventurer Lupperdiddle Swires. Others appear in the descriptions of the Potion of Glorious Vaulting, Arsonist's Oil and Swiresy Shoes. "Swires" is a reference to the Discworld books.

name: Swiresy Shoes
description: The Swiresy Shoes are a pair of rare Boots that improve Jumping distance and Acrobatics skill.
quote: Likely fashioned in tribute to the extremely small, high-vaulting rascal who pillaged many a hen house - Lupperdiddle Swires.
where_to_find: Sold by Grat the Trader
special: • Acrobatics +1
notes: • One of several references to the gnome adventurer Lupperdiddle Swires. Others appear in the descriptions of the Potion of Glorious Vaulting, Arsonist's Oil and Swires' Sledboard. "Swires" is a reference to the Discworld books.

name: Sword of Chaos
description: Sword of Chaos is a very rare +2 greatsword which deals additional Necrotic damage and also restores a portion of the wielder's health on each successful hit.
quote: The sword of Sarevok, brother of [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Gorion%27s_Ward Gorion's Ward] and child of the evil god Bhaal. Though much of its power died with him, the sword is still formidable, and glows with a malevolent light.
notes: • The Sword of Chaos is also found in Baldur's Gate 2. The description of the item in Baldur's Gate 3 refers to the events of the storyline of the previous game.

notes_links.page: List of references to previous Baldur's Gate games

name: Sword of Clutching Umbra
description: Sword of Clutching Umbra is a rare, lightly enchanted (+1) Shortsword that grants the wielder the unique weapon action Shadowsoaked Blow.
quote: Fingers of Shadow seem to beckon from the dark edge of the blade.

name: Sword of Justice
description: Sword of Justice is an uncommon +1 greatsword that grants its wielder the Tyr's Protection spell.
quote: The words 'Deliverance. Justice. Vengeance.' are engraved on the base of this sword. They echo in your mind.
special:
Tyr's Protection (Bonus Action)
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Short rest.)

name: Sword of Life Stealing
description: The Sword of Life Stealing is a very rare +2 shortsword which deals an extra 10 Necrotic damage on a critical hit, and heals the wielder for the same amount.
quote: Folded into the steel of this menacing weapon is an alloy of enchanted metal. It waits like a leech in thick swamp water, awaiting a victim to taste, awaiting a chance to restore your heartiness and inflict suffering on your foes.

name: Sword of Screams
description: Sword of Screams is an uncommon Rapier that deals an additional 1d4 Psychic damage.
quote: A blade of flawless craft. As it parts the air, you fancy you can hear a faint, whispering shriek...

name: Sword of the Emperor
description: Sword of the Emperor is a rare +2 Longsword that grants bonus damage against shapeshifted or polymorphed creatures and enhances the wielder's defences against spells.
quote: There's a graceful swarthiness to this sword. The inscription in the steel reads - 'My eye wanders far from home / To shores of distant Anchorome.'

name: Swordmaster Gloves
description: The Swordmaster Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves which grant proficiency with three types of swords and provide a bonus to melee Attack Rolls.
quote: The famous drow with his heart of gold, Drizzt Do'Urden, is not the pioneer of the 'twin sword style' of fighting, though he was among the best practitioners.
where_to_find: Sold by Dammon in Act Two

name: Sylvan Scimitar
description: Sylvan Scimitar is an uncommon +1 Scimitar that allows its wielder to use their Spellcasting Ability modifier instead of their Dexterity modifier to determine their Attack Roll bonus.
quote: Everything moves strangely in the [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Feywild Feywild], from rivers to behaviours. It's a mercurial place, where the magical and physical can pass permeably through one another.

name: Syringe

name: Tarnished Ring
icon: Ring A Simple Gold Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Tarnished Ring is an uncommon Ring created by combining the Gemless Ring with the Ringless Gem. It can be sold to Traders for a bit of gold.
quote: A cheap ring marred by rust and a thin patina of neglect.
where_to_find:
Created by combining:
• Gemless Ring - looted from the Refugee Corpse on the cliffs of northeastern Rivington at X: 46 Y: 66
• Ringless Gem - sold by Ferg Drogher in the Rivington refugee camp at X: 45 Y: -98
bugs: • The game code shows that this ring should be named "Magic Ring" with the description "Considered sacred by some gnomes and halflings, the gem set in this ring sparkles brilliantly." due to its Item Template. However, when the game spawns items created via Item Combination it uses the Stats of the item, which pulls data from the Parent Template field instead of the Item Template, which in this case is LOOT_GEN_Ring_A_Simple_Gold and thus why this ring appears with the name and description that it has.
notes: • If the party offer Noblestalk to Derryth Bonecloak, she initially claims to have no reward to offer. She can be given it regardless. A DC 10 Intimidation check results in her handing over her wedding ring which is the Tarnished Ring.

name: The Baneful
icon: Githyanki Shortsword Plus One Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Baneful is a rare +1 shortsword that applies the Bane condition on hit.
quote: The wizard [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Otiluke Otiluke] wrote about bound weapons and their propensity to coalesce with their wielder as the pair come together. He also wrote about their dangers, which are manifold, and their benefits, which make the danger worth it.
