name: The Blood of Lathander
icon: The Blood of Lathander Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Blood of Lathander is a legendary + 3 Mace found through the Find the Blood of Lathander quest. It continuously sheds light, blinds nearby Fiends and Undead with its light, can prevent death as well as heal its wielder, and allows the wielder to cast Sunbeam.
special:
Sunbeam (Action)
Cast as a level 6 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
notes:
• The version of Sunbeam granted by this item does not allow recasting on subsequent turns.
• Despite being considered a mace, its appearance is more akin to a morningstar.
• Within the game files, this item has multiple variations with different names, but same functionality:
• UUID: 96a35552-0c05-4df0-9974-2a8f142e4be6 (Blood of Lathander). This version of the item has a quote unlike the ingame version, which may have been intended for the usable version: The large chunk of amber set into the handle of this luminous mace supposedly holds four drops of godly blood, fallen to the earth in a battle between an avatar of Lathander and a maddened Chosen of Mystra.
• UUID: 7b961f08-46c1-46b1-99bc-c59283831a0b (Dawngrip Mace). This is the current usable variant.

name: The Clover
special:
• Armour Class +1 (Off-Hand Only)
True Strike (Action)
Cast as a cantrip ( Recharge: Short rest.)
notes: This weapon appears to be an earlier version of Bloodthirst.

name: The Dancing Breeze
description: The Dancing Breeze is a very rare +2 Glaive that grants its wielder the Whirlwind Attack weapon action, which strikes all nearby targets.
quote: Tiny specks of blood are fused into the blade, as if the glaive is feeding on them.
bugs: • While usable with the Sneak Attack (Melee) and Rakish Sneak Attack (Melee), this weapon lacks proper animations for these attacks.
notes: • This weapon is the only finesse glaive in the game.

name: The Dead Shot
description: The Dead Shot is a +2 Longbow which increases the accuracy of the wielder as well as increases the chance of a critical hit.
quote: When the archer Frederik Durlusk died, his only request was to be buried with his favorite bow. This is that bow.

name: The Deathstalker Mantle
description: The Deathstalker Mantle is a rare Cloak that turns the wearer Invisible for 2 turns after killing an enemy.
quote:
Let hill and hollow be a door
To screams that last forevermore
where_to_find: given to The Dark Urge Origin by Sceleritas Fel

name: The Devil-Crushers
controller_icon: Item ARM Boots Leather B Icon.png
icon: Item ARM Boots Leather B Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Devil-Crushers is a common pair of Camp Shoes.
quote: Stained with imp guts and warmed from within by hot, sweaty toes.
where_to_find: Available to Karlach in the epilogue if she does not become a mind flayer and goes to Avernus
notes: • This item is also available to the player character if they join Karlach in Avernus.

name: The Ever-Seeing Eye
description: The Ever-Seeing Eye is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to cast Protection from Evil and Good once per Short Rest.
quote: A pale green eye, pierced by the twisting branches of a dead tree - the result of a foolhardy woman begging Auntie for a favour.
where_to_find: In the treasure room in the Hag's Lair underneath the Gnarled Teahouse
special:
Protection from Evil and Good (Action)
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Short rest.)
bugs: • This item can be unequipped after casting Protection from Evil and Good from it; the caster will still receive the use of Protection from Evil and Good until long rest or concentration is broken.

name: The Fork-Lightning Fingers
description: The Fork-Lightning Fingers are a rare pair of gloves that give the wearer lightning damage to their unarmed attacks and the ability to cast Lightning Bolt as a level 3 spell once per Long Rest.
quote: There's a technique specific to the monks who train along the Spine of the World. It doesn't have a name, but it does involve fists, lightning, and some extremely decimated pines.
special:
Lightning Bolt (Action + Level 3 Spell Slot)
Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)

name: The Graceful Cloth
description: The Graceful Cloth is a rare piece of Clothing which gives its wearer +2 Dexterity and the Cat's Grace condition. It also boosts their Dexterity Saving Throws and jump distance.
quote: A garment worn by one of three monks who fought together against [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Headless_Serpent,_Secret_Venom Headless Serpent, Secret Venom], a gang in the port city of [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Port_Nyanzaru Nyanzaru]. This was worn by [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Roahton_Mobar Roahton Mobar], whose stances were broad and strong.
where_to_find: Sold by Lady Esther, north-east of the Trielta Crags waypoint
notes:
• This was also sold by Araj Oblodra at Moonrise Towers until Patch 4 with the following special properties:
• Martial Arts Lethality: Gain a +1 bonus to Unarmed Attack Rolls and the damage of throwing attacks
• Armour Class +1

name: The Impaler
description: The Impaler is a very rare, inaccessible, moderately enchanted (+2) Pike that deals additional damage to targets at full hp and grants temporary hp on kills.
quote: This impaling pole of enchanted steel was commissioned as part of a set by Strahd von Zarovich, who presented the weapons to his honour guard one cold morning.

name: The Joltshooter
description: The Joltshooter is a rare Longbow that allows the wielder to generate Lightning Charges upon dealing damage with this weapon.
quote: Sleek and lightweight, it is said that the Joltshooter was Yrre the Sparkstruck's favourite weapon. They were indifferent towards bows, but the spikes jutting out of it?
notes: • The Joltshooter is one of three possible quest rewards. The other two are The Sparky Points and The Spellsparkler.

name: The Jolty Vest
description: The Jolty Vest is a Rare Medium Armour that shocks enemies who land attacks on the wearer while they have Lightning Charges.
quote: Yrre the Sparkstruck got their nickname for both their obsession with lightning and the inventions they created, which had the habit of electrocuting both Yrre and any poor observers that got too close.
where_to_find: Sold by Brem after completing the quest Find the Missing Shipment

name: The Lifebringer
description: The Lifebringer is an uncommon circlet which grants the wearer temporary hit points whenever they gain Lightning Charges.
quote: 'Lightning is like magic,' Yrre the Sparkstruck once said. 'And what is magic but life itself?'
where_to_find: Sold by Blurg

id: The Long Arm of the Gur
page: The Long Arm of the Gur
name: The Long Arm of the Gur
description: The Long Arm of the Gur is a rare +2 Heavy Crossbow. It grants a bonus to Attack Rolls and Damage Rolls against Undead targets.
quote:
When the boy was seven, he was frightened badly by a vampire spawn during a public burning. Seized by the flames, the creature didn't shrivel up. It swelled and burst like a squeezed leech. Brains splattered the boy's shoes, grey-pink and pulpy.
He would never forget it.
notes: • The description of this crossbow is almost identical to that of Gandrel's Aspiration.

name: The Mighty Cloth
description: The Mighty Cloth is a rare piece of Clothing that gives its wearer +2 Strength (up to 20) and the Bull's Strength condition. Also grants the wearer the Bull Rush class action.
quote: A garment worn by one of three monks who fought together against [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Headless_Serpent,_Secret_Venom Headless Serpent, Secret Venom], a gang in the port city of [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Port_Nyanzaru Nyanzaru]. This was worn by [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Kimigha_Poji Kimigha Poji], whose stances were narrow and swift.
where_to_find: Sold by Quartermaster Talli near the Last Light Inn waypoint
special:
Bull Rush (Action + Movement Speed)
Charge forward and possibly knock your foes back 3 m (10 ft). ( Recharge: Per turn.)

name: The Oak Father's Embrace
description: The Oak Father's Embrace is an uncommon Medium Armour that deals Radiant damage to creatures violating the natural order, including the wearer.
quote: Embroidered with a simple maxim - 'Nature is the True State of the World' - these hides radiate a faint divine power.
where_to_find: On a headless skeleton near the owlbear nest and egg

name: The Pointy Hat
description: The Pointy Hat is a rare hat that gives the wearer a bonus to their persuasion checks equal to their Intelligence modifier.
quote: Sages over the course of ages have dealt very constructive and useful advice - however, none so sagacious as that of the wizard [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Otiluke Otiluke], who once advised one of his students thusly: 'Never cast Speak with Dead on a loved one if there's unresolved tension there. It's never worth it. Trust me.'
where_to_find: in a chest behind Lucretious
notes:
• There is no dye in the game to make the hat actually look like its tooltip icon.
• The name and appearance of the hat is a reference to D&D content creator [https://www.youtube.com/@pointyhatstudios Pointy Hat].

name: The Protecty Sparkswall
description: The Protecty Sparkswall is a rare article of Clothing. It increases the wearer's defences while they have Lightning Charges and grants a +1 bonus to their Spell Save DC.
quote: Yrre the Sparkstruck was raised in the Underdark, so they weren't surprised that power begets envy, and envy begets violence. They were prepared.
where_to_find: in a gilded chest at the end of the trapped bridge
notes: • Despite having more features, this robe sells for less than one third the value of the Robe of Exquisite Focus.

name: The Real Sparky Sparkswall
icon: The Real Sparky Sparkswall Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Real Sparky Sparkswall is an uncommon Shield that allows the wearer to create a Lightning Aura.
quote: 'Is there anything as beautiful as lightning striking all around you?' Yrre the Sparkstruck said, letting lightning strike all around them.
where_to_find: In a locked and trapped chest
special:
Lightning Aura (Action)
Consume 3 Lightning Charges and release a blast of electricity that damages and Jolts nearby enemies. ( Recharge: Long rest.)

name: The Reviving Hands
description: The Reviving Hands are a very rare pair of Gloves that grants the wearer the to ability to cast Revivify. They also apply Blade Ward and Death Ward to creatures healed or revived by the wearer respectively.
quote: Stitched into the lining is the phrase: 'Yes all right, all right, stop moaning and get up.'
where_to_find: Sold by Vicar Humbletoes
special:
• Strength Saving Throws +1
Revivify (Action)
Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)

name: The Sacred Star
description: The Sacred Star is a very rare +2 Morningstar that applies Radiating Orb on hit and possibly turns the target if it is Undead. It also grants the Dawnburst Strike weapon action.
quote: The power of this item lies in belief, though not in any god. This item believes that it's very good at hitting things, so it is. Belief is quite powerful when it comes to violence.
notes: • Damage from Tenacity still applies Radiant Strike and Sanctified Weapon's effects.

name: The Shadespell Circlet
description: The Shadespell Circlet is an uncommon Helmet that grants a bonus to Spell Save DC when the wearer is obscured in shadow.
quote: One of the relics of Deep Duerra's rebellious children. Flanked by her court, Duerra shook her head at her children. Had they really believed they could leave her?
where_to_find: Sold by Omeluum after completing the quest Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite
notes: • A dark cloud appears above the wearer's head while the effect is active.

name: The Skinburster
description: The Skinburster is an uncommon +1 Halberd that grants its wielder Force Conduit on each successful hit.
quote: In mellow light, the halberd's curved steel head eerily resembles a grin.

name: The Sparkle Hands
description: The Sparkle Hands are a pair of rare Gloves that grant Lightning Charges on unarmed attacks and provide Advantage against metal constructs and armoured foes while charged.
quote: 'Sometimes I just want to feel that spark,' Yrre the Sparkstruck said. 'Feel the lightning course through me.'
where_to_find: in a wooden chest at the base of the giant tree stump in the Sunlit Wetlands

name: The Sparkswall
description: The Sparkswall is an uncommon Ring that shields the wearer from Lightning.
quote: When the inventor Yrre met the cleric Lenore, sparks flew. Apart, they were in a rut, but together, they inspired each other to push the boundaries of innovation and invention. This ring is just one of their many scientific triumphs.
where_to_find: In a gilded chest on the upper level of the Arcane Tower's basement
special: • Resistance to Lightning damage.
notes:
• The ring Guiding Light is required to access the basement.
• Gale can absorb this item's magic, destroying it.
• Bernard deals Lightning damage with every attack and his aura. The ring can be acquired before fighting him by choosing the right poem lines when speaking to him.

name: The Sparky Points
description: The Sparky Points is a rare Trident that allows the wielder to generate Lightning Charges upon dealing melee damage with this weapon.
quote: When Yrre the Sparkstruck was asked why they'd created a trident twice their size, they simply replied, 'The question is - why not create another weapon with spikes like lightning bolts?'
notes:
• The Sparky Points is one of three possible quest rewards. The other two are The Joltshooter and The Spellsparkler.
• Electric Blood does not generate Lightning Charges when the trident is used as a thrown weapon.

name: The Spectator Eyes
image: Amulet Necklace A Bronze A 1 Faded.png
controller_icon: Amulet Necklace A Bronze A 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Amulet Necklace A Bronze A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Spectator Eyes is a very rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast Ray of Fear and Wounding Ray once per Long Rest.
quote: Spectators are hideous aberrations that float above the ground, fiercely staring around and shooting beams at anything they don't appreciate.
where_to_find: Worn by the Spectator located in the Petrified Battlefield
special:
Ray of Fear (Action)
Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
Wounding Ray (Action)
Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)

name: The Speedy Lightfeet
description: The Speedy Lightfeet are a pair of rare Boots that allow the wearer to gain Lightning Charges when Dashing in combat.
quote: It is said the Speedy Lightfeet were the first of many lightning inventions made by Yrre the Sparkstruck. The boots' old, frayed edges zap and crackle with even the slightest movement.
where_to_find: In a heavy chest in the cellar behind the windmill
special: • Athletics +1
notes: • The Speedy Lightfeet may appear ideal for rogues, barbarians, and monks, but rogues and monks do not gain medium armour proficiency from their class, and barbarians and monks lose the benefits of their respective Unarmoured Defence trait if wearing medium armour.

name: The Spellsparkler
description: The Spellsparkler is a rare Quarterstaff that allows the wielder to generate Lightning Charges upon dealing damage with spells.
quote: Yrre the Sparkstruck intended to give the Spellsparkler to Lenore, a cleric of Mystra and old lover. But when the gnome returned to the cleric's tower, they found it empty - inhabited only by dust and abandoned experiments.
notes: • The Spellsparkler is one of three possible quest rewards. The other two are The Joltshooter and The Sparky Points.

name: The Undead Bane
description: The Undead Bane is an uncommon +1 Greataxe that deals additional Slashing damage against Fiends and Undead and grants its wielder the Profane Scourge weapon action.
quote: Wielded by the indomitable Ser Lexia. Although her eagerness to destroy evil in all its forms was constant, she often took time to make little gifts for her friends.

name: The Watcher's Guide
description: The Watcher's Guide is an uncommon Spear that increases the chance to hit a target after the wielder misses it.
quote: Time has dampened this spear's sheen, but the centre glows a faint blue. The magic it exudes feels old, terrible... and divine. The spear was given to its previous owner for his unerring loyalty - even after death.

name: The Watersparkers
description: The Watersparkers are a pair of rare Boots that allow the wearer to electrify water surfaces and gain Lightning Charges.
quote: An enormous storm was raging the first time Yrre the Sparkstruck left the Underdark. The deep gnome's interest in lightning became at once an all-consuming obsession, and they would spend the rest of their years striving to recreate that storm's power themselves.
where_to_find: In a gilded chest in Minthara's area of the Shattered Sanctum X: 339 Y: 41
notes: • Synergizes with The Sparkswall, which provides immunity to being electrocuted each round by the electrified water.

name: The Whispering Promise
description: The Whispering Promise is an uncommon Ring that grants a bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws to creatures healed by the wearer.
quote: A soft, soothing voice floats from this ring, reciting a prayer over and over.
where_to_find: Sold by Grat the Trader
notes:
• Volo does not trade via dialogue at the Sacred Pool. One must click the trade button in the lower left while speaking with him to do so. The ring can also be stolen.
• This ring can only be bought or stolen from Grat if it was not previously acquired from Volo. It is the same ring, confiscated from Volo when he is captured.
• If Volo is rescued and joins the party's camp, he sells the ring there if it was not previously acquired from him or Grat. Additionally, Grat no longer sells the ring after Volo leaves the Goblin Camp, even if Volo later dies or leaves the party's camp.

name: Thermoarcanic Gloves
description: Thermoarcanic Gloves are an uncommon pair of Gloves that grant the wearer 2 turns of Heat whenever they deal Fire damage.
quote: Ash dusts the gloves' fingers, darkening their seams.
where_to_find: Worn by Kansif, either at the cultist camp or after the Harper ambush

name: Thermodynamo Axe
description: Thermodynamo Axe is a rare, lightly enchanted (+1) Battleaxe that grants Heat whenever the wielder deals damage with this weapon.
quote: Designed by gnomish innovation, this weapon has a dynamic core that swivels and tinkles into life whenever the axe is swung at a foe.

name: Thick Soled Shoes
description: Thick Soled Shoes is a common pair of Camp Shoes.
quote: Standard issue boots that may or may be modified depending on the wearer's needs. Examples include hidden knives, poison darts, and so on.
where_to_find: Available only to Jaheira in the epilogue if she leaves the Harpers

name: Thin-Soled Shoes
description: Thin-Soled Shoes are a common pair of Shoes.
quote: Made of tough, well-worn leather, these boots have survived years of use, and can survive many more.

name: Thorn Blade
description: Thorn Blade is a rare, lightly enchanted (+1) Scimitar that deals 1d4 Poison damage with melee weapons attacks while Concentrating and grants the ability to cast Ensnaring Strike (Melee).
quote: This Blade is sharp and slender as a serpent's fang - and just as likely to inflict a hideous sting.
special:
Ensnaring Strike (Melee) (Action + Bonus Action)
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
bugs: • The description in Honour Mode is erroneous. Whereas the extra damage normally applies to all melee attacks (as per the description of the weapon), the extra damage in Honour Mode only applies to attacks with the weapon itself. This is because in the normal base game the extra damage is added via the passive, whereas in Honour Mode the damage is derived directly from the weapon itself. The fact that this is at odds with the description of the weapon is likely an oversight.
notes:
• Thorn Blade has a chance to reappear in Dammon's merchant stock whenever it resets, like non-unique equipment, and can be acquired multiple times.
• If a character has two copies of Thorn Blade equipped, their damage bonus while concentrating stacks, resulting in additional 2d4 damage instead of 1d4. This behaviour only applies outside of Honour mode.

name: Thunderpalm Strikers
image: Gloves of Cinder and Sizzle Icon.png
controller_icon: Gloves of Cinder and Sizzle Unfaded.png
icon: Gloves of Cinder and Sizzle Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Thunderpalm Strikers are a rare pair of Gloves that add Thunder damage to unarmed attacks and allow the wearer to cast Thunderwave once per long rest.
quote: Each blow landed while wearing these gloves produces the rumbling boom of a thousand demons' ravenous stomachs.
where_to_find: Sold by Bumpnagel
special:
Thunderwave (Action)
Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
notes:
• The cellar is accessible via a cave entrance at X: 30 Y: 29 or via a trapdoor in Rivington General.
• This is one of five pieces of monk-oriented handwear items with similar properties. Each grants 1d4 bonus damage of a different type on unarmed attacks and allows casting a different spell at 3rd level once per long rest. The others are the Gloves of Cinder and Sizzle, the Seraphic Pugilist Gloves, the Servitor of the Black Hand Gloves, and the Snow-Dusted Monastery Gloves.

notes_links.text: Servitor of the Black Hand Gloves
notes_links.page: Servitor of the Black Hand Gloves

name: Thunderskin Cloak
description: Thunderskin Cloak is an uncommon Cloak which has a chance to Daze creatures that are Reverberating when they damage the wearer.
quote: Through a gap in the long snarls of thread, you are sure you can glimpse a great black thunderhead swollen with purple lightning and spears of rain.
where_to_find: Sold by Araj Oblodra on the main floor

name: Tidy Slender Boots
description: Tidy Slender Boots are a common pair of Boots.
quote: These boots are well-maintained and clean, though their soles are thin from wear.
where_to_find: In a cupboard in Nine-Fingers Keene's Office

name: Tightening Orbit Helm
description: Tightening Orbit Helm is a rare Helmet.
quote: Keep your enemies close, and those you want to slit up closer.' - Popular nursery saying
special:
• Constitution Saving Throws +1
Tightening Orbit (Action)
Spend 1 turn of Force Conduit to pull every enemy in the radius toward you with damaging force. ( Recharge: Short rest.)

name: Till Death Do Us Part
description: Til Death Do Us Part is a rare Ring that grants its wearer the ability to cast Beacon of Hope.
quote: Love is the sweetest bird that might migrate to the charming country of your heart.
where_to_find: Given by Lady Jannath
special:
Beacon of Hope (Action)
Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
notes:
• Given as a quest reward in Free the Artist, if the party is honest about Oskar Fevras.
• The ring can also be looted or stolen from Lady Jannath whether or not Oskar was saved in Act One.

name: Titanstring Bow
description: Titanstring Bow is a rare +1 Longbow that allows its wielder to add their Strength Modifier to damage dealt with this weapon.
quote: The commonly held belief that archers are rangey, thin-wristed people is completely false. It takes years of training to pull a bowstring all the way back to your cheekbone, and wrists like iron.

name: Torch
description: A Torch can be used as a Light Source or as an improvised club. It can be wielded as a simple melee weapon in one hand. The torch is a light weapon that anyone can dual wield without special training. Torches can also be used to ignite flammable surfaces or clouds upon contact.
quote: A deep oily smell wafts from this crude tree branch.
notes: • When equipped, torches are automatically lit and they deal an additional 1d4 Fire damage and gain the Burning condition until extinguished.

name: Torch of Revocation
description: Torch of Revocation is a story rarity +1 utility item carried by Mystic Carrion and used in exorcisms.
quote: This staple of any worthwhile [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Exorcise exorcist] burns with a pale flame that destroys the anchors of troublesome ghosts in need of banishment.
notes:
• This item is needed for the quest Free the Artist.
• Using the torch on the Painting of a Smiling Maiden throughout the quest may grant one or more of the following inspirations: Flames of Passion ( Guild Artisan background), True Exorcism ( Acolyte background), and Using the Proper Means ( Sage background).
• The Torch of Revocation is one of only a few weapons in the game that deals two types of extra damage at once (only true when it is lit).
• The flame of this torch burns green, rather than orange like standard torches.

name: Torment Drinker Armour
description: Torment Drinker Armour is a rare Light Armour that grants temporary hit points when the wearer scores a Critical Hit or kills a creature.
quote: Timid, god-fearing Cat Burroughs was dizzyingly happy when an angel courted her one summer. But in the autumn, when he shamefacedly revealed he was not an angel but an incubus of the Hells, Cat flew into a rage, slew him, and fashioned this armour from his wings and still-warm bones.

name: Tough Shoes
description: Tough Shoes are a common pair of Shoes.
quote: Made of tough, well-worn leather, these boots have survived years of use, and can survive many more.

name: Tough Sunrises
quote: Sent by Lathander, the god of creativity and sunrises. Unfortunately, it was not received by the cleric who needed it at that crucial moment, but by a baffled librarian in [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Daggerford Daggerford], who used it as a door stopper.

name: Tough-Soled Shoes
description: Tough-Soled Shoes are a common pair of Shoes.
quote: Made of tough, well-worn leather, these boots have survived years of use, and can survive many more.

variants.name: Tourmaline Ring
variants.icon: Ring F Gold A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
variants.description: A Tourmaline Ring is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.
variants.quote: The warm tones of the gold band pair beautifully with this mint-green tourmaline.
variants.where_to_find: In chests and carried by characters throughout the game

variants.name: Tourmaline Ring
variants.icon: Ring F Silver A Unfaded Icon.png
variants.description: A Tourmaline Ring is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.
variants.quote: A slim-fitting silver band, decorated with a mint green gemstone.
variants.where_to_find: In chests and carried by characters throughout the game

variants.name: Tourmaline Ring
variants.icon: Ring F Silver A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
variants.description: A Tourmaline Ring is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.
variants.quote: A slim-fitting silver band, decorated with a mint green gemstone.
variants.where_to_find: In chests and carried by characters throughout the game

name: Tourmaline Ring
icon: Ring F Gold A Unfaded Icon.png
description: A Tourmaline Ring is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.
quote: The warm tones of the gold band pair beautifully with this mint-green tourmaline.
where_to_find: In chests and carried by characters throughout the game

name: Training Shield
description: The Training Shield is a common Shield that is reserved for practice instead of real fighting. Considering it isn't sold anywhere, requires stealing and is inferior to other shields it can be considered little more than junk.
quote: A light, wooden shield, full of dents and cuts.
where_to_find: In the Hollow near Wyll

name: Treacleflow Amulet
image: Amulet Necklace C Gold A 1 Faded.png
controller_icon: Amulet Necklace C Gold A 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Amulet Necklace C Gold A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Treacleflow Amulet is a rare Amulet.
quote: The air surrounding this lavishly decorated amulet is thick - like pushing your fingers through sap or syrup.

name: Trepan
quote: Though blood and age have rusted the mechanism, a good twist can still make the blades on this bloodletting device spin.
bugs: • When wielded by any nurse this weapon deals an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage. A coding error causes a misplaced '1d6' to appear in the weapon's list of properties.

name: Trepan
description: Trepan is an uncommon +1 Shortsword which grants the weapon action Trephination to non player characters only.
quote: Though blood and age have rusted the mechanism, a good twist can still make the blades on this bloodletting device spin.
bugs: None of the weapon actions provided by this weapon are available to the player character, if equipped.
notes:
• Collecting one of each of the nurses' tools grants the inspiration Right Tool for the Job to party members with the Criminal background.
• When wielded by any nurse, this weapon deals an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage.

name: Tressym Collar
image: Amulet Necklace A Bronze A 1 Faded.png
controller_icon: Amulet Necklace A Bronze A 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Amulet Necklace A Bronze A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Tressym Collar is a very rare Amulet which allows the wearer to cast Telekinesis once per Long Rest.
quote: The gem in this collar's centre is placed as a common courtesy: it allows the tressym's summoner to be identified and complained to in the case of bereaved pet owners or pigeon-masters. This one glows with a Waterdhavian name: Gale Dekarios.
where_to_find: Worn by Tara on the roof
special:
Telekinesis (Action)
Cast as a level 5 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Trident
quote: It is said tridents were brought to the surface when Umberlee threw a Triton prince who scorned her onto Faerûn's shores.

name: Trident +1
quote: The brutal design of this weapon's trio of prongs forces pierced flesh apart.

name: Trident +2
quote: An elegant, vicious weapon designed to eviscerate flesh and organs.

name: Trident of the Depths
notes:
• This item cannot be obtained without exploits, because Water Myrmidons are Permanently Armed.
• A previous exploit involving getting the myrmidon arrested has been patched out.
• The version carried by NPC myrmidons (as opposed to a Wild Shape: Water Myrmidon or Conjure Elemental: Water Myrmidon) is not enchanted and does not deal extra Cold damage.
• This item has a hidden NoDualWield property, which prevents it from being dual-wielded, even with the Dual Wielder feat.

name: Trident of the Waves
description: Trident of the Waves is a +1 Trident. It creates a Water surface around the target and also applies the Wet condition.
quote: Umberlee, the goddess of the sea, is deeply capricious, intelligent, and not nearly as wet around the edges as her domain might suggest. She often demands sacrificial tribute from sailors, such as their ships, their cargo, and, while she's at it, them.
bugs:
• This weapon's game code indicates it should deal an additional 1d4 Cold damage, but it is not present when acquired normally; the extra damage can still be acquired by recruiting a hireling, having them equip the trident, dismissing them to the Fugue Plane, and then recruiting them again. The version of the trident the hireling spawns back with has the additional 1d4 Cold damage.
• Another method to force the game to spawn the trident with the additional 1d4 Cold damage is to duplicate it using the exploit described on the Invoke Duplicity page.
notes: • The water surface is not applied when the weapon is Thrown.

name: Triumphal Helm
description: Triumphal Helm is a common Helmet that improves the wearer's Constitution Saving Throws.
quote: Worn ceremonially by commanders and general at the head of parades.
where_to_find: On a table/shelf in the Morgue
special: • Constitution Saving Throws +1

name: True Love's Caress
description: True Love's Caress is one of a matching pair of Rings that grants the wearer Warding Bond.
quote: The most pragmatic and courageous lover ever known was, of course, Sorcha MacTire, for whom the popular hairstyle is named, and for whom many an extremely soppy poem has been written (most of them comparing her to geography).
where_to_find: On a skeleton leaning up against a tombstone, on the road between the House of Healing and Mason's Guild
notes:
• The matching ring, True Love's Embrace, is on a skeleton lying on a mattress in the House of Healing at X: -212 Y: 0.
• After casting Warding Bond, the condition persists even if both party members unequip their rings. It lasts until death or a Long Rest.
• See also:
• Bonded By Love - Husband's Diary
• Bonded By Love - Wife's Diary

name: True Love's Embrace
description: True Love's Embrace is one of a matching pair of Rings that lets the wearer cast Warding Bond.
quote: The scholar of love, Joel Firris Baldidims, writes that the next time he reads about a woman compared to a flower (or any feature of geography for that matter) he's going to start knocking on poets' doors with a sledgehammer.
where_to_find: On a skeleton laying on a mattress on the ground
notes:
• The matching ring, True Love's Caress, is on a skeleton leaning up against a large tree in the Shadow-Cursed Lands at X: -147 Y: 43.
• This ring is found on the same corpse as Bonded By Love - Husband's Diary, which describes a newlywed man who is taken to the House of Healing after suffering from a myriad of mysterious injuries. The husband describes how, prior to receiving these injuries, his wife went to battle against an entire troop of Harpers and defeated them without getting a single scratch.
• See also:
• Bonded By Love - Husband's Diary
• Bonded By Love - Wife's Diary
• After casting Warding Bond, the condition persists even if both party members unequip their rings. It lasts until death or a Long Rest.

name: Twist of Fortune
description: Twist of Fortune is a rare +1 Morningstar with the unique weapon action, Blood Money. When the wielder rolls 2 or less with this weapon's damage die, they reroll and take the new result.
quote: They say rich folk are never truly happy; especially true when they're targeted with this morningstar.
bugs:
• When dual-wielding a flail or morningstar with a non-Tenacity weapon using the Dual Wielder feat, Tenacity can be triggered by missing an attack with the non-Tenacity weapon, dealing Bludgeoning damage regardless of the weapon used.
• Some non-Tenacity weapons can trigger their on-hit effects via Tenacity as well, such as the Ritual Dagger and Loviatar's Scourge.

name: Twisted Oak Crook
quote: A staff engraved with a leafy motif, maples and oakleaf winding through a forest going through every stage of life, spring to bare-branched winter.
notes:
• This staff does not deal 1d8 Bludgeoning when used as a two-hand weapon, but 3d6 Bludgeoning.
• This item can be obtained by pointing at any weapon consumable by Gale lying on the ground while controlling the Dryad and executing the 'Consume' action. The staff can then be pickpocketed from the Dryad's inventory.
• Similar to Nature's Snare that has a chance to apply Ensnared, this weapon has a chance to apply Ensnared.
• Dryad's also have a passive Grasp of the Forest, which additionally has a chance to apply Entangled on a hit with this weapon.

notes_links.page: List of Items consumable by Gale

name: Twisting Branch
icon: Wood Woad Twisting Branch Unfaded Icon.png
quote: A thick, gnarled branch, grown into a club-like shape.
notes:
• While a Twisting Branch carried by a wood woad summoned via Fallen Lover is enchanted with Magic Club, this does not apply for this item dropped as normal loot.
• It is possible to acquire a version of the weapon which benefits from the Magic Club passive.
• On PC and Mac, this is done by using a mouse to quickly drag the weapon from the inventory of a summoned Wood Woad to a party member's main hand.
• On consoles, this is done by dropping any other Club on the ground, having the Wood Woad equip it, and pickpocketing the Twisting Branch off of them.

name: Tyrannical Jackboots
description: Tyrannical Jackboots are an uncommon pair of Boots that grant a +1 bonus to Charisma checks and Saving Throws.
quote: Each step taken in Gortash's shoes is a reflection of the man himself: quick, sharp, and terrible.
where_to_find: Worn by Enver Gortash
notes: • Enver Gortash is in the audience hall during his installation and moves to his personal quarters on top of the fortress after the party's next long rest.

name: Umber Trousers
description: Umber Trousers is an article of common Camp Clothing.
quote: An ensemble very fitting for a relaxing sit by the campfire, wheupon stories are exchanged, generally over hipflasks.
where_to_find: At several locations as as set-dressing and random loot later in the game
notes:
• Like Lae'zel's clothes the Umber Trousers only cover the lower half.
• Some underwear may appear on the upper body when wearing these clothes.

name: Uncovered Mysteries
image: Amulet Necklace B Silver A 1 Faded.png
controller_icon: Amulet Necklace B Silver A 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Amulet Necklace B Silver A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Uncovered Mysteries is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast Detect Thoughts once per Long Rest.
quote: Beneath the layers of dust covering this necklace, its inlaid gems still give off a blue sparkle - the colour of Mystra's clergy.
where_to_find: In a small gilded chest on the basement floor's mezzanine, right next to the elevator exit
special:
Detect Thoughts (Action)
Cast as a level 2 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
notes: • Unlike equivalent potions and scrolls which have to be activated ahead of time, simply equipping the item passively is sufficient to cause the dialog option to appear.

name: Undead Slayer Crossbow
description: The Undead Slayer Crossbow is a rare +2 Heavy Crossbow that grants a bonus to Attack Rolls and Damage Rolls against Undead targets.
quote:
When the boy was seven, he was frightened badly by a vampire spawn during a public burning. Seized by the flames, the creature didn't shrivel up. It swelled and burst like a squeezed leech. Brains splattered the boy's shoes, grey-pink and pulpy.
He would never forget it.

name: Underwear
description: Underwear is a common pair of Underwear.
where_to_find: Player character's starting underwear
notes:
• The appearance of the underwear differs depending on the character's race.
• Underwear cannot be looted regularly. A party member must pick up a character's corpse to loot its underwear.

description: Underwear is a set of Underwear that appears to have no model.

notes: • Unlike other underwear, this version of Incubus underwear cannot be dyed.

name: Underwear/Tiefling
description: Underwear is the starting Underwear of the Tiefling race.

name: Unflinching Protector Amulet
description: Unflinching Protector Amulet is a very rare Amulet that can only be obtained from Ptaris.
quote: Touching this amulet's centrepiece, you are imbued with a vision of woven strands, and the strands coming apart and holding true and firm over your friends, like shields banded in a haze of golden light.
where_to_find: Worn by Ptaris
notes: • This item is only accessible if the quest Steal a Githyanki Egg was completed by giving the egg to Lady Esther.

name: Unlucky Thief's Gloves
description: Unlucky Thief's Gloves are an uncommon pair of Gloves that grants the wearer +2 to Sleight of Hand checks.
quote: Whenever the wearer steals anything, a piece of coal appears in their pocket, like a tiny, dusty condemnation.
where_to_find: Given as a consolation prize by Akabi after failing to win the jackpot at the Wheel of Fortune
special:
• Sleight of Hand +2
• Adds a piece of Charcoal to the wearer's inventory with each item they steal.
• After stealing 20 times, the next theft adds a Coal Bucket instead, which inflicts the Burning condition upon the wearer for Duration: 1 turn.
notes:
• While the description of this item appears to intend for the charcoal to be a punishment, the player character can sell them for a small profit.
• The Burning condition that is sometimes triggered while stealing with these gloves can be avoided by being Wet. The Reverse Rain Cloak, which also comes from Akabi's Wheel of Fortune, applies this condition while worn, making it a useful companion item to these gloves.

name: Unseen Menace
description: Unseen Menace is a rare + 1 Pike which increases critical hit chance and grants Advantage as long as the wielder keeps connecting hits.
quote: Yes, but what exactly is hitting you?

name: Unwanted Masterwork Gauntlets
description: Unwanted Masterwork Gauntlets are a rare pair of Gloves that provide a bonus to Attack Rolls and Strength Saving Throws. They are part of the Unwanted set.
quote: These gauntlets spark with unfinished, yet still potent, devilish magic - indicative of a cancelled blacksmith's commission.
where_to_find: in a gilded chest in the basement
special:
• Strength Saving Throws +1
• Attack rolls +1

name: Unwanted Masterwork Greaves
description: Unwanted Masterwork Greaves are a rare pair of Boots that provide a bonus to Athletics. It is part of the Unwanted set.
quote: These boots are stamped with the marks of a cancelled commission. Despite their discarded fate, they still hum with complex infernal arcana.
where_to_find: In a gilded chest in the basement
special: • Athletics +1
notes: • These boots share the stats of Metallic Boots, offering no additional benefit.

name: Unwanted Masterwork Scalemail
description: The Unwanted Masterwork Scalemail is a rare Medium Armour which does not limit the wearer's AC's Dexterity bonus. It is part of the Unwanted set.
quote: Nothing stings the master blacksmith more than a cancelled commission - not even molten iron. This mail is engraved with the mark of a devillish forgemaster, as well as several curses stamped out in infernal, and hums with diabolic magic.
where_to_find: Sold by Dammon
special: • Resistance to Fire damage
notes: • This armour's model was specifically designed for Karlach, likely as her starter armour (see concept art below).

name: Vampiric Dagger
quote: This dagger's handle is smooth and light, its jagged blade sharpened into a thin, cruel edge.

name: Vampiric Gloves
description: Vampiric Gloves are a pair of Very Rare Gloves that grant the wearer the ability to cast a Vampiric Touch.
quote: Little leech motifs adorn the pad of each finger. The leeches have rows of suckling, sharp teeth.
special:
Vampiric Touch (Action + Level 3 Spell Slot)
Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
notes: • This item's presence in LOW_CazadorsPalace_Crypt_Treasure suggests it was intended for Cazador's Palace, potentially the unfinished subterranean puzzle area

name: Varsh Ko'kuu's Boots
description: Varsh Ko'kuu's Boots are an uncommon pair of Boots that grant immunity to Acid surfaces and Resistance to Acid damage.
quote: Though the leather is slick with acid, the corrosive liquid doesn't seem to damage the boots - nor does it penetrate.
where_to_find: Acquired from Varsh Ko'kuu in the Hatchery

name: Veil of the Morning
icon: Veil of the Morning Unfaded Icon.png
description: Veil of the Morning is a very rare piece of Clothing that imposes Disadvantage on Undead Attack Rolls against the wearer, grants them Advantage against Undead spells and actions, and allows them to Turn Undead.
quote: Crafted from celestial feathers, bottled sunlight, and ink from the pages of sacred scripture, it's a wonder the maker didn't hang cloves of garlic from this robe, so anathema is it to the undead.
where_to_find: Sold by Mystic Carrion
passives: Let The Undead Blanch With Fear
special:
Turn Undead (Action)
Pray to Turn all undead that can see you. ( Recharge: Long rest.)

variants.name: Verdelite Ring
variants.icon: Ring B Gold A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
variants.description: Verdelite Ring is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.
variants.quote: Encased in delicately twisted gold, this seafoam green stone is of the tourmaline variety.
variants.where_to_find: In chests and carried by characters throughout the game

name: Verdelite Ring
icon: Ring B Gold A Unfaded Icon.png
description: Verdelite Ring is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.
quote: Encased in delicately twisted gold, this seafoam green stone is of the tourmaline variety.
where_to_find: In chests and carried by characters throughout the game

name: Verminsign
quote: Where most people see a bundle of interesting diseases in the common rat, members of the Zhentarim syndicate see a potential colleague.
notes: • Mechanically identical to a Rapier +1

name: Very Handsome Shirt
description: Very Handsome Shirt is a common Camp Clothing.
quote: Whichever rodent chose this outfit must have thought its wearer looked very handsome in it.
where_to_find: Available only to Minsc in the epilogue if the Zhentarim do not take over the Guild

name: Very Heavy Greataxe
description: Very Heavy Greataxe is an uncommon +1 Greataxe. It grants its wielder the Gargantuan Cleave weapon action, which can strike multiple targets but leaves the wielder Off-Balance for 1 turn.
quote: It's really very heavy.
notes: • True to its name, this weapon is about three times heavier than most Greataxes.

name: Vest of Soul Rejuvenation
icon: Vest of Soul Rejuvenation Unfaded Icon.png
description: Vest of Soul Rejuvenation is a very rare piece of Clothing. It heals the wearer on a successful saving throw against a spell and allows them to use a Reaction to make an Unarmed Attack against any attacker that misses.
quote: A garment worn by one of three monks who fought together against [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Headless_Serpent,_Secret_Venom Headless Serpent, Secret Venom], a gang in the port city of [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Port_Nyanzaru Nyanzaru]. This was worn by [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Strigga_Morkoscavich Strigga Morkoscavich], whose stances moved fluidly, flawlessly, and who defanged the Serpent one blustery night.
where_to_find:
Sold by Lorroakan's Projection in Sorcerous Sundries if Rolan is dead
• Sold by Rolan in Sorcerous Sundries if Rolan and Lorroakan are both alive
• Sold by Rolan via trade option on the bottom left during the dialogue in Ramazith's Tower if Rolan is alive but Lorroakan is dead
special: • Armour Class +2

name: Vicious Battleaxe
description: Vicious Battleaxe is a rare +2 Battleaxe that deals additional damage on a Critical Hit.
quote: A pulse of magic shoots through your hands whenever you touch this axe.
notes: • The player character can only purchase the Vicious Battleaxe from the Echo of Abazigal if they accept becoming an Unholy Assassin of Bhaal. However, it can also be acquired through an exploit – see notes on the Echo of Abazigal page for details.

name: Vicious Shortbow
description: Vicious Shortbow is a rare +2 Shortbow that deals 7 additional damage on a Critical Hit.
quote: Pliable yew and a hearty bowstring ensure this shortbow fires straight and true.
notes: • The player character can only purchase the Vicious Shortbow from the Echo of Abazigal if they accept becoming an Unholy Assassin of Bhaal. However, it can also be acquired through an exploit – see notes on the Echo of Abazigal page for details.

name: Vicious Shortsword
quote: Despite its engravings, this lightweight sword is perfectly balanced - a flawless killing implement.

name: Viconia's Priestess Robe
description: Viconia's Priestess Robe is a rare piece of Clothing that grants the wearer Advantage on Stealth checks while Obscured, and enhances Shield of Faith to give a +2 to all Saving Throws as well.
quote: Listening to the magical hum this robe emits dulls your senses, thoughts, feelings - everything. Listen too long, and you can almost hear the screaming chitters of a thousand spiders devoured by encroaching, hungry darkness. Almost.
where_to_find: Worn by Viconia DeVir during the quest Daughter of Darkness
special: • Armour Class +1

name: Viconia's Walking Fortress
description: Viconia's Walking Fortress is a legendary shield that can deal Force damage to the attacker when hit. Gives Advantage on saving throws against spells and Disadvantage to spell attacks made against the wearer.
quote: 'Walking Fortress' is a defensive technique reliant on a shield of this caliber. It involves upsetting your opponent who just wants to land a single blow.
where_to_find: Carried by Viconia DeVir during the quest Daughter of Darkness
special:
Reflective Shell (Bonus Action)
A protective shell envelops you. It reflects any projectiles targeted at you back to their point of origin. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
Warding Bond (Action)
Ward an ally. They gain resistance to all damage, and a +1 bonus to their Armour Class and Saving Throws. ( Recharge: Long rest.)
notes: • This shield sells for more than any other in the game.

name: Violin
description: Violin is a starting instrument for the Bard. It can be played with the Perform action.
quote: A violin of cedar and burled walnut. The pegs are a little scuffed, the strings thin and worn, but the song from this instrument would still ring clear and true.
where_to_find:
• Starting Instrument for Bard
• Random loot

name: Vision of the Absolute
icon: Vision of the Absolute Unfaded Icon.png
description: Vision of the Absolute is a Spear that possibly blinds targets and deals additional Piercing damage against targets with multiple sets of eyes.
quote: The tip of this spear strikes unerringly toward its target's eyes.
notes:
• Despite being themed around the Absolute, the spear does not seem to have any interactions with the Brand of the Absolute.
• The spear's specialty of dealing additional damage to spiders seems consistent with the positioning of the Absolute as a deific figure in opposition to Lolth, the Drow Queen of Spiders.
• Reforging the spear grants the inspiration A New Vision to party members with the Guild Artisan background.

name: Vital Conduit Boots
icon: Boots Metal Githyanki Magic Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Vital Conduit Boots are a pair of rare Boots that grants the wearer temporary Hit Points when they cast a Spell that requires Concentration.
quote: [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Tenser Tenser's] notes on arcane displacement were not only read by wizards - other avid readers included enterprising smiths eager to break into the magic items market.
where_to_find: Sold by A'jak'nir Jeera
special: • Athletics +1

name: Vivacious Cloak
description: Vivacious Cloak is an uncommon Cloak that grants the wearer 8 temporary Hit Points when casting a spell in melee.
quote: The sheer mortal terror of the low-vitality spellcaster (who can be blown over by a wafted spoon) can be partially offset by cloaks like this one.
where_to_find: In a locked traveller's chest in the south-east corner

name: Voss' Silver Sword
description: Voss' Silver Sword is a very rare +2 Longsword enhanced with additional Psychic damage. It also grants a bonus to damage and Attack Rolls against githyanki, aberrations, fiends and elementals and well as granting the wielder the ability to cast the Wrathful Smite spell.
quote: Heavy and grouted in the gore of countless centuries, this prototype for the contemporary githyanki silver sword was wielded during their rebellion against the mind flayers who enslaved them.
special:
Wrathful Smite (Action + Bonus Action)
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Short rest.)
notes:
• Prior to Patch 6 it could be purchased from Voss during Act 3, but this is no longer the case.
• The sword can be pickpocketed from Voss ( DC 26 Sleight of Hand Check) as early as right before the conversation with Raphael by a stealthy character buffed with Greater Invisibility, followed by teleportation to camp.

name: Wakeful Amulet
controller_icon: Amulet Necklace D Gold A 1 Unfaded.png
icon: Amulet Necklace D Gold A 1 Unfaded Icon.png
description: Wakeful Amulet is an uncommon Amulet that prevents the user from being put to sleep.
quote: While this doesn't prevent wilful rest, it does protect you from being put to sleep from such sources as hypnotism, copious alcohol usage, or, indeed, magic.

name: Wapira's Crown
description: Wapira's Crown is an uncommon Helmet that heals the wearer whenever they heal another creature.
quote: Legends say a Giant Elk and a druid once formed a powerful friendship. When the Elk laid down his life for the druid, she crafted this helmet in honour of her beloved friend, so his beauty and compassion would live on forever.
where_to_find: Rewarded by Zevlor for helping the tiefling refugees during Save the Refugees, provided the monetary reward is accepted
notes:
• If the reward is declined, the item can be purchased from Zevlor until the next long rest.
• Zevlor does not give this reward if Minthara is lead to attack the Emerald Grove.
• The helmet is inside the Patched-Together Sack.

name: War Pick
quote: A pickaxe modified to pierce flesh and armour rather than stone.

name: War Pick +1
quote: When swung, the arc of this weapon perfectly matches the curve of its beak-like pick.

name: Warhammer
quote: This hammer's noticeable lack of upkeep hardly matters, given its heft.

name: Warhammer +1
quote: Following tradition, this hammer's faces were forged with grooves that sealed in the blood of its first kill.

name: Warhammer +2
quote: The segmented design of this gnome-forged hammer borrows elements of dragonborn weaponry.

name: Warped Headband of Intellect
icon: Warped Headband of Intellect Unfaded Icon.png
description: The Warped Headband of Intellect is an uncommon Circlet that raises the wearer's Intelligence to 17.
quote: This particular circlet is covered in yellow slime and has pieces of half-digested mutton stuck behind the gems.
where_to_find: Carried by Lump the Enlightened
special: • Set the wearer's Intelligence score to 17. The enchantment has no effect if their Intelligence score is higher without it.
notes:
• This item originally provided the same effect as a regular D&D Headband of Intellect, setting Intelligence to 19; it was decreased to 17 to reduce its power during Early Access.
• This item is not worn by Lump, he carries it in his gut, which (although not stated in game) both explains and gives better context to its in-game description.
• Most effective on characters who need Intelligence as a secondary ability score and also have several other needed ability scores, such as Eldritch Knight Fighters and Arcane Trickster Rogues.
• If Wizards use this item to to prepare more spells than they are normally able to, those spells stay prepared even after taking it off.
• If convinced to fight for the party, Lump can be called and looted later within Act One.

variants.controller_icon: Item ARM Helmet BG Watch Metal B Unfaded.png
variants.icon: Item ARM Helmet BG Watch Metal B Unfaded Icon.png
variants.description: Watch's Helmet is a common Helmet that improves the wearer's Constitution Saving Throws.
variants.quote: Any padding that once lined this helmet has long since worn away.
variants.where_to_find: on a shelf in the Infiltration Training room

image: Item ARM Helmet BG Watch Metal A.png
controller_icon: Item ARM Helmet BG Watch Metal A Unfaded.png
icon: Item ARM Helmet BG Watch Metal A Unfaded Icon.png
description: Watch's Helmet is a common Helmet that improves the wearer's Constitution Saving Throws.
quote: Any padding that once lined this helmet has long since worn away.
special: • Constitution Saving Throws +1

name: Watcher Crossbow
special: Can only be used by Steel Watchers.

name: Watcher Greatsword
description: Watcher Greatsword is a common greatsword. It can only be wielded by Steel Watchers.
special: Can only be used by Steel Watchers.
notes:
• This sword can be picked up after a successful disarm against a Steel Watcher.
• With the introduction of Patch #3, all weapons with equip restrictions properly prevent character usage, with the patch notes specifically addressing the Steel Watcher greatsword.

name: Watcher's Shield
description: Watcher's Shield is an uncommon Shield that gives the wielder Advantage on Perception Checks.
quote: To hold this shield is to be vigilant in duty, wary of danger, and mindful in crisis.
where_to_find: On one of a pair of skeletons along the cliffs west of the House of Healing
special: • Advantage on Perception Checks

name: Wavemother's Boots
description: Wavemother's Boots is a rare pair of Boots that allow the wearer to heal while standing in water.
quote: Though vindictive and about as kindly as a tsunami, Umberlee the Sea Goddess is occasionally inclined toward restorative acts, as gentle as placid waves on a white-gold shore.

name: Wavemother's Cloak
description: Wavemother's Cloak is a rare Cloak that grants its wearer Water Layer Protection every turn.
quote: Little jellyfish-shaped pockets line the inside of this cloak.
where_to_find: in an opulent chest behind Allandra Grey's desk on the upper floor

name: Wavemother's Robe
description: Wavemother's Robe is a very rare piece of Clothing which heals the wearer while standing in Water. It also grants Resistance to Fire and Cold damage, and allows them to cast Create or Destroy Water.
quote: Tales tell of a most wondrous fish, scales resplendent, an intricate jewel that shone beneath the sea. When it died, the Wavemother gifted its hide as a robe to her most devoted follower - and demanded she drown the sailors that killed her gem-bright fish.
where_to_find: Rewarded by Allandra Grey in the basement for completing the quest Avenge the Drowned
special:
• Armour Class +1.
Create or Destroy Water (Action)
Cast as a level 4 spell ( Recharge: Short rest.)
bugs: • Switching from camp clothing to default view briefly (about 2 frames) shows the character from the waist up with no clothing.

name: Wavemother's Sickle
description: Wavemother's Sickle is a rare, + 2 Sickle that grants the wielder Advantage against targets with the Wet condition.
quote: The curve of this sickle evokes a pitiless crescent moon over turbulent seas.
notes: • Only two enchanted Sickles exist in game, with the other being Sussur Sickle.

name: Weave-Touched Robe
description: Weave-Touched Robe is a common Camp Clothing.
quote: A beautiful robe crafted with the Weave itself. It thrums with power.
where_to_find: Available only to Gale in the epilogue if he becomes the God of Ambitions

name: Well Crated Helm
controller_icon: Item ARM Helmet Metal B Icon.png
icon: Item ARM Helmet Metal B Unfaded Icon.png
description: A Well Crated Helm is a common helmet.
quote: Hammered into a fine shape by competent smiths.
where_to_find: On the second floor, sitting on a shelf
special: • Constitution Saving Throws +1
notes: • Also worn by various characters throughout the game.

name: Well-Cobbled Boots
description: Well-Cobbled Boots is a common pair of Camp Shoes.
quote: Crafted from tough, reinforced leather, these oft-oiled boots are sure to survive many years of use.
where_to_find: Available only to Wyll in the epilogue if he does not become a Duke of Baldur's Gate

name: Well-Worn Dress Shoes
description: Well-Worn Dress Shoes is a common pair of Camp Shoes.
quote: All the polish in the world can't hide the grass stains on these shoes.
where_to_find: Available only to Halsin in the epilogue

name: Whipping Cane
description: Whipping Cane is a mundane, nonmagical variant of the Clubs family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon wielded in one hand. It's a light weapon that anyone can dual-wield without special training. It has the same stats as a Club, making it a relatively useless weapon.
quote: A cane designed to inflict a sharp and agonizing pain with every blow.

name: Whispering Mask
description: Whispering Mask is a common Helmet with connections to Auntie Ethel.
quote: Soft, unintelligible whispers seep from the dark wood, ringing in your ears and resounding in your skull.
where_to_find: 4x – on a table in the Overgrown Tunnel Entrance Gallery, just before the Gnarled Door
special: • If Ethel is dead: Uncanny Sight
notes:
• Removing a Whispering Mask from an unconscious hag victim kills them if the hag is still alive.
• While Auntie Ethel is alive, the wearer of this mask must make a Wisdom Saving Throw every turn. If failed, they become a Hag's Pawn (controlled by Auntie Ethel) and attack the party; if all party members equip the masks and become Hag's Pawns, a Game Over screen appears. If all unaffected party members run away from combat (e.g., back to the Tea House), leaving no one to attack, the remaining mask-affected party member can unequip the mask after making a Wisdom saving throw.
• The negative effects of this mask can be prevented by casting Protection from Evil and Good before equipping it. In this case, the poison gas clouds in Ethel's lair temporarily dissipate for the wearer, and the thralls wearing these masks (e.g. Mask of Vengeance) will not attack the wearer.
• While in this protected state, the wearer still rolls saving throws against Ephemeral Whispers, but failing them has no effect.
• If Auntie Ethel is dead, the mask can be worn with no ill effects.
• If equipped by a Paladin when inside the tunnel, a dialogue with Ethel starts where a DC 15 Charisma Check is needed to prevent succumbing to the mask. Succeeding grants the Voice of Reason condition.
• Succumbing to Auntie Ethel's will due to wearing a Whispering Mask is an oathbreaking action for Paladins of Devotion, Paladins of the Ancients and Paladins of Vengeance.

name: Wide-Brimmed Hat
description: Wide-Brimmed Hat is a common non-armour Headwear.
quote: Very wide brimmed, really. Almost a kind of grinning sombrero.
where_to_find: Sold by Figaro Pennygood

name: Winkling Gloves
description: Winkling Gloves are a Rare pair of Gloves that improve the wearer's Attack Rolls and Sleight of Hand checks.
quote: Good for a winkle in cases of mechanisms, locks, or some bugger who needs killing.
where_to_find: Carried by Zanner Toobin in the western-most room on the ground floor or later accompanying the party in the basement during the quest Save the Gondians
special:
• Sleight of Hand +1
• Attack rolls +1

name: Winter Gala Doublet
description: Winter Gala Doublet is a set of common Camp Clothing.
quote: Crisply white with snatches of blue, this garment would not be out of place at a winter festival gala celebrating the wearer's sense of style.
notes: • This item is visually the same as Sweetly Tailored Outfit.

name: Winter's Clutches
description: The Winter's Clutches are an uncommon pair of Gloves that allow the wearer to inflict Encrusted with Frost on enemies whenever they deal Cold damage.
quote: Likely these originated in [https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Icewind_Dale Icewind Dale], where tempers run as hot as hearths, and frozen rivers trace the arm of the dale in a network of blue-white tributaries.
where_to_find: Given by Glut for completing Avenge Glut's Circle
notes: • The gloves given by Glut and the ones sold by Lady Esther are mutually exclusive: if the party gets one, the other does not appear.

name: Witchbreaker
description: Witchbreaker is an uncommon +1 Battleaxe that grants Advantage against concentrating foes and has a unique weapon action, Hush You!.
quote: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to... well, keep doing whatever she's doing. It's probably malefic, involving toads and... and things.

name: Wizard Hat
controller_icon: Generated ARM Hat Wizard A Icon.png
icon: Generated ARM Hat Wizard A Unfaded Icon.png
description: Wizard Hat is a common Non-Armour Headwear.
quote: This wizardly hat has a little embroidered rabbit inside its lining - the rabbit is called snowball, and once he was lost, never to be found.
where_to_find: Can be found by the fountain in Bloomridge Park in Baldur's Gate

name: Woe
description: Woe is a very rare, +2 Quarterstaff wielded by Cazador Szarr. It grants a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack Rolls, access to the Blight spell, and healing when creatures fail Saving Throws by the caster's spells.
quote: The gentle tap-tap-tap of a staff on stone sparked terror for all in Cazador's palace. It signalled an approaching storm, and all they could do was shrink into the background and pray its wrath would not fall on them.
special:
Blight (Action)
Cast as a level 4 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
bugs: • If one of the spawn is killed while in dialogue with Astarion after Cazador's death, the cutscene ends, the spawn flee, and Woe disappears even if not on a dialog branch where Asarion would have broken it otherwise.
notes:
• This staff cannot be obtained if it is destroyed via dialogue which includes:
• Refusing or failing to persuade Astarion out of becoming a Vampire Ascendant
• Helping Astarion Ascend but interrupting him in the middle of the ritual
• Choosing to leave the imprisoned spawns behind if Astarion does not Ascend or he is not present during the confrontation with Cazador

name: Wondrous Gloves
description: The Wondrous Gloves are a rare pair of gloves that increase the wearer's AC and give Bards an additional Bardic Inspiration.
quote: A series of motivational quotes have been enthusiastically removed from the embroidery of these gloves, as if in protest.
where_to_find: Carried by a Mimic near the harper cache
notes: • If Bardic Inspiration is given to an ally wearing these gloves and the gloves are then unequipped, the inspired ally loses the second use of bardic inspiration and is left with just one. If the inspired ally used one of the bardic inspiration points while wearing the gloves and then unequips them, the remaining bardic inspiration point will be lost.

name: Wood Woad Shield
description: Wood Woad Shield is an uncommon Shield found on Wood Woads and grants its wearer the ability to cast Woad's Ensnaring Strike.
quote: 'And with her arm the dryad linked a man who had once been her lover, and once of flesh and bone. Now his flesh was bark, and his bone heartwood. In his eyes a feverish love still blazed like a thousand fireflies in a spring meadow.'
where_to_find: Carried by Wood Woads in the Sunlit Wetlands
special:
Woad's Ensnaring Strike (Bonus Action)
Your attack summons thorny vines that possibly Ensnare your target. ( Recharge: Short rest.)

variants.name: Wooden Shield
variants.description: A Wooden Shield is a common Shield.
variants.quote: Blood splatters this shield - both inside and out.
variants.where_to_find: On the ground and against the walls of Talli's tent

variants.name: Wooden Shield
variants.description: A Wooden Shield is a common Shield.
variants.quote: Despite the chips and dents, you can still make out the faded painting of a flower on the face of this shield.
variants.where_to_find: Starting equipment for Paladins

name: Wooden Shield
description: A Wooden Shield is a common Shield.
quote: Blood splatters this shield - both inside and out.
where_to_find: Carried by some Duergar
notes:
Prior to Patch #7 this shield could be found equipped by Shadowheart following the crash of the Nautiloid in Act One, if her original shield was taken from her in the Prologue and not in her inventory.
Since Patch #7 Shadowheart will not be given this shield and instead will have nothing equipped if her shield is removed during the prologue.

name: Worgfang
description: Worgfang is an uncommon dagger which grants the wielder defensive capabilities against Goblins. Any goblin attacking the wielder suffers Disadvantage on its Attack Rolls.
quote: ‘No goblin will strike you down’ is etched into this dagger's handle. When goblin assailants realised they couldn't kill the dagger's original owner, they gave him to the worgs, who made short work of him.

name: Worn Shoes
description: Worn Shoes is a common pair of Camp Shoes.
quote: Newly repaired soles and a lick of polish can't hide the fact that these shoes have been nearly worn through.
where_to_find: Available only to Astarion in the epilogue if he remains a Vampire Spawn

name: Worn Slashstrip Sandals
description: Worn Slashstrip Sandals is a common pair of Camp Shoes.
quote: Slashes of leather gird the feet. A bright silvery button gleams.

name: Wulbren's Hammer
description: Wulbren's Hammer is an uncommon +1 Light Hammer that deals an extra 2d4 Force damage on each hit against constructs and world objects.
quote: "Constructs and objects melt beneath this hefty blunt tool when wielded by a sharp mind."
special: • 2d4 Force damage against items and world objects (unlisted).
notes: • This weapon can be given to Wulbren Bongle as part of Rescue Wulbren, in which case he recognizes it and rejoices at getting it back.

name: Wyll's Earthy Garb
description: Wyll's Earthy Garb is the default Camp Clothing of Wyll.
quote: In his good-humored performativity, Wyll could not resist a puff of perfume on these clothes. Possible eau du Frontiers.
where_to_find: Wyll's starting camp clothing
notes:
• Despite having a unique appearance when worn, the clothes use the same icon as the the Homely Clothes.
• If Wyll has equipped different clothing, he temporarily switches back to his default Camp Garb while Mizora punishes or rewards Wyll for his quest regarding Karlach.

name: Wyll's Underwear
description: Wyll's Underwear is the default Underwear for Wyll.
quote: Long may these gird the Blade of Frontiers.
where_to_find: Wyll's starting underwear
notes: • Underwear cannot be looted regularly. A party member must pick up the corpse to loot the underwear.

name: Xyanyde
description: Xyanyde is an uncommon +1 Mace. Once per short rest, it applies Faerie Fire on targets that the wielder misses.
quote: Cast deep in the Underdark by duergar slaves, the head of this mace is engraved with spiderwebs. It is ice-cold to the touch.

name: Yuan-Ti Scale Mail
description: Yuan-Ti Scale Mail is a rare Medium Armour that adds the wearer's Dexterity Modifier to their Armour Class and also grants a +1 bonus to Initiative.
quote: The Snakefolk of Chult are not known for waste, so often forge lightweight and robust armour like this from their own shed skin.
where_to_find: Sold by Quartermaster Talli near the Last Light Inn waypoint

name: Zina's Dog Collar
description: Zina's Dog Collar is a common Amulet. Primarily of use for barter or sale to Traders.
quote: Smells a bit rusty, but looks stylish nonetheless
where_to_find: Carried by Houndmaster Pol
notes: • Belonged to Zina when she lived.
